threads.title_zh: Solana 基金会确定 Alpenglow 主网升级日期
threads.title_en: Solana Foundation Sets Alpenglow Mainnet Upgrade Date
threads.summary_zh: Solana基金会将10月21日（epoch 1064）定为Alpenglow主网激活日期，该升级将用新系统取代TowerBFT共识，目标是将交易最终确认时间从当前的约12.8秒缩短至约150毫秒，并将从区块中移除投票交易——这会大幅降低表面TPS数据，但实际活动不会减少。
threads.summary_en: The Solana Foundation set October 21 (epoch 1064) for the Alpenglow mainnet activation, which replaces the TowerBFT consensus with a new system targeting roughly 150ms transaction finality instead of the current ~12.8 seconds, and will remove vote transactions from blocks — sharply lowering headline TPS counts without any decline in real activity.
threads.latest_update_zh: Solana基金会将10月21日（epoch 1064）定为Alpenglow主网激活日期，该升级将用新系统取代TowerBFT共识，目标是将交易最终确认时间从当前的约12.8秒缩短至约150毫秒，并将从区块中移除投票交易——这会大幅降低表面TPS数据，但实际活动不会减少。
threads.latest_update_en: The Solana Foundation set October 21 (epoch 1064) for the Alpenglow mainnet activation, which replaces the TowerBFT consensus with a new system targeting roughly 150ms transaction finality instead of the current ~12.8 seconds, and will remove vote transactions from blocks — sharply lowering headline TPS counts without any decline in real activity.
threads.background_zh: TowerBFT 自 Solana 主网上线以来一直是其共识机制，并与历史证明（PoH）配合运行，后者作为一种为事件排序的密码学时钟。Anza 与 Solana 均称 Alpenglow 是迄今对 Solana 核心协议最重大的重构；新的投票协议 Votor 随 Agave 4.3 发布。
threads.background_en: TowerBFT has been Solana's consensus mechanism since mainnet launch, working alongside Proof of History (PoH), a cryptographic clock that orders events. Anza and Solana describe Alpenglow as the most significant overhaul of Solana's core protocol to date; the new voting protocol Votor ships in Agave 4.3.
threads.latest_summary_zh: The Solana Foundation set October 21 (epoch 1064) for the Alpenglow mainnet activation, which replaces the TowerBFT consensus with a new system targeting roughly 150ms transaction finality instead of the current ~12.8 seconds, and will remove vote transactions from blocks — sharply lowering headline TPS counts without any decline in real activity.
threads.latest_summary_en: The Solana Foundation set October 21 (epoch 1064) for the Alpenglow mainnet activation, which replaces the TowerBFT consensus with a new system targeting roughly 150ms transaction finality instead of the current ~12.8 seconds, and will remove vote transactions from blocks — sharply lowering headline TPS counts without any decline in real activity.
threads.market_impact_zh: 该升级直接关系到 SOL 质押者与验证者以及在 Solana 上结算的应用，因为亚秒级最终确认可能改变交易所、托管机构和支付处理方对链上结算的处理方式。由于验证者投票移至链下，被广泛引用的 Solana 交易量指标可能发生变化，从而影响数据服务商和市场观察者对网络活跃度的判断。
threads.market_impact_en: The upgrade directly concerns SOL stakers and validators and the applications settling on Solana, since sub-second finality could change how exchanges, custodians and payment processors treat on-chain settlement. Because validator votes move off-chain, widely cited Solana transaction-count metrics may shift, affecting how data providers and market observers read network activity.

timeline.text_zh: Solana基金会将10月21日（epoch 1064）定为Alpenglow主网激活日期，该升级将用新系统取代TowerBFT共识，目标是将交易最终确认时间从当前的约12.8秒缩短至约150毫秒，并将从区块中移除投票交易——这会大幅降低表面TPS数据，但实际活动不会减少。
timeline.text_en: The Solana Foundation set October 21 (epoch 1064) for the Alpenglow mainnet activation, which replaces the TowerBFT consensus with a new system targeting roughly 150ms transaction finality instead of the current ~12.8 seconds, and will remove vote transactions from blocks — sharply lowering headline TPS counts without any decline in real activity.

timeline.text_zh: Solana已将其Alpenglow共识升级安排在10月21日，目标是通过取代TowerBFT并将验证者投票移至链下，实现约150毫秒的交易最终性，同时要求验证者迁移至Agave 4.3.0。
timeline.text_en: Solana has scheduled its Alpenglow consensus upgrade for Oct. 21, targeting roughly 150-millisecond transaction finality by replacing TowerBFT and moving validator votes off-chain, while requiring validators to migrate to Agave 4.3.0.

timeline.text_zh: Anza 宣布 Alpenglow 计划于 2026 年 10 月 21 日 22:50 左右在 Solana 主网 Mainnet-beta 激活，迁移将在单个 slot 内完成；此前主网激活时间未定。
timeline.text_en: Anza announced that Alpenglow is scheduled to activate on Solana Mainnet-beta around Oct 21, 2026 at 22:50, with a single-slot migration; the mainnet activation was previously unscheduled.

threads.title_zh: Anthropic 筹备 IPO：递交招股书并计划最早 11 月中旬上市
threads.title_en: Anthropic files IPO prospectus
threads.summary_zh: Anthropic 正在推进其约 2 万亿美元估值的 IPO，目标 11 月上市，并于 10 月 14 日向投资者披露 Q3 营收 168 亿美元、调整后盈利且现金流为正，市场关注其营收确认口径。
threads.summary_en: Anthropic is advancing its ~$2 trillion IPO targeting a November listing, and on October 14 disclosed Q3 revenue of $16.8 billion with adjusted profitability and positive cash flow to investors, with market focus on revenue recognition clarity.
threads.latest_update_zh: Anthropic 告知投资者其第三季度营收跃升至 168 亿美元，较第二季度的 115 亿美元增长近 50%，按调整后口径实现盈利，并录得正现金流。
threads.latest_update_en: Anthropic told investors its Q3 revenue rose to $16.8 billion, up nearly 50% quarter-over-quarter from $11.5 billion, with adjusted profitability and positive cash flow.
threads.background_zh: Anthropic 是一家 AI 安全与研究公司，以公益公司（public benefit corporation）形式运营，由包括 Amodei 兄妹在内的前 OpenAI 员工创立。若完成 IPO，公司将由私募持股转为公开上市。
threads.background_en: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company that operates as a public benefit corporation and was founded by former OpenAI staff, including siblings Dario and Daniela Amodei. An IPO would move the company from private ownership into public markets.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Anthropic told investors its Q3 revenue rose to $16.8 billion, up nearly 50% quarter-over-quarter, with adjusted profitability and positive cash flow as it prepares for what is expected to be the largest IPO by valuation in history.
threads.latest_summary_en: Anthropic told investors its Q3 revenue rose to $16.8 billion, up nearly 50% quarter-over-quarter, with adjusted profitability and positive cash flow as it prepares for what is expected to be the largest IPO by valuation in history.
threads.market_impact_zh: Anthropic 并未发行代币，因此对加密市场的传导是间接的：一方面通过 AI 叙事类代币的市场情绪，另一方面是这样一笔大型 AI 股票上市可能吸走机构配置资金、加剧风险资本竞争。按其报道中的规模，这一事件更可能影响 AI 相关加密板块的情绪与流动性，而非某一具体资产。
threads.market_impact_en: Anthropic issues no token, so any crypto-market transmission would be indirect — through sentiment toward AI-narrative tokens and through competition for risk capital as a large AI equity listing absorbs institutional allocations. The scale of the reported offering makes it a potential sentiment and liquidity factor for AI-adjacent crypto segments rather than for any single asset.

timeline.text_en: Anthropic told investors its Q3 revenue rose to $16.8 billion, up nearly 50% quarter-over-quarter from $11.5 billion, with adjusted profitability and positive cash flow.

timeline.text_zh: Anthropic 于10月14日在旧金山总部向潜在机构投资者披露第三季度营收数据，作为其约2万亿美元IPO进程的一部分，重点在于营收确认口径（是否计入云合作伙伴收入）。
timeline.text_en: Anthropic is disclosing its Q3 revenue to potential institutional investors at its San Francisco headquarters on October 14 as part of its ~$2 trillion IPO process, with focus on revenue recognition clarity (including whether cloud partner revenue is counted).

timeline.text_zh: 据报道，Anthropic 正准备最早于 11 月中旬 IPO，目标估值约 1.8 至 2 万亿美元，并将于 10 月 14 日在旧金山开始与投资者会面。
timeline.text_en: Anthropic is reportedly preparing to IPO as early as mid-November, targeting a valuation of about $1.8-2 trillion and beginning investor meetings in San Francisco on October 14.

threads.title_zh: Ledger硬件钱包供应链植入间谍芯片窃取助记词事件
threads.title_en: Ledger Hardware Wallet Supply Chain Implant Seed Theft Incident
threads.summary_zh: Ledger已将销售暂停请求扩大至六个东南亚国家和香港的经销商，设备下架，调查仍在进行；Ledger称已确认事件仍限于东南亚，且未核实其他地区购买设备相关的资金流出。
threads.summary_en: Ledger has expanded its sales suspension request to resellers in six Southeast Asian countries and Hong Kong, with devices removed from shelves and the investigation ongoing; Ledger says confirmed incidents remain contained to Southeast Asia and it has not verified a drain linked to a device bought elsewhere.
threads.latest_update_zh: Ledger要求印度尼西亚、新加坡、泰国、菲律宾、越南、马来西亚及香港的经销商暂停销售并下架硬件钱包，以调查设备篡改事件；此前仅要求经销商CryptoBilis停售和停止发货。
threads.latest_update_en: Ledger requested resellers and distributors in Indonesia, Singapore, Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia and Hong Kong to suspend sales and remove its hardware wallets from shelves while it investigates device tampering; this expands on the earlier request for reseller CryptoBilis to halt sales and shipments.
threads.background_zh: 相关调查于 10 月 9 日公开，此前有用户报告称，通过区域经销商 CryptoBilis 购买的 Ledger 设备涉及加密资产被盗；Ledger 表示所有已确认的损失都涉及通过该经销商售出的设备。Ledger 称目前确认的相关事件仍局限于东南亚，尚未核实其他地区购买的设备与资金被盗有关。该公司还强调，没有迹象表明其自身基础设施、系统、服务或官方直销渠道遭到入侵。研究人员称，自 9 月 16 日起已发现 Ledger X 设备中被植入该装置，被篡改的设备以近原价一半的价格出售。
threads.background_en: The investigation was disclosed on Oct 9 after users reported crypto asset thefts linked to Ledger devices bought through CryptoBilis, a reseller in the region; Ledger has said all confirmed losses involve devices sold through that reseller. Ledger said the only confirmed incidents remain contained in Southeast Asia and that it has not verified a drain linked to a device bought elsewhere. It added that it has no indication its own infrastructure, systems, services or direct sales channel have been compromised. Researchers have reported the implant in Ledger X devices since Sept 16, with tampered units offered at nearly half the original price.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Ledger asked resellers and distributors across six Southeast Asian countries plus Hong Kong to suspend sales and remove its hardware wallets from shelves while it investigates confirmed device-tampering incidents in the region.
threads.latest_summary_en: Ledger asked resellers and distributors across six Southeast Asian countries plus Hong Kong to suspend sales and remove its hardware wallets from shelves while it investigates confirmed device-tampering incidents in the region.
threads.market_impact_zh: 此次影响集中在 Ledger 设备在东南亚及香港的线下零售与经销渠道，传导路径主要作用于供应链完整性和自托管信心，而非协议流动性。Ledger 称其官方直销渠道未受影响；与此同时，竞争对手 Trezor 表示出于预防将于 2027 年 1 月 1 日终止对经销商的授权，这可能使硬件钱包需求在不同厂商和销售渠道之间发生转移。
threads.market_impact_en: The disruption sits in the physical retail and reseller channel for Ledger devices in Southeast Asia and Hong Kong, so the transmission runs through supply-chain integrity and self-custody sentiment rather than protocol liquidity. Ledger says its direct sales channel is unaffected, while rival Trezor's stated plan to end reseller authorizations from Jan 1, 2027 as a precautionary measure could shift hardware-wallet demand between vendors and sales channels.

reference_links.title: Ledger confirms spy chip implant behind wallet crypto thefts

timeline.text_zh: Ledger要求印度尼西亚、新加坡、泰国、菲律宾、越南、马来西亚及香港的经销商暂停销售并下架硬件钱包，以调查设备篡改事件；此前仅要求经销商CryptoBilis停售和停止发货。
timeline.text_en: Ledger requested resellers and distributors in Indonesia, Singapore, Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia and Hong Kong to suspend sales and remove its hardware wallets from shelves while it investigates device tampering; this expands on the earlier request for reseller CryptoBilis to halt sales and shipments.

timeline.text_zh: 在Ledger的Donjon团队确认，通过经销商CryptoBilis售出的硬件钱包中被植入间谍程序，可捕获助记词并通过LTE外传——链上追踪到疑似被盗资金达8600万美元——之后，Trezor出于预防考虑，决定在2027年1月1日前削减其自有授权经销商网络。
timeline.text_en: After Ledger's Donjon team confirmed a spy implant in hardware wallets sold via reseller CryptoBilis that captures seed phrases and exfiltrates them over LTE — with $86M in suspected thefts traced onchain — Trezor moved to cut its own authorized reseller network by January 1, 2027 as a precaution.

timeline.text_zh: 新报道称，Mark Karpelès 已在菲律宾官方经销商 LazMall 销售的 Ledger 钱包中也发现间谍软件，使受影响经销商范围进一步扩大；Ledger 最新声明称尚未核实来自其他渠道购买签名器的资金流出，并正在审查其他签名器和地点的植入物报告，同时 CryptoBilis 在调查期间继续停售。
timeline.text_en: The new report says Mark Karpelès has also found spyware in Ledger wallets sold by official Philippine reseller LazMall, further widening the affected-reseller scope; Ledger’s latest statement says it has not verified a drain linked to a signer bought elsewhere and is reviewing reports of implants in other signers and locations, while CryptoBilis remains not selling wallets during the investigation.

threads.title_zh: Payward 收购立陶宛 Saldo 银行以获取欧盟银行牌照
threads.title_en: Payward to acquire Lithuania-based Saldo Bank for EU banking license
threads.summary_zh: Payward已同意收购Saldo Bank以获得欧盟银行牌照，交易待监管批准，预计2027年完成。
threads.summary_en: Payward has agreed to acquire Saldo Bank to obtain an EU banking license, pending regulatory approval, expected to close in 2027.
threads.latest_update_zh: CoinDesk 报道补充：该交易据 Financial Times 称为加密公司首次收购欧洲银行；Saldo Bank 2025 年底总资产约 1.639 亿欧元（1.8 亿美元）；Payward 计划提供有息存款、贷款、卡服务和欧元支付；其银行业务已发放逾 20 亿美元贷款，并持有美联储有限用途主账户和爱尔兰电子货币机构牌照。
threads.latest_update_en: CoinDesk adds that the deal is reportedly the first acquisition of a European bank by a crypto company according to the Financial Times; Saldo Bank had €163.9 million ($180 million) in total assets at end-2025; Payward plans to offer interest-bearing deposits, loans, card services and euro payments; its banking business has originated over $2 billion in loans and holds a Federal Reserve limited-purpose master account and an Irish electronic money institution license.
threads.background_zh: Kraken 是一家成立于 2011 年的美国加密货币交易所，据维基百科介绍，它是首家获得银行牌照的加密公司。Payward 一直在推进受监管金融基础设施布局：它已申请美国的 national trust bank 牌照，CoinDesk 在 7 月报道称 Kraken 正在争取立陶宛的银行牌照。Payward 联合首席执行官 Arjun Sethi 表示，一家受监管的欧盟银行“让我们能够像主要金融机构那样服务欧洲客户：一个可以持有资产、自由转移资产并让资产产生收益的地方”。
threads.background_en: Kraken is a US-based cryptocurrency exchange founded in 2011, and per Wikipedia it was the first crypto company to obtain a bank charter. Payward has been pushing into regulated financial infrastructure: it has applied for a US national trust bank charter, and CoinDesk reported in July that Kraken was seeking a banking license in Lithuania. Payward co-CEO Arjun Sethi said a regulated EU bank "is the piece that lets us serve European clients the way a primary financial institution should: one place to hold assets, move them freely, and put them to work."
threads.latest_summary_zh: Payward, the parent of crypto exchange Kraken, agreed to acquire Lithuania-based Saldo Bank to secure an EU banking license and expand into interest-bearing deposits, lending, cards and euro payments — reportedly the first such acquisition of a European bank by a crypto company.
threads.latest_summary_en: Payward, the parent of crypto exchange Kraken, agreed to acquire Lithuania-based Saldo Bank to secure an EU banking license and expand into interest-bearing deposits, lending, cards and euro payments — reportedly the first such acquisition of a European bank by a crypto company.
threads.market_impact_zh: 这笔交易把加密行业的资金直接引入受欧盟监管的银行基础设施，使 Payward 掌握吸收存款、放贷和欧元支付通道，与面向欧盟加密用户的传统银行形成竞争。主要影响传导至面向欧盟市场的交易所、托管与支付服务商——其法币出入金和收益类产品将面对一家持牌银行的竞争；同时该交易预计 2027 年完成，并仍待监管批准。
threads.market_impact_en: The transaction channels crypto-native capital directly into EU-regulated banking infrastructure, giving Payward control of deposit-taking, lending and euro payment rails that compete with traditional lenders serving EU crypto users. The main exposure runs through EU-facing exchanges, custody and payments providers whose fiat on/off-ramp and yield products would face a licensed banking competitor, with the deal's 2027 closing and regulatory approval still pending.

timeline.text_en: CoinDesk adds that the deal is reportedly the first acquisition of a European bank by a crypto company according to the Financial Times; Saldo Bank had €163.9 million ($180 million) in total assets at end-2025; Payward plans to offer interest-bearing deposits, loans, card services and euro payments; its banking business has originated over $2 billion in loans and holds a Federal Reserve limited-purpose master account and an Irish electronic money institution license.

timeline.text_zh: Payward 已签署最终协议，收购持有欧盟银行牌照的立陶宛 Saldo Bank（通过芬兰控股公司 Saldo Finance Oy 旗下 Saldo Bank UAB），预计 2027 年完成，尚待监管批准；交易将使其银行服务扩展至立陶宛、芬兰、瑞典、德国和荷兰。
timeline.text_en: Payward signed a definitive agreement to acquire Lithuania-licensed Saldo Bank (via Finnish holding company Saldo Finance Oy and subsidiary Saldo Bank UAB), expected to close in 2027 subject to regulatory approvals; the deal would expand banking services into Lithuania, Finland, Sweden, Germany and the Netherlands.

timeline.text_zh: Kraken母公司Payward宣布计划收购受欧盟监管的立陶宛银行Saldo，以拓展贷款和发卡等传统银行服务，该交易预计在获得监管批准后于2027年完成。
timeline.text_en: Kraken parent Payward announced plans to acquire EU-regulated Lithuanian bank Saldo to expand into traditional banking services like lending and card issuance, with the deal expected to close in 2027 pending regulatory approval.

threads.title_zh: Blast宣布关停L2主网，因维护成本超过收入
threads.title_en: Blast announces shutdown of its L2 mainnet as maintenance costs exceed revenue
threads.summary_zh: Blast 因维护成本超过收入而停止运营，用户需在 10 月 26 日前将资产撤回以太坊主网；Bithumb 与 Upbit 已将 BLAST 列入交易注意名单并暂停充值；Upbit 进一步宣布将下架 BLAST，并将在当地时间 10 月 26 日 12:00 下架 BLAST 现货交易，相关网络转换期间暂停提现；Coinbase 要求用户在 10 月 26 日前将 BLAST 转出，并据报道于 10 月 20 日暂停 BLAST 交易。
threads.summary_en: Blast is ceasing operations because maintenance costs exceed revenue, and users need to withdraw assets to Ethereum mainnet by Oct. 26. Bithumb and Upbit added BLAST to trading-caution watchlists and suspended deposits; Upbit has further announced it will delist BLAST and will delist BLAST spot trading on Oct. 26 at 12:00 local time, with withdrawals halted during the associated network conversion. Coinbase requires users to move BLAST off Coinbase by Oct. 26 and is reported to suspend BLAST trading on Oct. 20.
threads.latest_update_zh: Upbit 具体说明将于当地时间 10 月 26 日 12:00 下架 BLAST 现货交易。
threads.latest_update_en: Upbit specified that it will delist BLAST spot trading on October 26 at 12:00 local time.
threads.background_zh: Blast 是一条以太坊二层网络，在 2024 年 2 月主网上线时吸引了 23 亿美元存款，最初主打 ETH 与稳定币持仓的原生收益。有报道称，团队于 2026 年 10 月 2 日宣布逐步关停，理由是运营成本已超过二层网络收入，且看不到可信的经济可持续路径。
threads.background_en: Blast is an Ethereum layer-2 network that drew $2.3 billion in deposits by its February 2024 mainnet launch and initially pitched native yield on ETH and stablecoin holdings. Reports say the team announced the wind-down on October 2, 2026, citing operating costs that exceed L2 revenue with no credible path to economic sustainability.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Upbit announced it will delist BLAST spot trading on October 26 at 12:00 local time.
threads.latest_summary_en: Upbit announced it will delist BLAST spot trading on October 26 at 12:00 local time.
threads.market_impact_zh: 传导路径经由交易所托管与提现基础设施：存放在 Coinbase 的 BLAST 必须在截止日期前转出，随着网络关停，资金流将集中到该代币剩余的交易场所与提现通道。这也会影响市场对以太坊二层网络经济模型的情绪，不过此次关停属于有序退出，而非故障或漏洞事件。
threads.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through exchange custody and withdrawal infrastructure: BLAST held on Coinbase must be moved before the deadline, which concentrates flow into the token's remaining trading venues and withdrawal rails as the network winds down. It also feeds sentiment about the economics of Ethereum layer-2 networks, though the shutdown is an orderly sunset rather than a failure or exploit.

threads.background_zh: Evernorth 通过 SPAC 合并上市，据搜索结果其合并对象为 Armada Acquisition Corp II，并获得 Ripple 支持；相关信息提到其计划以 XRPN 为代码登陆纳斯达克，同时持有 4.73 亿枚 XRP 和 3 亿美元现金。XRP Ledger 的借贷协议（XLS-66）是一种链上 DeFi 基础组件，可基于单一资产金库的池化资金发放固定期限、无抵押贷款，这正是 Evernorth 表示将拓展的方向。
threads.background_en: Evernorth came to the public market through a SPAC merger, reported to be with Armada Acquisition Corp II, and is backed by Ripple; search results describe a planned Nasdaq listing under the ticker XRPN alongside the 473 million XRP and $300 million in cash. The XRP Ledger's Lending Protocol (XLS-66) is an on-chain primitive that enables fixed-term, uncollateralized loans funded from a pooled single-asset vault, the DeFi venue Evernorth says it will expand into.

threads.market_impact_zh: 传导路径主要体现在托管与交易场所安排上：约 6.48 亿美元的 XRP 头寸被接入 Kraken、Coinbase 和 BitGo，而后续在 XRP Ledger 上开展 XRP 借贷的计划若落地，将把这部分供应中的一部分转入链上借贷池。实际影响取决于该机构策略是否真正执行。
threads.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs mainly through custody and venue arrangements: a roughly $648 million XRP position is being routed to Kraken, Coinbase and BitGo, and the later plan to lend XRP on the XRP Ledger would, if executed, move part of that supply into on-chain lending pools. Any effect is contingent on deployment actually proceeding under the stated institutional strategies.

II merger closed on Oct. 9 and began trading on Nasdaq on Oct. 12; about 80.3% of public shareholders redeemed roughly $195 million, leaving a thin float; XRP fell from $2.37 at signing to a $1.43 reference price, marking the treasury at about $677 million versus the originally touted more than $1 billion raise; SBI Holdings controls 39.9% of voting shares, Arrington Capital's fund holds 19.9%, Chris Larsen is tied to 9.9%, and Ripple and affiliates are capped at 9.9% with six-month lock-ups until April 2027.

II and will begin trading on Nasdaq under ticker XRPN on October 12, carrying roughly 473 million XRP and about $300 million in gross cash proceeds from investors including Ripple, SBI Group, Pantera Capital, Kraken and GSR, while its accounting model recognizes impairment losses without allowing reversals when XRP recovers.

threads.title_zh: XRP Ledger 披露并修复可无限铸造 XRP 的支付路径漏洞
threads.title_en: XRP Ledger patched old flaw that could create XRP from nothing
threads.summary_zh: XRP Ledger 已披露并修复支付引擎中的整数溢出漏洞，该漏洞自 2015 年起潜伏且普通支付不会触发；3.4.1 补丁于 9 月 25 日发布，超过 80% 可信验证者当日已运行该补丁；无证据表明漏洞曾被利用。
threads.summary_en: The XRP Ledger disclosed and patched an integer overflow in the payment engine that had been dormant since 2015 and is not triggered by normal payments; the 3.4.1 fix shipped on Sept. 25, and more than 80% of trusted validators were running it that day; there is no evidence the bug was ever exploited.
threads.latest_update_zh: 新披露该漏洞是支付引擎中的整数溢出，自 2015 年支付引擎编写以来一直存在；攻击者通过消耗数百个特制订单簿报价可使买方应付款项溢出并少付，而账本内置的“未创建 XRP”安全检查使用同样的错误算术，因此无法拦截。漏洞由 XRPL 漏洞赏金计划于 9 月报告。
threads.latest_update_en: Newly disclosed that the flaw was an integer overflow in the payment engine, present since the engine was written in 2015; an attacker could consume hundreds of specially crafted order-book offers to overflow the buyer's owed amount and underpay, while the ledger's built-in 'no XRP created' safety check used the same broken arithmetic and failed to catch it. The bug was reported through the XRPL bug bounty program in September.
threads.latest_summary_zh: XRP Ledger maintainers disclosed and patched a decade-old integer overflow in the payment engine that could have let an attacker mint counterfeit XRP, with no evidence the bug was ever exploited.
threads.latest_summary_en: XRP Ledger maintainers disclosed and patched a decade-old integer overflow in the payment engine that could have let an attacker mint counterfeit XRP, with no evidence the bug was ever exploited.

timeline.text_zh: 新披露该漏洞是支付引擎中的整数溢出，自 2015 年支付引擎编写以来一直存在；攻击者通过消耗数百个特制订单簿报价可使买方应付款项溢出并少付，而账本内置的“未创建 XRP”安全检查使用同样的错误算术，因此无法拦截。漏洞由 XRPL 漏洞赏金计划于 9 月报告。
timeline.text_en: Newly disclosed that the flaw was an integer overflow in the payment engine, present since the engine was written in 2015; an attacker could consume hundreds of specially crafted order-book offers to overflow the buyer's owed amount and underpay, while the ledger's built-in 'no XRP created' safety check used the same broken arithmetic and failed to catch it. The bug was reported through the XRPL bug bounty program in September.

timeline.text_zh: XRP Ledger 基金会进一步说明，该漏洞之所以多年未被发现，是因为正常账本参数从未触发它。
timeline.text_en: The XRP Ledger Foundation further explained that the bug went undetected for years because normal ledger parameters never triggered it.

timeline.text_zh: XRP Ledger 基金会与开发者公开为 9 月 25 日紧急补丁辩护，称若等待常规两周验证者投票会提前暴露漏洞；他们否认中心化指控，强调决定由基金会、RippleX、核心开发者和验证者共同做出，且 3.4.1 后来通过正常修正案投票以超过 80% 支持持续两周成为必需版本。
timeline.text_en: The XRP Ledger Foundation and developers publicly defended the Sept. 25 emergency patch, saying waiting for the usual two-week validator vote would have exposed the flaw; they rejected centralization claims, stressing the decision was joint among the Foundation, RippleX, core developers and validators, and that 3.4.1 later became required via a normal amendment vote with over 80% support sustained for two weeks.

threads.title_zh: CFTC提出规则将事件合约归类为联邦掉期并排除赌场赌博
threads.title_en: CFTC Proposes CTX and CAM Rules to Establish Federal Crypto Exchange Framework
threads.summary_zh: CFTC提出两项规则，将事件合约归类为联邦“掉期”，同时排除赌场赌博，这加剧了其与起诉Kalshi和Polymarket等预测市场运营商的各州之间的管辖权之争。
threads.summary_en: The CFTC proposed two rules that would classify event contracts as federal 'swaps' while excluding casino gambling, escalating its jurisdictional battle with states suing prediction-market operators like Kalshi and Polymarket.
threads.latest_update_zh: CFTC提案明确将体育、政治、文化和天气事件合约纳入掉期定义，并发布临时最终规则排除体育博彩和赌场赌注，进一步划定预测市场与赌博的联邦界限。
threads.latest_update_en: The CFTC proposed expressly including sports, political, cultural and weather event contracts in the swap definition and issued an interim final rule excluding sportsbook and casino wagers, further drawing the federal line between prediction markets and gambling.
threads.background_zh: 参议院未能达到推进《CLARITY 法案》所需的 60 票门槛，该法案本将为数字资产建立法定框架。美国加密交易目前要么适用为其他市场制定的规则，要么适用各州不一的地方牌照。CFTC 的这份通知还否定了该机构在拜登时期对 Kraken、Ooki DAO 和 Uniswap 的执法案件，称其为“以执法代替监管”。
threads.background_en: The Senate failed to reach the 60 votes needed to advance the CLARITY Act, which would have created a statutory framework for digital assets. Crypto trading in the US currently runs under rules built for other markets or under state licenses that vary by state. The CFTC notice also disowns the agency's Biden-era cases against Kraken, Ooki DAO and Uniswap as regulation by enforcement.
threads.latest_summary_zh: The CFTC proposed including sports, political, cultural and weather event contracts in the swap definition while issuing an interim final rule excluding sportsbook and casino wagers, drawing a federal line between prediction markets and gambling.
threads.latest_summary_en: The CFTC proposed including sports, political, cultural and weather event contracts in the swap definition while issuing an interim final rule excluding sportsbook and casino wagers, drawing a federal line between prediction markets and gambling.
threads.market_impact_zh: 传导路径在于美国市场准入：联邦牌照将使本土交易所能够上线目前主要在离岸提供的杠杆及永续类产品，涉及交易所股票、在岸永续合约场所及为其撮合交易的经纪商，而更清晰的规则也会降低银行和券商涉足加密业务的门槛。由于该文件只是开启意见征询期，近期影响限于围绕美国受监管场所的情绪与仓位，而非已生效的规则。
threads.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through US market access: a federal license would let domestic exchanges list leveraged and perpetual-style products now largely offered offshore, putting exchange equities, listed perp venues and the brokers routing those trades in scope, with clear rules also lowering the barrier for banks and brokers to touch crypto. Because the document only opens a comment period, near-term effects are confined to sentiment and positioning around US-regulated venues rather than to rules in force.

timeline.text_zh: CFTC提案明确将体育、政治、文化和天气事件合约纳入掉期定义，并发布临时最终规则排除体育博彩和赌场赌注，进一步划定预测市场与赌博的联邦界限。
timeline.text_en: The CFTC proposed expressly including sports, political, cultural and weather event contracts in the swap definition and issued an interim final rule excluding sportsbook and casino wagers, further drawing the federal line between prediction markets and gambling.

timeline.text_zh: CFTC发布了一项立即生效的临时最终规则，并提出另一项新规，拟将Kalshi和Polymarket等平台的预测市场事件合约纳入其掉期监管框架；临时最终规则已立即生效但仍接受公众意见，新规提案则有30天意见征询期。
timeline.text_en: The CFTC issued an immediately effective interim final rule and proposed a new rule to bring prediction-market event contracts on platforms such as Kalshi and Polymarket under its swaps regulatory framework; the interim final rule is effective immediately but remains open to comment, while the proposed rule has a 30-day comment period.

timeline.text_zh: NFL向最高法院提交法庭意见书，支持新泽西州在Kalshi案中的调卷令申请，主张各州可对预测市场的体育事件合约施加赌博监管，并对CFTC声称拥有专属联邦管辖权提出异议，指出Kalshi未遵守操纵防范措施、内部人员投注限制和21岁年龄要求。
timeline.text_en: The NFL filed an amicus brief with the Supreme Court supporting New Jersey's cert petition in the Kalshi case, arguing states may impose gambling regulation on prediction-market sports event contracts and disputing the CFTC's claim of exclusive federal jurisdiction, citing unmet manipulation safeguards, insider-betting limits, and age-21 requirements that Kalshi does not follow.

threads.title_zh: ESMA 发布 MiCA 意见，要求不合规稳定币有序清退并规范 DeFi 服务
threads.title_en: ESMA Issues MiCA Opinion on Non-Compliant Stablecoins and DeFi Services
threads.summary_zh: ESMA发布意见，要求不符合MiCA规定的稳定币在1月8日前逐步清退，并将该要求扩大至此前指引允许继续开展的托管和转移服务。
threads.summary_en: ESMA issued an opinion ordering the wind-down of MiCA-noncompliant stablecoins by January 8, expanding the requirement to cover custody and transfer services that earlier guidance had permitted to continue.
threads.latest_update_zh: ESMA发布意见，要求不符合MiCA规定的稳定币在1月8日前逐步清退，并将该要求扩大至此前指引允许继续开展的托管和转移服务。
threads.latest_update_en: ESMA issued an opinion ordering the wind-down of MiCA-noncompliant stablecoins by January 8, expanding the requirement to cover custody and transfer services that earlier guidance had permitted to continue.
threads.background_zh: MiCA的稳定币规则涵盖资产参考代币（ART）和电子货币代币（EMT），自2024年6月起适用，要求面向欧盟用户发行的美元和欧元挂钩代币的发行方满足授权、储备、赎回和信息披露要求。ESMA在2025年1月17日的声明中限制了构成向公众发售的交易及其他服务，但为单纯的托管和转移留出空间；此次新意见是对该指引的补充，并在ESMA另行提出的“立法禁止一切涉及不合规稳定币的可许可服务”诉求之上，增加了时间表和受监督的退出安排。
threads.background_en: MiCA's stablecoin rules — covering asset-referenced tokens and e-money tokens — began applying in June 2024, requiring issuers of dollar- and euro-pegged tokens offered to EU users to meet authorization, reserve, redemption and disclosure requirements. An earlier ESMA statement on Jan. 17, 2025 restricted trading and other services constituting public offers while leaving mere custody and transfers open; the new opinion complements that guidance and adds a timetable and supervised exit arrangements to ESMA's separate request for legislation prohibiting all licensable services involving non-compliant stablecoins.
threads.latest_summary_zh: ESMA issued an opinion ordering the wind-down of MiCA-noncompliant stablecoins by January 8, expanding the requirement to cover custody and transfer services that earlier guidance had permitted to continue.
threads.latest_summary_en: ESMA issued an opinion ordering the wind-down of MiCA-noncompliant stablecoins by January 8, expanding the requirement to cover custody and transfer services that earlier guidance had permitted to continue.
threads.market_impact_zh: 传导路径在于欧盟市场准入：欧洲经济区内获得MiCA授权的交易所和托管机构可能需要缩减或调整涉及USDT等不合规代币的服务，这可能影响这些平台面向欧盟客户的订单簿流动性以及充提可用性。该意见针对的是通过受监管欧盟机构获取的敞口，并未在全球范围禁止持有此类代币，因此影响集中于欧盟受监管平台及其EEA客户群，而非非欧盟平台或自托管持仓。
threads.market_impact_en: The transmission runs through EU market access: MiCA-authorized exchanges and custodians in the EEA may have to curtail or restructure services touching non-compliant tokens such as USDT, which can affect EU client order-book liquidity and deposit/withdrawal availability on those venues. The opinion concerns access via regulated EU firms and does not impose a worldwide ban on holding such tokens, so exposure is concentrated in EU-regulated venues and their EEA customer base rather than in non-EU or self-custodied holdings.

timeline.text_en: ESMA issued an opinion ordering the wind-down of MiCA-noncompliant stablecoins by January 8, expanding the requirement to cover custody and transfer services that earlier guidance had permitted to continue.

timeline.text_zh: ESMA发布意见，要求各国监管机构强制MiCA授权公司在三个月内处理欧盟客户对不合规稳定币的风险敞口，在此期间仅允许在严格监管下进行清算、转换、提现、转移或保管。
timeline.text_en: ESMA issued an opinion requiring national regulators to force MiCA-authorized firms to remediate EU clients' exposure to non-compliant stablecoins within three months, with only narrowly supervised liquidation, conversion, withdrawal, transfer or safekeeping allowed in the interim.

timeline.text_zh: ESMA发布意见，要求欧盟加密企业在三个月内停止涉及不合规稳定币的服务，并设定2027年1月8日为各国监管机构完成风险敞口处理的最后期限；该意见扩展了2025年1月的指引，将适用范围扩大至交易平台、兑换、订单执行、托管、转账、投资建议与投资组合管理等所有MiCA监管服务。
timeline.text_en: ESMA issued an opinion requiring EU crypto firms to cease services involving non-compliant stablecoins within three months, setting a January 8, 2027 deadline for national regulators to wind down remaining exposures; the opinion expands January 2025 guidance to cover all MiCA-regulated crypto services including trading platforms, exchange, order execution, custody, transfer, investment advice and portfolio management.

threads.title_zh: Strategy斥资9.508亿美元回购STRC，远超同期比特币买入
threads.title_en: Strategy prioritizes $950 million STRC buyback over expanding its Bitcoin treasury
threads.summary_zh: Strategy继续将资本配置优先用于STRC回购以维持其接近100美元的目标价：截至2026年10月11日，USD Cash降至6.405亿美元（8月30日为16.1亿美元），20亿美元STRC回购授权仅剩3.548亿美元，USD Reserve降至48.8亿美元。比特币持仓为848,000枚（截至10月5日）。股东10月28日将就优先股每日派息投票。按近期消耗速度，USD Cash若不补充或在约四周内耗尽。
threads.summary_en: Strategy continues prioritizing STRC buybacks to defend its ~$100 target price: as of Oct 11, 2026, USD Cash fell to $640.5M (from $1.61B on Aug 30), only $354.8M of its $2B STRC buyback authorization remained, and the USD Reserve declined to $4.88B. BTC holdings were 848,000 as of Oct 5. Shareholders vote Oct 28 on daily preferred dividends. At the recent burn rate, USD Cash could be depleted in about four weeks without replenishment.
threads.latest_update_zh: 截至2026年10月11日，Strategy的USD Cash从8月30日的16.1亿美元降至6.405亿美元，降幅60%；20亿美元STRC回购授权仅剩3.548亿美元；独立USD Reserve同期从51.0亿美元降至48.8亿美元。按近七周约9.7亿美元的消耗速度，若不补充，USD Cash约四周内耗尽。
threads.latest_update_en: As of Oct 11, 2026, Strategy's USD Cash fell 60% from $1.61B on Aug 30 to $640.5M; only $354.8M of its $2B STRC buyback authorization remained; the separate USD Reserve declined from $5.10B to $4.88B. At the ~$970M burn pace over less than seven weeks, USD Cash could run out in about four weeks absent replenishment.
threads.background_zh: Strategy 于 8 月 24 日设立了“美元现金”这一资金池，其大部分资金来自前一周出售约 20 亿美元 MSTR 股票所得的约 15.7 亿美元。公司当时表示，美元现金“与美元储备形成互补，为管理层提供更灵活的流动性来源”。较早设立的美元储备有更严格的使用限制，除董事会正式另行授权外，只能用于支付优先股股息和利息；例如在 10 月 4 日当周，Strategy 为此支付了 1.425 亿美元。
threads.background_en: Strategy created the USD Cash bucket on August 24, funding most of it with about $1.57 billion from the sale of roughly $2 billion of MSTR stock the prior week. The company said at the time that USD Cash “complements the USD Reserve by providing management with a more flexible source of liquidity.” The older USD Reserve carries stricter limits and may be used for preferred dividends and interest payments unless the board formally authorizes otherwise; Strategy paid out $142.5 million for those purposes during the week of October 4.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Strategy's USD cash reserves dropped 60% in seven weeks — from $1.61B to $640.5M — as the company spent heavily buying back its STRC preferred stock to defend its ~$100 target price, funded largely by earlier common-shareholder dilution.
threads.latest_summary_en: Strategy's USD cash reserves dropped 60% in seven weeks — from $1.61B to $640.5M — as the company spent heavily buying back its STRC preferred stock to defend its ~$100 target price, funded largely by earlier common-shareholder dilution.
threads.market_impact_zh: Strategy 是最大的企业级比特币持有者，因此其美元缓冲变薄会通过“储备增持能力”这一渠道影响市场上来自企业金库的边际买盘，而非通过协议或供给层面的变化。同时，STRC 回购的成本直接落在优先股持有人与 MSTR 普通股股东身上，因为所用现金主要来自普通股增发稀释。
threads.market_impact_en: Strategy is the largest corporate holder of bitcoin, so a thinner dollar cushion affects the marginal corporate bid for BTC through treasury-accumulation capacity rather than through protocol or supply changes. The STRC buybacks also put preferred holders and MSTR common shareholders directly on the hook for the capital-structure cost, since the cash used was largely raised via common-share dilution.

timeline.text_zh: 截至2026年10月11日，Strategy的USD Cash从8月30日的16.1亿美元降至6.405亿美元，降幅60%；20亿美元STRC回购授权仅剩3.548亿美元；独立USD Reserve同期从51.0亿美元降至48.8亿美元。按近七周约9.7亿美元的消耗速度，若不补充，USD Cash约四周内耗尽。
timeline.text_en: As of Oct 11, 2026, Strategy's USD Cash fell 60% from $1.61B on Aug 30 to $640.5M; only $354.8M of its $2B STRC buyback authorization remained; the separate USD Reserve declined from $5.10B to $4.88B. At the ~$970M burn pace over less than seven weeks, USD Cash could run out in about four weeks absent replenishment.

timeline.text_zh: 2026年9月29日至10月5日当周，Strategy买入334枚BTC（花费2870万美元），同时以1.763亿美元回购约177万股STRC；比特币持仓增至848,000枚。此外，公司提交代理文件寻求股东批准将STRC、STRF、STRK和STRD的股息支付改为每个工作日支付，特别股东大会定于10月28日。Q3比特币持仓仅净增1,666枚，因当季买入7,218枚并卖出5,553枚；Q3回购STRC支出约13.8亿美元。
timeline.text_en: During the week of Sept 29–Oct 5, Strategy bought 334 BTC for $28.7 million while repurchasing about 1.77 million STRC shares for $176.3 million; BTC holdings reached 848,000. It also filed a proxy seeking shareholder approval to move STRC, STRF, STRK and STRD to daily dividend payments, with a special meeting set for Oct. 28. Q3 BTC holdings rose only 1,666 BTC net as it bought 7,218 and sold 5,553; Q3 STRC repurchases totaled about $1.38 billion.

timeline.text_zh: 最新披露显示，Strategy累计回购STRC的支出已增至约12.8亿美元，占20亿美元回购授权额度的64%，剩余不足7.24亿美元；累计回购约1330万股STRC，约占流通股的八分之一。上周回购支出1.517亿美元，回购均价升至98.86美元，远高于7月底约86.52美元的均价。
timeline.text_en: Latest disclosure shows Strategy has spent about $1.28 billion, or 64%, of its $2 billion STRC repurchase authorization, leaving less than $724 million; it has repurchased 13.3 million STRC shares, roughly one in eight outstanding. Last week it spent $151.7 million at an average price of $98.86, up from an average of $86.52 in late July.

threads.title_zh: Google 发布 Gemini 4 Argon 模型
threads.title_en: Google releases Gemini 4 Argon model
threads.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 的 Gemini 4 Argon 已向全球付费用户开放，此前仅面向部分网络安全合作伙伴。用户可通过 Gemini App（Google AI Pro/Ultra）、Antigravity（仅 Ultra）及付费 API 使用；API 首发价为每百万输入 token 2 美元、输出 10 美元，优惠至 11 月 30 日后翻倍。谷歌同时展示其视频驱动机器人技能学习、自动仿真生成等能力，ERQA 物理推理评测得分 87%。
threads.summary_en: Google DeepMind's Gemini 4 Argon is now open to global paid users after initially being limited to selected cybersecurity partners. It is available via the Gemini App (Google AI Pro/Ultra), Antigravity (Ultra only), and paid API; introductory API pricing is $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens until Nov 30, after which it doubles. Google also showcased video-driven robot skill learning, automated simulation generation, and an 87% score on the ERQA physical-reasoning benchmark.
threads.latest_update_zh: Gemini 4 Argon 从仅面向部分网络安全合作伙伴，扩大至向全球所有付费用户正式开放；可在 Gemini App（Google AI Pro/Ultra）、Antigravity（仅 Ultra）和付费 API 使用；API 首发价每百万输入 2 美元、输出 10 美元，优惠持续至 11 月 30 日后翻倍。谷歌还展示了其视频驱动机器人技能学习和仿真生成能力，ERQA 得分 87%。
threads.latest_update_en: Gemini 4 Argon expanded from limited availability for selected cybersecurity partners to a general opening for all global paid users; it is available in the Gemini App (Google AI Pro/Ultra), Antigravity (Ultra only), and paid API. Introductory API pricing of $2/$10 per million tokens lasts until Nov 30, after which it doubles. Google also showcased video-driven robot skill learning, simulation generation, and an 87% ERQA score.
threads.background_zh: 据 9to5Google 报道，Gemini 4 Argon 采用了新的命名体系，此前谷歌取消了 Gemini 3.5 Pro，并将重心放在 Gemini 3.8 Flash 上。前沿模型通常基于海量数据训练，成本极高，涵盖数据获取与处理以及算力开支。第三方对比报道将 Gemini 4 Argon 与 OpenAI 的 GPT-6 Astra 视为同代竞争对手。
threads.background_en: Gemini 4 Argon uses a new naming scheme and follows the cancellation of Gemini 3.5 Pro, with Google having focused on Gemini 3.8 Flash, according to 9to5Google. Frontier models are typically trained on vast datasets at very high cost, covering data acquisition and processing plus compute. Third-party comparison coverage places Gemini 4 Argon alongside OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra as a same-generation rival.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Google has opened Gemini 4 Argon to all global paid users, showcasing video-driven robot skill learning (Apptronik's Apollo landing 7 straight sandbag throws), automated simulation generation, 87% on the ERQA physical-reasoning benchmark, and launch API pricing of $2/$10 per million tokens that doubles after November 30.
threads.latest_summary_en: Google has opened Gemini 4 Argon to all global paid users, showcasing video-driven robot skill learning (Apptronik's Apollo landing 7 straight sandbag throws), automated simulation generation, 87% on the ERQA physical-reasoning benchmark, and launch API pricing of $2/$10 per million tokens that doubles after November 30.
threads.market_impact_zh: 该发布与链上资产、托管或代币供给没有直接关联；对加密市场的可能传导渠道是情绪面，即去中心化算力、AI 代理等 AI 叙事类资产历来会对头部实验室的前沿模型发布作出反应。由于模型初期仅面向选定合作伙伴开放，目前尚不能确立开发者需求层面的即时变化。
threads.market_impact_en: The release has no direct on-chain, custody or token-supply linkage; any crypto read-through runs through sentiment in AI-narrative assets such as decentralized-compute and AI-agent tokens, which have historically reacted to frontier-model announcements from major labs. Because availability is initially gated to select partners, no immediate developer-demand shift is established.

timeline.text_zh: Google DeepMind 发布了 Gemini 4“Argon”，这是一款新的前沿模型，可通过 API 使用，入门价格为每百万输入 token 2 美元、每百万输出 token 10 美元（缓存输入享 95% 折扣），因其 SVG 生成和自然语言写作质量而受到关注。
timeline.text_en: Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 'Argon', a new frontier model available via API at introductory pricing of $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens (95% off cached input), drawing attention for its SVG generation and natural-language writing quality.

timeline.text_zh: Artificial Analysis 的独立评估发现，谷歌的 Gemini 4 Argon 在智能指数上以 53 分与 GPT-6 Astra 持平，其幻觉率远低（15%），API 入门价格也更便宜，但全价成本和答案准确性落后于 Astra。
timeline.text_en: Artificial Analysis' independent evaluation finds Google's Gemini 4 Argon ties GPT-6 Astra on the Intelligence Index at 53 points with a far lower hallucination rate (15%) and cheaper introductory API costs, though full-price costs and answer accuracy lag Astra.

threads.title_zh: 持有超200万枚$SOL（约2.2亿美元）的SkyAI疑似正在亏损抛售$SOL！
threads.title_en: SkyAI, which holds over 2M $SOL($220M), appears to be dumping $SOL at a loss!
threads.summary_zh: SkyAI 仍在持续清算其 SOL 储备：已披露出售 100 万枚 SOL 套现约 1.07 亿美元，链上自 10 月初以来累计转出约 157 万枚 SOL（约 1.75 亿美元），8-K 显示持仓已降至约 60 万枚，按约 194 美元均价计算浮亏超过 1.6 亿美元；公司 10 月 11 日宣布每股 3.00 美元现金要约收购以回购 95% 股份，但大股东 Bastion Trading 公开反对并要求全面披露、独立审查、改组董事会及提高要约价至至少 3.50 美元。
threads.summary_en: SkyAI remains in an ongoing SOL liquidation: it disclosed selling 1M SOL for about $107M, on-chain outflows since early October total about 1.57M SOL (~$175M), an 8-K shows holdings down to ~600K SOL, with unrealized losses over $160M on a ~$194 average cost basis; its Oct 11 $3.00/share cash tender offer to buy back 95% of shares is now publicly opposed by 9.99% holder Bastion Trading, which demands full disclosure, an independent review, board changes, and a higher price of at least $3.50/share.
threads.latest_update_zh: 10月13日Form 8-K显示SkyAI的SOL持仓已降至约60万枚，较9月中旬“逾200万枚”减少约七成；持有约9.99%流通普通股的大股东Bastion Trading公开质疑公司10月11日宣布的每股3.00美元现金要约收购，要求立即全面披露SOL处置细节、启动独立审查、改组董事会，并将要约价提高至至少每股3.50美元，否则不会参与。
threads.latest_update_en: An Oct 13 Form 8-K shows SkyAI's SOL holdings have fallen to about 600,000, down roughly 70% from the 'over 2M' disclosed in mid-September; 9.99% holder Bastion Trading publicly challenged the company's Oct 11 $3.00/share cash tender offer, demanding immediate full disclosure of SOL disposals, an independent review, board changes, and a higher tender price of at least $3.50/share before it will participate.
threads.background_zh: 数字资产储备型公司（DAT）以持币作为上市公司资产，Solana 板块的储备积累竞争近期加剧，Forward Industries、DFDV 等公司均公布过数百万枚 SOL 的持仓。SkyAI 此次事件的核心，在于上市储备型公司如何披露和执行其核心储备的出售，以及 Form 8-K 这一用于向股东报告重大事件的 SEC 申报文件。
threads.background_en: Digital asset treasury (DAT) companies hold crypto on their balance sheets as a listed-market vehicle, and the Solana segment has seen intensifying accumulation, with firms such as Forward Industries and DFDV reporting multi-million SOL positions. SkyAI's situation centers on how a listed treasury vehicle discloses and executes sales of its core reserve, and on the Form 8-K, the SEC filing companies use to report major events to shareholders.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Nasdaq-listed Solana treasury firm SkyAI has offloaded roughly 1.75M SOL (~$175M) since early October, cutting holdings ~70% and crystallizing large losses, while 9.99% holder Bastion Trading is demanding full disclosure, an independent review, board changes, and a higher tender price before supporting the company's cash offer.
threads.latest_summary_en: Nasdaq-listed Solana treasury firm SkyAI has offloaded roughly 1.75M SOL (~$175M) since early October, cutting holdings ~70% and crystallizing large losses, while 9.99% holder Bastion Trading is demanding full disclosure, an independent review, board changes, and a higher tender price before supporting the company's cash offer.
threads.market_impact_zh: 此次处置将约 157 万枚此前由公司金库持有的 SOL 投放至市场，构成对 SOL 流动性与供给的直接渠道。被质疑的要约收购还关系到上市 SOL 储备型公司的溢价水平与融资能力，并可能通过情绪渠道传导至整个 DAT 板块。
threads.market_impact_en: The disposal places roughly 1.57 million SOL of previously treasury-held supply into the market, a direct channel to SOL liquidity and supply. The contested tender offer also bears on the premium-to-NAV and financing capacity of listed SOL treasury vehicles, which can transmit to sentiment across the DAT segment.

timeline.text_en: An Oct 13 Form 8-K shows SkyAI's SOL holdings have fallen to about 600,000, down roughly 70% from the 'over 2M' disclosed in mid-September; 9.99% holder Bastion Trading publicly challenged the company's Oct 11 $3.00/share cash tender offer, demanding immediate full disclosure of SOL disposals, an independent review, board changes, and a higher tender price of at least $3.50/share before it will participate.

timeline.text_zh: SkyAI 披露已出售 100 万枚 SOL、套现约 1.07 亿美元，并表示可能继续出售；链上数据显示自 10 月初以来累计转出约 157 万枚 SOL（约 1.75 亿美元），按约 194 美元均价计算浮亏超过 1.6 亿美元。
timeline.text_en: SkyAI disclosed it has sold 1 million SOL for about $107M and signaled possible further sales; on-chain data now shows about 1.57M SOL (~$175M) moved out since early October, with unrealized losses exceeding $160M on a ~$194 average cost basis.

timeline.text_zh: SkyAI 被监测到正在清算其 SOL 储备，近5天累计卖出约125万枚 SOL（约1.38亿美元），其中包括约半小时前将211,623枚 SOL 转入 Coinbase Prime；公司公告称此次出售是为了回购其已发行股份的95%。
timeline.text_en: SkyAI is liquidating its SOL reserves, having sold roughly 1.25 million SOL (~$138M) over five days, including a 211,623 SOL transfer to Coinbase Prime; the company announced the sale is to fund a buyback of 95% of its outstanding shares.

threads.title_zh: Coinbase 获 CFTC 批准将指数期货转换为永续合约并完成 Deribit 整合
threads.title_en: Coinbase Completes Deribit Integration
threads.summary_zh: Coinbase 已获得 CFTC 清算注册资格，使其能够清算美国衍生品交易并扩展其受监管的衍生品业务。
threads.summary_en: Coinbase has secured CFTC clearing registration, allowing it to clear US derivatives trades and expand its regulated derivatives business.
threads.latest_update_zh:
Coinbase 已获得美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）的衍生品清算组织注册资格，从而可以清算美国衍生品交易。该注册依据《商品交易法》第 5b 条，在公司提交申请并经过审查后获批。

该注册使 Coinbase 能够自行清算其衍生品交易，而不再依赖第三方清算机构，从而为其受美国监管的衍生品业务补上清算环节。据有关该批准的报道，CFTC 将注册范围限定为全额抵押的期货、期货期权和掉期，杠杆类产品不在此列。

Coinbase Derivatives 自称是一个以加密资产为核心的期货交易所，提供覆盖多种资产类别和合约规模的产品。此次 CFTC 注册属于《商品交易法》第 5b 条下的衍生品清算资格。
threads.latest_update_en: Coinbase has secured CFTC clearing registration, allowing it to clear US derivatives trades and expand its regulated derivatives business.
threads.background_zh: Coinbase Derivatives 是一家受 CFTC 监管的期货交易所，提供以加密资产为重点的合约，其中包括面向个人交易者的较小规模期货。衍生品清算组织必须满足《商品交易法》第 5b 条规定的标准和程序，才能向 CFTC 注册。
threads.background_en: Coinbase Derivatives operates as a CFTC-regulated futures exchange offering crypto-focused contracts, including smaller-sized futures aimed at individual traders. Derivatives clearing organizations must meet the criteria and procedures set out in Section 5b of the Commodity Exchange Act to register with the CFTC.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Coinbase has secured CFTC clearing registration, allowing it to clear US derivatives trades and expand its regulated derivatives business.
threads.latest_summary_en: Coinbase has secured CFTC clearing registration, allowing it to clear US derivatives trades and expand its regulated derivatives business.
threads.market_impact_zh: 这一变化将 Coinbase 的清算环节内部化，从而影响美国受监管加密衍生品的市场结构，并可能影响机构参与者在美国场所获取期货和期权的路径以及抵押品存放方式。同时，这也关系到 Coinbase 作为受监管加密市场基础设施提供商的上市股票定位。
threads.market_impact_en: The change affects U.S.-regulated crypto derivatives market structure by moving clearing in-house for Coinbase, which can influence how institutional participants access futures and options on U.S. venues and how collateral is held. It also touches Coinbase's listed-equity profile as a regulated crypto market infrastructure provider.

timeline.text_zh: Coinbase 的 Deribit 整合现已为符合条件的美国客户提供通过受 CFTC 监管的 Coinbase Financial Markets 接入全球加密期权和永续合约流动性的途径；美国机构客户可通过 Coinbase Prime 和 Coinbase Financial Markets 接入，美国零售期权预计今年晚些时候推出。
timeline.text_en: Coinbase's Deribit integration now gives eligible US customers access to global crypto options and perpetual futures liquidity through CFTC-regulated Coinbase Financial Markets; US institutional clients can access via Coinbase Prime and Coinbase Financial Markets, with US retail options expected later this year.

timeline.text_zh: Coinbase已完成将收购的衍生品交易所Deribit整合进其平台，并计划在年底前重新推出其高级/专业交易服务。
timeline.text_en: Coinbase has completed the integration of acquired derivatives exchange Deribit into its platform and intends to relaunch its advanced/pro trading service before the end of the year.

threads.title_zh: 法国国民议会财政委员会通过稳定币兑换税及加密资产退出税修正案后否决预算收入部分
threads.title_en: French lawmakers back stablecoin swap tax in 2027 budget bill
threads.summary_zh: 法国国民议会财政委员会已通过包括31.4%加密兑MiCA稳定币税、自托管钱包超10万欧元申报和加密退出税在内的修正案，随后以31票对3票否决预算收入部分；这些修正案退回国民议会全体审议，收入部分预计10月20日投票，目前均未成为法律。
threads.summary_en: France's National Assembly Finance Committee has adopted amendments including a 31.4% crypto-to-MiCA-stablecoin tax, self-custody wallet reporting above €100,000, and a crypto exit tax, then rejected the budget's revenue section 31-3; the amendments return to the full National Assembly, with a revenue vote expected Oct. 20 and no measure yet law.
threads.latest_update_zh: 新增具体税率：法国2027年预算修正案拟对加密货币兑换为MiCA监管稳定币征收31.4%资本利得税；财政委员会以31票对3票否决政府收入部分；预计10月20日就收入部分进行投票；目前尚无任何措施成为法律。
threads.latest_update_en: Adds the specific 31.4% capital gains tax rate on crypto-to-MiCA-regulated-stablecoin conversions in France's 2027 budget amendment; the finance committee rejected the government's revenue section by 31 votes to 3; a revenue vote is expected Oct. 20; no measure is law yet.
threads.latest_summary_zh: France's parliament is reviewing a 2027 budget amendment that would impose a 31.4% capital gains tax on crypto-to-MiCA-stablecoin conversions from January 2027, alongside proposals to declare self-custodied wallets above €100k and include crypto in the exit tax, with a revenue vote expected Oct. 20 and no measure yet law.
threads.latest_summary_en: France's parliament is reviewing a 2027 budget amendment that would impose a 31.4% capital gains tax on crypto-to-MiCA-stablecoin conversions from January 2027, alongside proposals to declare self-custodied wallets above €100k and include crypto in the exit tax, with a revenue vote expected Oct. 20 and no measure yet law.

timeline.text_zh: 新增事实：法国财政委员会另于10月7日通过允许加密损失结转最多10年的修正案；Chainalysis法国CEO警告31.4%稳定币税可能推动交易转向不受监管的离岸稳定币；议会需在12月10日前通过2027年预算。
timeline.text_en: New facts: a separate Oct. 7 amendment backed by the finance committee would allow crypto losses to be carried forward up to 10 years; Chainalysis' France CEO warned the 31.4% regulated-stablecoin tax could push trading toward unregulated offshore stablecoins; lawmakers have until Dec. 10 to pass the 2027 budget.

timeline.text_zh: 法国国民议会财政委员会还通过了一项修正案（I-CF821），要求持有价值10万欧元及以上自托管加密资产的人每年申报持仓，未申报最高罚款1万欧元。
timeline.text_en: France's National Assembly Finance Committee also adopted an amendment (I-CF821) requiring holders of self-custodied crypto worth €100,000 or more to report holdings annually, with fines up to €10,000 for non-declaration.

threads.summary_en: Kraken has launched operations in Dubai after receiving full market approval from the Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA), expanding its regulated footprint into the UAE.
threads.latest_update_zh: Kraken在获得虚拟资产监管局（VARA）的全面市场批准后已在迪拜开展业务，将其受监管业务版图扩展至阿联酋。
threads.latest_update_en: Kraken has launched operations in Dubai after receiving full market approval from the Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA), expanding its regulated footprint into the UAE.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Kraken has launched operations in Dubai after receiving full market approval from the Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA), expanding its regulated footprint into the UAE.
threads.latest_summary_en: Kraken has launched operations in Dubai after receiving full market approval from the Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA), expanding its regulated footprint into the UAE.

timeline.text_zh: Kraken在获得虚拟资产监管局（VARA）的全面市场批准后已在迪拜开展业务，将其受监管业务版图扩展至阿联酋。
timeline.text_en: Kraken has launched operations in Dubai after receiving full market approval from the Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA), expanding its regulated footprint into the UAE.

timeline.text_zh: 迪拜加密监管机构批准Kraken母公司Payward在阿联酋运营，为该交易所服务当地投资者扫清障碍。
timeline.text_en: Dubai's crypto regulator approved Kraken parent company Payward to operate in the UAE, clearing the exchange to serve local investors.

timeline.text_zh: Payward 获 VARA 全面市场批准，可作为受监管 VASP 运营；计划在阿联酋推出 AED 现货和保证金交易、法币出入金、链上质押、xStocks、Krak 转账及机构 OTC/Kraken Prime 服务，衍生品和收益产品预计 2026 年底至 2027 年推出。

threads.title_zh: 渣打银行在阿联酋推出比特币和以太坊现货交易
threads.title_en: Standard Chartered launches spot Bitcoin and Ether trading in the UAE
threads.summary_zh: 渣打银行在获得迪拜虚拟资产监管局牌照后，为阿联酋富裕客户推出比特币和以太坊直接交易服务，通过现有银行账户提供买卖、托管和结算，采用与Zodia Markets共同构建的闭环模式。
threads.summary_en: Standard Chartered launched direct Bitcoin and Ethereum trading for its affluent UAE clients after receiving a Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority license in Dubai, offering buy/sell, custody and settlement through existing bank accounts in a closed-loop model built with Zodia Markets.
threads.latest_update_zh: 渣打银行将其在阿联酋的比特币和以太币现货交易扩展至专业投资者，符合条件的客户可在现有银行账户内交易；资格要求净资产至少400万迪拉姆（约110万美元），并计划进一步扩大准入。
threads.latest_update_en: Standard Chartered expanded its spot Bitcoin and Ether trading in the UAE to professional investors, allowing eligible clients to trade within existing bank accounts; eligibility requires at least AED 4 million (~$1.1M) in net assets, and the bank plans to broaden access further.
threads.background_zh: 现货交易是指以当前市场价格直接买卖实际资产（如比特币或以太币），与期货或期权等衍生品交易相对。机构客户通常包括资产管理公司、银行和大型企业。阿联酋（尤其是迪拜）已将自己定位为对加密货币友好的监管中心，DIFC和虚拟资产监管局（VARA）等监管机构吸引了交易所和银行。G-SIB是金融稳定理事会认定的全球系统重要性银行，渣打银行获此身份，使其本次服务更具标志性意义。
threads.background_en: Spot trading means buying or selling the actual asset, such as Bitcoin or Ether, at the current market price, as opposed to derivatives like futures or options. Institutional clients typically include asset managers, banks, and large corporations. The UAE, especially Dubai, has positioned itself as a crypto-friendly hub with regulators such as the DIFC and the Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA) attracting exchanges and banks. G-SIB is a designation by the Financial Stability Board for banks whose systemic importance is considered significant globally, which adds symbolic weight to Standard Chartered's offering.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Standard Chartered expanded its spot Bitcoin and Ether trading services to UAE clients qualifying as professional investors, allowing them to trade within existing bank accounts and signaling plans to broaden access further.
threads.latest_summary_en: Standard Chartered expanded its spot Bitcoin and Ether trading services to UAE clients qualifying as professional investors, allowing them to trade within existing bank accounts and signaling plans to broaden access further.
threads.market_impact_zh: 通过一家成熟的全球性银行增加受监管的法币与加密货币出入金通道以及托管关联的执行渠道，此举可能改善市场结构，为机构资本接触比特币和以太币提供更便利的途径。然而，对价格的直接传导仍是间接的，取决于实际客户需求，而非仅凭这一声明本身。
threads.market_impact_en: By adding a regulated fiat-to-crypto on- and off-ramp and a custody-linked execution channel through an established global bank, this move could improve market structure and provide a more accessible venue for institutional capital to engage with Bitcoin and Ether. The direct transmission to prices, however, remains indirect and depends on actual client demand rather than the announcement alone.

timeline.text_zh: 渣打银行将其在阿联酋的比特币和以太币现货交易扩展至专业投资者，符合条件的客户可在现有银行账户内交易；资格要求净资产至少400万迪拉姆（约110万美元），并计划进一步扩大准入。
timeline.text_en: Standard Chartered expanded its spot Bitcoin and Ether trading in the UAE to professional investors, allowing eligible clients to trade within existing bank accounts; eligibility requires at least AED 4 million (~$1.1M) in net assets, and the bank plans to broaden access further.

timeline.text_zh: 渣打银行推出阿联酋首个此类加密货币交易服务，让富裕的专业投资者客户可直接通过银行账户买卖比特币和以太坊，托管和结算通过闭环模式在内部处理。
timeline.text_en: Standard Chartered launched a first-of-its-kind-in-the-UAE crypto trading service letting affluent, professional-investor clients buy and sell bitcoin and ether directly through bank accounts, with custody and settlement handled in-house via a closed-loop model.

timeline.text_zh:
渣打银行已通过其在迪拜国际金融中心（DIFC）受监管的实体，在阿联酋向机构客户推出比特币和以太币现货交易。该银行声称自己是首家在该地区提供此类受监管机构级数字资产交易的主要全球银行，也是首家提供类似服务的全球系统重要性银行（G-SIB）。

这是一个重要的机构采用里程碑：一家G-SIB通过其现有银行平台提供受监管的加密现货交易，标志着数字资产正获得越来越多的主流认可。这可能促使其他大型全球银行效仿，并扩大中东地区机构资本接触受监管加密服务的渠道。

符合条件的机构客户可通过渣打银行整合至现有平台的电子交易渠道进行交易。渣打此前已于2024年9月在阿联酋推出数字资产托管服务，并于6月与加密交易所CoinMENA达成银行业务协议，以支持法币出入金、客户资金账户以及基于虚拟账户的交易管理。
timeline.text_en: Standard Chartered launches spot Bitcoin and Ether trading for institutional clients in the UAE, claiming to be the first major global bank to offer this in the region.

threads.title_zh: 美国司法部审查币安是否违反2023年和解协议及伊朗制裁
threads.title_en: US DOJ Reviews Whether Binance Breached Its 2023 Settlement and Iran Sanctions
threads.summary_zh: 美国司法部正在审查币安是否违反了其2023年和解协议的条款，此举可能使该交易所面临新一轮执法或额外的合规义务。
threads.summary_en: The U.S. Department of Justice is reviewing whether Binance violated the terms of its 2023 settlement agreement, a step that could expose the exchange to renewed enforcement or added compliance obligations.
threads.latest_update_zh: 美国司法部正在审查币安是否违反了其2023年和解协议的条款，此举可能使该交易所面临新一轮执法或额外的合规义务。
threads.latest_update_en: The U.S. Department of Justice is reviewing whether Binance violated the terms of its 2023 settlement agreement, a step that could expose the exchange to renewed enforcement or added compliance obligations.
threads.background_zh: 2023年的和解协议了结了针对币安的联邦指控，并要求该公司报告不当行为，并维持更严格的反洗钱与制裁违规管控措施。司法部此次审查的重点是币安在协议生效后是否遵守了这些要求。司法部刑事司负责人Tysen Duva表示，官员正在审查币安对2023年协议的遵守情况。此外，美国财政部海外资产控制办公室（OFAC）已因规避制裁对包括Nobitex在内的多家伊朗大型加密交易所实施制裁。
threads.background_en: The 2023 settlement resolved federal charges against Binance and required the company to report misconduct and maintain stronger controls against money laundering and sanctions violations. The DOJ review concerns whether Binance complied with those requirements after the agreement took effect. Tysen Duva, head of the DOJ's criminal division, said officials were reviewing Binance's compliance with the 2023 agreement. Separately, the U.S. Treasury's OFAC has sanctioned several of Iran's largest crypto exchanges, including Nobitex, over sanctions evasion.
threads.latest_summary_zh: The U.S. Department of Justice is reviewing whether Binance violated the terms of its 2023 settlement agreement, a step that could expose the exchange to renewed enforcement or added compliance obligations.
threads.latest_summary_en: The U.S. Department of Justice is reviewing whether Binance violated the terms of its 2023 settlement agreement, a step that could expose the exchange to renewed enforcement or added compliance obligations.
threads.market_impact_zh: 此次审查针对的是全球交易量最大的加密货币交易所，因此若事态升级至重启起诉或追加处罚，其影响将通过交易对手与托管风险、机构信心以及整体市场情绪传导，而非直接改变任何代币的基本面。目前该事项仍是未决调查，并未认定存在违规。
threads.market_impact_en: The review targets the world's largest crypto exchange by trading volume, so any escalation toward renewed prosecution or additional penalties would transmit through counterparty and custody risk, institutional confidence and broader market sentiment rather than through a direct change in any token's fundamentals. The outcome remains an open investigation, not a finding of a violation.

timeline.text_zh: 《华尔街日报》报道称，“Zanjani”网络利用币安向伊朗革命卫队转移了数亿美元，凸显该交易所面临的制裁规避风险。
timeline.text_en: The Wall Street Journal reports that the 'Zanjani' network moved hundreds of millions of dollars to Iran's Revolutionary Guard using Binance, spotlighting sanctions-evasion risks at the exchange.

timeline.text_zh: 币安的一项调查将伊朗制裁网络与8.5亿美元转账联系起来，引发了对该交易所规避制裁和合规问题的担忧。
timeline.text_en: A Binance investigation has connected an Iran sanctions network to $850 million in transfers, raising sanctions-evasion and compliance concerns for the exchange.

threads.title_zh: Bybit 推出美股与 ETF 交易并开发代币化股票产品 mStocks
threads.title_en: Bybit Expands Beyond Crypto With Direct Access to U.S. Stocks & ETFs
threads.summary_zh: Bybit Stocks 已正式上线，符合条件的用户可通过 Bybit 账户以 USDC 交易逾 1000 只美股及 ETF；Bybit CEO 宣布未来将支持股票抵押、借贷及券商转仓。
threads.summary_en: Bybit Stocks is live, letting eligible users trade over 1,000 US-listed stocks and ETFs with USDC; Bybit CEO announced future support for stock collateral, lending, and broker transfers.
threads.latest_update_zh: Bybit CEO Ben Zhou 宣布，Bybit 股票交易未来将支持股票作为交易抵押品、推出股票借贷服务，并支持从富途、Moomoo 等券商转仓。
threads.latest_update_en: Bybit CEO Ben Zhou announced that Bybit stock trading will in the future support stocks as trading collateral, offer stock lending services, and enable transfers in from brokers such as Futu and Moomoo.
threads.background_zh: Bybit的统一交易账户（UTA）是该平台的一体化账户模式，让交易者无需切换账户即可使用现货、现货杠杆、永续合约、期货与期权等产品。代币化股票——即以1:1资产背书、可在多条链上24小时交易的美股与ETF数字化代表——则成为将股票敞口引入加密平台的另一条相关但不同的路径。
threads.background_en: Bybit's Unified Trading Account is the venue's all-in-one account mode, giving traders access to spot, spot margin, perpetuals, futures and options without switching accounts. Tokenized equities — 1:1 backed digital representations of US stocks and ETFs tradable around the clock across chains — have become a related but distinct route for bringing equity exposure onto crypto venues.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Bybit launched Bybit Direct Stock, letting users hold and trade 1,000+ real US stocks inside its Unified Trading Account, with future plans to accept equities as collateral, offer stock lending, and enable transfers in from brokers such as Futu and Moomoo.
threads.latest_summary_en: Bybit launched Bybit Direct Stock, letting users hold and trade 1,000+ real US stocks inside its Unified Trading Account, with future plans to accept equities as collateral, offer stock lending, and enable transfers in from brokers such as Futu and Moomoo.
threads.market_impact_zh: 若股票最终可被接受为Bybit统一账户内的抵押品，保证金与清算动态可能在股票头寸与加密头寸之间相互传导，使加密订单簿与美国股票市场结构、以及DTC FOP等既有券商转仓与托管通道更直接地连接起来。由于抵押、借贷与转仓转入功能目前仍属已公布的后续计划，直接受影响的群体当前主要集中在Bybit自身的UTA用户。
threads.market_impact_en: If equities are eventually accepted as collateral inside Bybit's unified account, margin and liquidation dynamics could transmit between equity and crypto positions, linking crypto order books more directly to US equity market structure and to established brokerage transfer and custody rails such as DTC FOP. The immediate exposure is concentrated in Bybit's own UTA users, since the collateral, lending and transfer-in functions remain announced plans.

timeline.text_en: Bybit CEO Ben Zhou announced that Bybit stock trading will in the future support stocks as trading collateral, offer stock lending services, and enable transfers in from brokers such as Futu and Moomoo.

timeline.text_en: Bybit CEO Ben Zhou announced at a keynote that Bybit is developing mStocks, a tokenized stock product with Mantle, targeting launch next month with 1:1 real-stock backing, 24/7 conversion, DEX AMM trading on Mantle, and eligibility as collateral in Bybit's Unified Trading Account.

timeline.text_zh: Bybit Stocks 由此前宣布的扩展计划转为正式上线：符合条件的 KYC 用户在许可地区可用 USDC 交易逾 1000 只美国上市股票及 ETF，支持碎股、24/5 交易、零佣金及公司行动，订单由美国自清算经纪商 Alpaca 执行与托管，服务由受毛里求斯 FSC 监管的 Infra Capital Limited 提供。
timeline.text_en: Bybit Stocks moved from an announced expansion plan to a live launch: KYC-verified users in permitted jurisdictions can trade over 1,000 US-listed stocks and ETFs with USDC, with fractional shares, 24/5 trading, zero commission and corporate-action support, executed and custodied by US self-clearing broker Alpaca, with the service provided by Mauritius FSC-regulated Infra Capital Limited.

threads.title_zh: Coinbase 拓展传统金融与支付服务
threads.title_en: Coinbase Expands Traditional Finance and Payment Services
threads.summary_zh: Citi与Coinbase正在扩大合作，在现有法币-稳定币支付整合基础上，规划面向机构商户的稳定币收单产品，允许商户以法币结算而无需持有数字资产；全面可用时间和支持的代币尚未确定。
threads.summary_en: Citi and Coinbase are expanding their partnership, building on existing fiat-stablecoin payment integration to plan a stablecoin checkout product for institutional merchants that allows fiat settlement without holding digital assets; general availability and supported tokens remain unspecified.
threads.latest_update_zh: Citi披露了与Coinbase合作构建的稳定币收单产品计划，该产品使机构商户能够以法币结算而无需持有数字资产，并计划首先在美国推出。
threads.latest_update_en: Citi outlined plans for a stablecoin checkout product built with Coinbase that lets institutional merchants settle in fiat without holding digital assets, in a US-first expansion.
threads.background_zh: 此次公告建立在花旗与 Coinbase 既有的合作关系之上。与此同时，支付与加密基础设施公司正竞相把银行法币轨道与稳定币结算连接起来，例如 Fireblocks 于 9 月推出了覆盖 100 多个国家合规工具的“Network for Payments”。
threads.background_en: The announcement builds on an existing partnership between Citi and Coinbase. It comes as payment and crypto infrastructure firms race to connect bank fiat rails with stablecoin settlement; Fireblocks, for example, launched a "Network for Payments" with compliance tooling across more than 100 countries in September.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Citi outlined plans for a stablecoin checkout product built with Coinbase that lets institutional merchants settle in fiat without ever holding digital assets, in a US-first expansion.
threads.latest_summary_en: Citi outlined plans for a stablecoin checkout product built with Coinbase that lets institutional merchants settle in fiat without ever holding digital assets, in a US-first expansion.
threads.market_impact_zh: 其传导路径在于机构对稳定币的采用与银行结算渠道，而非代币供应或链上流动性：若此类银行合作规模扩大，稳定币发行方与支付类加密基础设施有望在主流结算量中占据更大份额；由于 Coinbase 是交易当事方，其上市股票直接暴露于该进展。实际影响取决于整合落地程度。
threads.market_impact_en: The transmission runs through institutional stablecoin adoption and banking settlement channels rather than through token supply or on-chain liquidity: stablecoin issuers and payment-focused crypto infrastructure stand to gain a larger share of mainstream settlement volume if such bank partnerships scale, while Coinbase's listed equity is directly exposed given it is a party to the deal. Any effect depends on how far the integration is actually implemented.

timeline.text_en: Citi institutional clients can now accept stablecoin payments through Spring by Citi using Coinbase payments infrastructure, and Coinbase Virtual Accounts can automatically convert incoming fiat into stablecoins via Citi's Virtual Account Wallet.

threads.title_zh: Coinbase 推进比特币托管的后量子密码学方案
threads.title_en: Coinbase Advances Post-Quantum Cryptography Plan for Bitcoin Custody
threads.summary_zh: Coinbase 已发布一项后量子准备提案，呼吁比特币立即采取行动，建议灵活的后量子签名、分阶段采用和备份量子安全密钥，并将休眠钱包处理问题分开讨论。该方案仍处于提案阶段，尚未部署。
threads.summary_en: Coinbase has published a post-quantum readiness proposal urging Bitcoin to act now, recommending flexible post-quantum signatures, staged adoption, and a backup quantum-proof key, while separating the dormant-wallet issue. The plan remains a proposal, not deployed.
threads.latest_update_zh: Coinbase 发布了一项提案，敦促比特币立即开始为量子计算做准备，建议采用灵活的后量子签名方案、分阶段采用、备份量子安全密钥，并将休眠或迁移延迟钱包的争议作为单独议题处理。
threads.latest_update_en: Coinbase published a proposal urging Bitcoin to begin preparing for quantum computers now, recommending flexible post-quantum signature schemes, staged adoption, a backup quantum-proof key, and treating dormant or late-migrating wallets as a separate debate.
threads.background_zh: 担忧的核心在于比特币如何保护钱包：足够强大的量子机器理论上可以从已暴露的公钥推导出私钥并转走资金，业内将这一假设性节点称为“Q-Day”。BIP-360 是首个针对抗量子签名的比特币改进提案，其设计允许新的后量子签名方案随时间替换，而无需整体重新设计。Coinbase 曾在今年 1 月召集量子顾问委员会，并于 7 月与贝莱德和 Strategy 一同加入比特币安全联盟，三方承诺合计投入 1500 万美元用于比特币的抗量子化。
threads.background_en: The concern centers on how Bitcoin secures wallets: a sufficiently powerful quantum machine could in theory derive a private key from an exposed public key and drain funds, a hypothetical milestone the industry calls "Q-Day." BIP-360 is the first Bitcoin Improvement Proposal tackling post-quantum signatures, proposing a design that would let new post-quantum signature schemes be swapped in over time without a full redesign. Coinbase convened a quantum advisory board in January and in July joined a Bitcoin Security Consortium alongside BlackRock and Strategy, pledging a combined $15 million toward quantum-proofing Bitcoin.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Coinbase published a proposal urging Bitcoin to begin preparing for quantum computers now, recommending flexible post-quantum signature schemes, staged adoption, a backup quantum-proof key, and treating the contentious question of dormant or late-migrating wallets as a separate debate so it does not stall broader protections.
threads.latest_summary_en: Coinbase published a proposal urging Bitcoin to begin preparing for quantum computers now, recommending flexible post-quantum signature schemes, staged adoption, a backup quantum-proof key, and treating the contentious question of dormant or late-migrating wallets as a separate debate so it does not stall broader protections.
threads.market_impact_zh: 最直接的传导渠道是托管与机构信心，而非价格：一家托管约 5% 比特币的机构公开提出签名灵活性议题，会影响大型持有者与托管服务商对长期密钥安全风险的评估，并把 BIP-360 及相关后量子提案推上比特币治理议程。而比特币签名方案的实际变更需节点运营者与矿工达成共识，因此并不意味着短期内对供应、发行或交易机制产生影响。
threads.market_impact_en: The immediate transmission channel is custody and institutional confidence rather than price: a custodian holding roughly 5% of BTC publicly flagging signature agility shapes how large holders and custody providers assess long-term key-security risk, and it puts BIP-360 and related post-quantum proposals on the agenda for Bitcoin's governance process. Any actual change to Bitcoin's signature scheme would require consensus among node operators and miners, so no near-term effect on supply, issuance or transaction mechanics is implied.

timeline.text_zh: Coinbase 首席密码学家 Yehuda Lindell 披露了后量子托管保障的更多细节，包括探索结合后量子阈值解密与可编程 HSM 的备用架构，以应对部分后量子签名方案可能不兼容 MPC 的问题。
timeline.text_en: Coinbase's head of cryptography Yehuda Lindell disclosed more details on post-quantum custody safeguards, including exploring a fallback architecture combining post-quantum threshold decryption with programmable HSMs to address potential non-MPC-friendly post-quantum signature schemes.

timeline.text_zh: Coinbase 提出推进比特币后量子就绪的步骤，以应对量子计算带来的未来安全威胁。
timeline.text_en: Coinbase outlines steps to advance Bitcoin's post-quantum readiness, addressing future security threats from quantum computing.

threads.title_zh: 菲律宾央行限制银行向主要加密平台Coins.ph转账
threads.title_en: Philippine Central Bank Curbs Bank Transfers to Major Crypto Platform Coins ph
threads.summary_zh: BSP 对 Coins.ph 的执法行动持续，可能吊销牌照；通过 DCPay Philippines 的存款限制仍在且非临时；合规高管离职增加了运营与监管压力。
threads.summary_en: BSP enforcement against Coins.ph continues with potential license revocation; deposit restrictions via DCPay Philippines remain and are not time-bound; compliance leadership departures add operational and regulatory pressure.
threads.latest_update_zh: 新报道补充称 Coins.ph 多名合规高管离职，包括首席合规官及反洗钱监控负责人，并披露其拥有超 1800 万用户、日现货交易量约 5000 万美元、控制菲律宾约 75%-80% 比索兑稳定币流动性。
threads.latest_update_en: New reporting adds that multiple Coins.ph compliance executives have departed, including the chief compliance officer and AML monitoring head, and discloses it has over 18 million users, about $50 million daily spot volume, and controls roughly 75%-80% of Philippine peso-to-stablecoin liquidity.
threads.background_zh: Coins.ph 是菲律宾最早的加密货币钱包和交易所之一，24小时现货交易量约为5000万美元，据称控制着该国约75%-80%的比索兑稳定币流动性；菲律宾是全球第四大汇款接收国。大约一年多前，BSP 收紧了对电子钱包应用用于赌博的管制，要求受其监管的机构切断应用内访问赌博网站的通道；据消息人士称，此后若干赌博实体迁移至 Coins.ph，而第三位知情人士表示，这也让这些公司获得加密货币和稳定币渠道，用于向离岸合作方付款。今年，该交易所多位知名合规人员离职，包括首席合规官 Lexi Herrera、反洗钱交易监控负责人 Chris Beaño 以及洗钱报告官 Irish Calagui。
threads.background_en: Coins.ph is one of the earliest crypto wallets and exchanges in the Philippines, has a 24-hour spot trading volume of about $50 million and reportedly controls some 75%-80% of peso-to-stablecoin liquidity in the country, the world's fourth-largest remittance recipient. A little over a year ago the BSP clamped down on the use of e-wallet apps for gambling, requiring supervised institutions to cut in-app access to gambling sites; several gambling entities then migrated to Coins.ph, according to the sources, which also gave them access to crypto and stablecoins for paying offshore partners, according to a third person. Several high-profile compliance staff left the exchange this year, including chief compliance officer Lexi Herrera, AML transaction monitoring head Chris Beaño and money laundering reporting officer Irish Calagui.
threads.latest_summary_zh: The Philippines' largest crypto exchange Coins.ph is facing BSP punitive measures — including possible license revocation — over allegations it served restricted offshore gambling firms, after the central bank already curtailed deposits via its main wallet operator DCPay Philippines.
threads.latest_summary_en: The Philippines' largest crypto exchange Coins.ph is facing BSP punitive measures — including possible license revocation — over allegations it served restricted offshore gambling firms, after the central bank already curtailed deposits via its main wallet operator DCPay Philippines.
threads.market_impact_zh: 该报道的核心是这一据称承载菲律宾大部分比索兑稳定币流量的平台的存款通道，因此 Coins.ph 与 DCPay Philippines 的任何存款或提现限制都会通过法币出入金与稳定币流动性渠道传导，并可能外溢至区域内其他交易所及每年约430亿美元的汇款通道。该报道基于匿名信源且监管行动尚未确认，因此相关风险敞口取决于是否会有正式执法公告。
threads.market_impact_en: The report centers on deposit access at a venue that reportedly handles the bulk of Philippine peso-to-stablecoin flow, so any limits on deposits or withdrawals through Coins.ph and DCPay Philippines would transmit through the fiat on/off-ramp and stablecoin liquidity channel, with possible spillover to regional exchanges and to the roughly $43 billion annual remittance corridor. The story rests on anonymous sourcing and unconfirmed regulatory action, so the exposure is contingent on whether any enforcement is formally announced.
