timeline.text_en: CoinDesk reports that BSP enforcement against Coins.ph is tied to serving restricted offshore gambling operators and could include license revocation; the DCPay Philippines deposit restrictions are reported as not time-bound, and neither BSP nor Coins.ph commented.

timeline.text_zh: 菲律宾中央银行部分暂停了向DCPay Philippines的InstaPay和PESONet入账银行转账，DCPay Philippines是当地领先加密平台Coins.ph的电子货币运营商，而转出转账以及单独持牌的Betur Inc.交易实体不受影响。
timeline.text_en: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas partially suspended inbound InstaPay and PESONet bank transfers to DCPay Philippines, the e-money operator of leading local crypto platform Coins.ph, while outbound transfers and the separately licensed Betur Inc. trading entity remain unaffected.

threads.title_zh: 加密硬件钱包遭攻击，估计损失7000万美元
threads.title_en: Crypto Hardware Wallets Hit in Estimated $70 Million Attack
threads.summary_zh: Ledger 硬件钱包被盗事件现已确认涉及供应链环节：授权经销商售出的设备被植入未授权模块，助记词可被截获并外传；行业对硬件钱包供应链与自托管安全保证的审查加剧。
threads.summary_en: The Ledger hardware-wallet loss incident is now confirmed to involve the supply chain: devices sold through an authorized reseller contained unauthorized implants that could capture and exfiltrate recovery phrases, intensifying scrutiny of hardware-wallet supply-chain and self-custody security guarantees.
threads.latest_update_zh: Ledger 确认通过授权经销商 CryptoBilis 售出的一台受影响设备含有未授权植入模块；这些恶意植入模块会截取用户助记词并通过蜂窝网络传输。Trezor 也宣布作为预防措施减少经销商数量。
threads.latest_update_en: Ledger confirmed that one affected device sold through authorized reseller CryptoBilis contained an unauthorized implant; the malicious implants captured users’ recovery phrases and transmitted them over cellular networks. Trezor also announced it would reduce resellers as a preventive step.
threads.latest_summary_zh: A Cointelegraph report, featuring hardware-security researcher Joe Grand, examines whether crypto users can realistically verify the integrity of hardware wallets after reported losses involving Ledger devices sold through authorized reseller CryptoBilis.
threads.latest_summary_en: A Cointelegraph report, featuring hardware-security researcher Joe Grand, examines whether crypto users can realistically verify the integrity of hardware wallets after reported losses involving Ledger devices sold through authorized reseller CryptoBilis.

timeline.text_zh: Ledger 确认通过授权经销商 CryptoBilis 售出的一台受影响设备含有未授权植入模块；这些恶意植入模块会截取用户助记词并通过蜂窝网络传输。Trezor 也宣布作为预防措施减少经销商数量。
timeline.text_en: Ledger confirmed that one affected device sold through authorized reseller CryptoBilis contained an unauthorized implant; the malicious implants captured users’ recovery phrases and transmitted them over cellular networks. Trezor also announced it would reduce resellers as a preventive step.

timeline.text_zh: Ledger报告称，加密货币硬件钱包在一场估计损失7000万美元的攻击中被盗空，引发了对自托管设备安全保证的担忧。
timeline.text_en: Ledger reported that cryptocurrency hardware wallets were drained in an attack estimated at $70 million, raising concerns about the security guarantees of self-custody devices.

threads.title_zh: Gemini 4 Argon：我们通往前沿智能的下一个时代
threads.title_en: Gemini 4 Argon: our next era of frontier intelligence
threads.summary_zh: Gemini 4 Argon 已从仅限可信网络安全团队的 Fairwind Program 阶段扩展到通过付费版 Gemini API 向全球开发者和企业开放，并可通过 Google AI Ultra 订阅使用；此前公布的 100 万 tokens 输出上限、定价与评测数据仍然有效。
threads.summary_en: Gemini 4 Argon has moved from the Fairwind Program-only phase for trusted cybersecurity teams to broad availability for developers and enterprises worldwide via the paid Gemini API and the Google AI Ultra subscription; previously reported details (1M token output limit, pricing, benchmark scores) remain in effect.
threads.latest_update_zh: 谷歌宣布通过付费版 Gemini API 向全球开发者和企业正式推出 Gemini 4 Argon，并同时开放 Google AI Ultra 订阅使用。这标志着此前受限的 Fairwind Program 首发阶段结束，进入面向开发者/企业的普遍可用阶段。
threads.latest_update_en: Google announced the general availability of Gemini 4 Argon through the paid Gemini API for developers and enterprises worldwide, as well as via the Google AI Ultra subscription. This marks the end of the earlier restricted Fairwind Program-only phase and the start of broad developer/enterprise access.
threads.background_zh: Argon 是谷歌 Gemini 旗舰系列的后续产品：Gemini 3 于 11 月发布，而 DeepMind 首席技术官 Koray Kavukcuoglu 担任新设立的谷歌首席 AI 架构师一职，职责是加快公司 AI 技术的产品化。“前沿模型”是产业与政策领域的术语，指处于当前通用人工智能能力最前沿或接近最前沿的模型，而非固定的技术类别。
threads.background_en: Argon arrives as the successor in Google's Gemini flagship line: Gemini 3 was released in November, and Koray Kavukcuoglu, DeepMind's chief technology officer, holds the newly created role of Google chief AI architect aimed at accelerating productization of the company's AI technology. "Frontier model" is an industry and policy term for a model at or near the current leading edge of general-purpose AI capability, rather than a fixed technical class.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Google launched Gemini 4 Argon globally through the paid Gemini API and its Google AI Ultra subscription, making the new frontier model available to developers and enterprises.
threads.latest_summary_en: Google launched Gemini 4 Argon globally through the paid Gemini API and its Google AI Ultra subscription, making the new frontier model available to developers and enterprises.
threads.discussion_zh: Hacker News 上的评论意见不一。一些人对受限的发布方式提出批评，指出非 Flash 模型再次对普通订阅用户无限期不可用，并质疑付费档位的价值；也有人认为各实验室之间的持续交替领先，削弱了“AI 是赢者通吃、先发优势永不丢失”这一与 Anthropic 的 Dario Amodei 相关的看法。另有用户描述了一次 Gemini 3.8 Flash 的使用经历：该模型将 GDB 附加到 GPU 驱动、逆向内核队列 ioctl 接口，并编写 LD_PRELOAD 垫片，使 ROCm 版 llama.cpp 在 Strix Halo 机器上运行起来。
threads.discussion_en: Commenters on Hacker News were divided. Several criticized the restricted rollout, noting that a non-Flash model is again unavailable to regular subscribers for an indefinite period and questioning the value of paid tiers, while one argued the steady leapfrogging between labs undercuts the idea — associated with Anthropic's Dario Amodei — that AI is a winner-takes-all field where an early lead is never ceded. Another user described a Gemini 3.8 Flash session in which the model attached GDB to a GPU driver, reverse-engineered a kernel queue ioctl interface and wrote an LD_PRELOAD shim to get ROCm llama.cpp working on a Strix Halo machine.
threads.market_impact_zh: 与加密市场相关的传导渠道主要是情绪面，而非公告披露的任何集成：大型实验室发布前沿模型往往会推动围绕 AI 相关代币和去中心化算力代币的叙事，尽管该公告本身并未披露与加密市场在托管、流动性、上币或监管方面的任何关联。任何影响都将通过交易者在这类 AI 主题板块上的仓位体现，而非通过目前仍受限的 Gemini 4 Argon 本身的可获得性。
threads.market_impact_en: The crypto-relevant transmission channel is sentiment rather than any disclosed integration: frontier-model releases from major labs tend to feed narratives around AI-adjacent and decentralized compute tokens, even though the announcement itself discloses no custody, liquidity, listing or regulatory linkage to crypto markets. Any effect would run through trader positioning on those AI-themed segments rather than through Gemini 4 Argon's own availability, which remains restricted.

This marks the end of the earlier restricted Fairwind Program-only phase and the start of broad developer/enterprise access.

timeline.text_zh: 新报道补充了 Gemini 4 Argon 的关键细节：单次输出上限从 64K tokens 提升至 100 万 tokens；首批仅通过 Fairwind Program 向可信网络安全团队开放，后续再逐步开放给付费 API 客户和 Google AI Ultra 用户；API 上线初期按每百万输入 tokens 2 美元、输出 10 美元收费，之后价格翻倍至 4 美元和 20 美元；在 DeepSWE v1.1 得 77.9%，领先 GPT-6 Astra 的 74.1% 和 Claude Opus 5.5 的 74.2%，但在 FrontierSWE、Terminal-Bench 4.0 和部分科学任务上仍落后；网络安全能力被重点强化，可信防御团队版本会取消部分网络安全限制，同时谷歌仍在测试滥用、提示词注入和 Agent 越界等风险。
timeline.text_en: The new report adds key details about Gemini 4 Argon: its single-pass output limit jumps from 64K tokens to 1 million tokens; initial access is only through the Fairwind Program to trusted cybersecurity teams, with later rollout to paid API customers and Google AI Ultra users; API pricing starts at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, later doubling to $4 and $20; it scores 77.9% on DeepSWE v1.1, ahead of GPT-6 Astra's 74.1% and Claude Opus 5.5's 74.2%, but still trails on FrontierSWE, Terminal-Bench 4.0 and some scientific tasks; cybersecurity capabilities are emphasized, with trusted defender versions removing some cyber restrictions, while Google continues testing abuse, prompt injection and agent boundary risks.

timeline.text_zh:
谷歌发布了其新一代前沿 AI 模型 Gemini 4 Argon。谷歌首席 AI 架构师、Google DeepMind 高级副总裁 Koray Kavukcuoglu 表示，该模型在“真实软件工程、法律与金融等企业知识工作，以及网络安全防御等复杂工作流中提供前沿性能”。谷歌目前限制该模型的访问权限，称将继续从早期测试者处收集反馈并迭代护栏机制，之后再向开发者、企业和消费者开放 Argon。

该发布使顶级实验室之间的竞争再添一款旗舰模型，但访问权限仍受限——开发者、企业和消费者目前尚不能普遍使用，谷歌给出的理由是仍在完善护栏机制并收集早期测试者反馈。

谷歌称 Argon 在编程、推理和多模态方面具备能力，并能在企业工作流中持续完成长链条、多步骤任务。Hacker News 评论者引用公告称，Argon 智能体正在谷歌内部将 C/C++ 代码库迁移至 Rust；独立评测机构 Artificial Analysis 将 Gemini 4 Argon（High）列为智能水平领先的模型之一，且相对于同等价位的模型定价合理。
timeline.text_en:
Google unveiled Gemini 4 Argon, its next frontier AI model, which the company says delivers "frontier performance in complex workflows across real-world software engineering, enterprise knowledge work like legal and finance, and cybersecurity defense," according to chief AI architect and Google DeepMind SVP Koray Kavukcuoglu. Google is limiting access to the model for now, saying it will keep gathering feedback from early testers as it iterates on guardrails before making Argon available to developers, enterprises and consumers.

The announcement puts a new flagship model into the top-lab competition, but access remains restricted — developers, enterprises and consumers cannot yet use it generally, with Google citing continued work on guardrails and feedback from early testers as the reason.

Google describes Argon's capabilities across coding, reasoning and multimodality, and its ability to sustain long, multi-step tasks in enterprise workflows. Hacker News commenters quoted the announcement as saying Argon agents are working on migrating C/C++ codebases to Rust across Google; independent evaluator Artificial Analysis rates Gemini 4 Argon (High) as among the leading models in intelligence and reasonably priced relative to models at a similar price point.

threads.title_zh: BNY与Citadel Securities测试代币化美国国债，以加速华尔街融资
threads.title_en: BNY, Citadel Securities test tokenized U.S. Treasuries to speed up Wall Street financing
threads.summary_zh: BNY与Citadel Securities已完成主要三方回购平台上首笔使用代币化资产的三方回购，使用2年期美国国债代币化版本作为抵押品，在BNY私有数字账本上数分钟内完成交割并进入隔夜三方回购融资。BNY计划增加数字现金和代币化存款能力，并拟于明年将相关结算平台运行时间扩展至欧洲与亚洲交易时段。
threads.summary_en: BNY and Citadel Securities have completed the first tri-party repo on a major platform using a tokenized asset, using a tokenized 2-year U.S. Treasury as collateral, settling in minutes on BNY's private digital ledger and moving into overnight tri-party repo financing. BNY plans to add digital cash and tokenized deposit capabilities and aims to extend related settlement platform hours to European and Asian trading sessions next year.
threads.latest_update_zh: 新报道明确该交易是主要三方回购平台上首笔使用代币化资产的三方回购：Citadel Securities经BNY在Tradeweb买入一只2年期美国国债，BNY在其私有数字账本上记录代币化版本并在数分钟内完成交割，随后Citadel将该代币化国债作为隔夜三方回购抵押品从BNY获得现金。
threads.latest_update_en: The new report specifies the transaction was the first tri-party repo on a major platform using a tokenized asset: Citadel Securities bought a 2-year U.S. Treasury via BNY on Tradeweb, BNY recorded a tokenized version on its private digital ledger and settled in minutes, then Citadel used the tokenized Treasury as collateral for an overnight tri-party repo to obtain cash from BNY.
threads.background_zh: 华尔街一直在探索将传统资产引入区块链，贝莱德、富兰克林邓普顿和摩根大通等机构已采用代币化基金和证券，押注该技术能够缩短结算时间、实现流程自动化并让资产更易流转。BNY本身也在布局数字资产基础设施，包括为USDC稳定币提供托管和发行支持，并表示计划将支持范围扩展至其他稳定币发行方和数字现金服务。代币化美国国债是政府债务（如短期国库券）的区块链化表示形式。
threads.background_en: Wall Street has been exploring bringing traditional assets onto blockchains, with firms including BlackRock, Franklin Templeton and JPMorgan embracing tokenized funds and securities on bets the technology can shorten settlement times, automate processes and make assets easier to move. BNY has separately moved into digital asset infrastructure, including custody and issuance support for the USDC stablecoin, and has said it plans to extend support to other stablecoin issuers and digital cash services. Tokenized U.S. Treasuries are blockchain-based representations of government debt such as short-term Treasury bills.
threads.latest_summary_zh: BNY and Citadel Securities completed the first tri-party repo on a major platform using a tokenized 2-year US Treasury as collateral, settling in minutes via BNY's private digital ledger, with BNY planning digital cash and extended global settlement hours.
threads.latest_summary_en: BNY and Citadel Securities completed the first tri-party repo on a major platform using a tokenized 2-year US Treasury as collateral, settling in minutes via BNY's private digital ledger, with BNY planning digital cash and extended global settlement hours.
threads.market_impact_zh: 这笔交易属于代币化现实世界资产与抵押品领域：如果代币化国债能够在结算与融资通道之间流转，就可能触及回购和三方交易中的抵押品流动，而这些环节正使用USDC等数字现金工具进行结算，这也是大型托管机构和稳定币发行方正在建设的通道。上述计划仍处于试点阶段，并取决于BNY能否扩展数字现金服务和结算时间。
threads.market_impact_en: The transaction sits in the tokenized real-world asset and collateral segment: if tokenized Treasuries can move between settlement and financing rails, they could touch repo and triparty collateral flows where USDC and other digital cash instruments are used for settlement, a channel that large custodians and stablecoin issuers are already building toward. The described plans remain pilot-stage and depend on BNY extending digital cash services and settlement hours.

timeline.text_en: The new report specifies the transaction was the first tri-party repo on a major platform using a tokenized asset: Citadel Securities bought a 2-year U.S. Treasury via BNY on Tradeweb, BNY recorded a tokenized version on its private digital ledger and settled in minutes, then Citadel used the tokenized Treasury as collateral for an overnight tri-party repo to obtain cash from BNY.

timeline.text_zh:
被称为全球最大托管银行的BNY与交易巨头Citadel Securities周二表示，双方已完成一笔使用代币化美国国债的交易，展示基于区块链的政府债券如何从结算环节进入融资环节。BNY还表示计划增加数字现金和代币化存款能力，并延长其面向美联储合格证券及美国三方交易的既有结算系统的运营时间，目标是在明年覆盖欧洲和亚洲交易时段。

该尝试针对的是金融市场的一个关键瓶颈：作为交易和借贷抵押品的政府债券在账户与结算系统之间转移需要时间，从而占用本可另作他用的资产。Citadel Securities数字资产业务运营负责人Dan Doherty表示，高质量抵押品的高效流转是市场良好运行的基础，减少交易生命周期中的延迟可以改善机构市场的运作方式。

这笔交易旨在演示代币化政府债券如何从结算进入融资环节，从而可能让机构更早地重复使用抵押品，并释放现金用于其他交易。BNY首席创新与市场转型官Carolyn Weinberg表示，在结算和融资两个环节都使用美国国债的代币化表示，可以实现一个更互联、更高效、全天候运行的金融体系。
timeline.text_en:
BNY, described as the world's largest custody bank, and trading firm Citadel Securities said on Tuesday they had completed a transaction using tokenized U.S. Treasuries, showing how blockchain-based government bonds could move from settlement into financing. BNY also said it plans to add digital cash and tokenized deposit capabilities and to extend the operating hours of its traditional settlement systems for Federal Reserve-eligible securities and U.S. triparty transactions, with the aim of reaching European and Asian trading hours next year.

The effort targets a key bottleneck in financial markets: moving government bonds used as collateral for trading and borrowing can take time, tying up assets that could otherwise be put to work. Citadel Securities digital assets operations lead Dan Doherty said efficient movement of high-quality collateral is fundamental to well-functioning markets and that reducing delays across the trade lifecycle could improve how institutional markets operate.

The transaction was a demonstration of how tokenized government bonds could move from settlement into financing, potentially letting firms reuse collateral sooner and free up cash for other trades. BNY chief innovation and market transformation officer Carolyn Weinberg said using a tokenized representation of a U.S. Treasury across both settlement and financing enables a more connected, efficient and always-on financial system.

threads.title_zh: 【Polygon Labs 已完成对 Coinme 的收购】

threads.summary_zh: Polygon Labs 已完成对 Coinme 的收购，其 Polygon Open Money Stack（OMS）成为受美国监管的支付平台，覆盖 48 个州，持有 37 张州级货币转账牌照、11 项豁免资格，并在 FinCEN 注册为 MSB。
threads.summary_en: Polygon Labs completed its acquisition of Coinme, making its Polygon Open Money Stack (OMS) a US-regulated payments platform covering 48 states, holding 37 state money transmitter licenses, 11 exemptions, and FinCEN MSB registration.
threads.latest_update_zh: 新增监管覆盖细节：OMS 已覆盖美国 48 个州，持有 37 张州级货币转账牌照、11 项豁免资格，并在 FinCEN 注册为货币服务业务机构。
threads.latest_update_en: Added regulatory coverage details: OMS covers 48 US states with 37 state money transmitter licenses, 11 exemptions, and FinCEN MSB registration.
threads.background_zh: Polygon Labs 将 Open Money Stack 描述为一套垂直整合的链上支付解决方案，涵盖区块链底层、稳定币调度、钱包基础设施、入金与出金、互操作性、合规及链上身份等环节。Coinme 是一家持牌并受监管的数字货币交易所和比特币自助终端运营商，可提供现金入口。货币转账牌照是州级颁发的、代表可代客户转移资金的许可，FinCEN 注册则是联邦层面的货币服务业务登记。
threads.background_en: Polygon's Open Money Stack is described by Polygon Labs as a vertically integrated suite of on-chain payment solutions spanning blockchain rails, stablecoin orchestration, wallet infrastructure, on-ramps and off-ramps, interoperability, compliance, and on-chain identity. Coinme is a licensed and regulated digital currency exchange and Bitcoin kiosk operator, which adds cash-based access points. Money transmitter licenses are state-issued permissions required to transmit funds on behalf of customers, while FinCEN registration is a federal money services business registration.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Polygon Labs completed its acquisition of Coinme, turning its Polygon Open Money Stack into a US-regulated payments platform covering 48 states with 37 state money transmitter licenses, 11 exemptions, and FinCEN MSB registration.
threads.latest_summary_en: Polygon Labs completed its acquisition of Coinme, turning its Polygon Open Money Stack into a US-regulated payments platform covering 48 states with 37 state money transmitter licenses, 11 exemptions, and FinCEN MSB registration.
threads.market_impact_zh: 此次收购让具备美国州级牌照的法币入金与出金基础设施与基于 Polygon 的稳定币及支付流程直接打通，因此受影响最明显的渠道是支付企业所面对的监管与托管准入，以及其美元链上结算路径，而非协议机制或代币供给的变化。相关敞口集中于依赖合规法币兑换的稳定币通道和构建在 Polygon 上的支付类应用。
threads.market_impact_en: The acquisition gives fiat on-ramp and off-ramp infrastructure with US state licensing a direct connection to Polygon-based stablecoin and payment flows, so the channel most affected is regulatory and custody access for payments firms and their USD on-chain settlement, rather than a change in protocol mechanics or token supply. Exposure concentrates in stablecoin rails and payment-focused applications built on Polygon that rely on regulated fiat conversion.

threads.title_zh: Character.AI申请破产：创始人回归谷歌、CEO转投迪士尼，平台面临关停
threads.title_en: Character.AI申请破产：创始人回归谷歌、CEO转投迪士尼，平台面临关停
threads.summary_zh: Character.AI 于10月12日申请 Chapter 11 破产保护，迪士尼提出2000万美元初始报价，仅涉及部分知识产权的永久非独家授权而非平台本身；平台尚未关停，公司预计11月底至12月初完成出售，若找不到愿意继续运营的买家将停止服务。
threads.summary_en: Character.AI filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection on October 12, with Disney submitting a $20 million initial bid covering only perpetual non-exclusive licensing of some IP rather than the platform itself. The platform has not yet shut down, the company expects to complete the sale between late November and early December, and it will stop service if no buyer willing to keep operating it is found.
threads.latest_update_zh: 新增：公司预计在11月底至12月初完成出售；平台目前尚未关停，并称若找不到愿意继续运营的买家将停止服务；前CEO Karandeep Anand已于10月2日加入迪士尼任CTO，部分技术员工随之转投，并在出售期间暂时帮助维持平台运营。
threads.latest_update_en: Added: the company expects to complete the sale between late November and early December; the platform has not yet shut down and will stop if no buyer willing to keep operating it is found; former CEO Karandeep Anand joined Disney as CTO on October 2, with some technical staff moving with him and temporarily helping keep the platform running during the sale.
threads.background_zh: Character.AI由Transformer论文作者之一Noam Shazeer与前谷歌研究员Daniel De Freitas创办；其应用在2023年上线不到一周便获得约170万次安装，公司完成1.5亿美元融资，估值达10亿美元。2024年，谷歌以27亿美元获得Character.AI大模型技术的非独家授权，并招走两位创始人及约20%的员工，此后Character.AI放弃与科技巨头竞争前沿大模型，转而专注聊天产品。此后平台因涉嫌伤害未成年人面临多起诉讼，搜索结果显示其在2026年1月与谷歌就五起相关诉讼达成和解。
threads.background_en: Character.AI was founded by Noam Shazeer, a co-author of the Transformer paper, and former Google researcher Daniel De Freitas; its app drew about 1.7 million installs within a week of its 2023 launch, and the company raised $150 million at a $1 billion valuation. In 2024, Google paid $2.7 billion for a non-exclusive license to Character.AI's model technology and hired the two founders plus roughly 20% of staff, after which Character.AI dropped frontier-model competition to focus on its chat product. The company later faced lawsuits over harm to minors, and search results indicate it agreed with Google in January 2026 to settle five such suits.
threads.latest_summary_zh:
上线约五年后，Character.AI于10月12日在美国申请Chapter 11破产保护，迪士尼对其部分资产提出2000万美元的初始报价。公司预计在11月底至12月初完成出售。

平台目前尚未关停，但公司表示如果找不到愿意继续运营的买家，服务就会停止；已有用户开始询问如何保存自己与AI角色持续数年的聊天记录。

迪士尼的初始报价只涉及Character.AI部分知识产权的永久非独家授权等权益，并未承诺接手整个平台。Character.AI前CEO Karandeep Anand已于10月2日加入迪士尼出任首席技术官，部分技术员工也随之转投迪士尼，这些离职员工正帮助平台在出售期间短暂维持运营。
threads.latest_summary_en:
Character.AI filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in the United States on October 12, roughly five years after launch, and Disney has submitted a $20 million initial bid for some of its assets. The company expects to complete the sale between late November and early December.

The platform has not shut down yet, but the company says it will stop service if no buyer is found to keep operating it, and users have already begun asking how to preserve chat histories with their AI characters that span several years.

Disney's initial offer covers only a perpetual, non-exclusive license to some of Character.AI's intellectual property and related rights, and the entertainment company has not committed to taking over the whole platform. Character.AI's former CEO Karandeep Anand joined Disney as chief technology officer on October 2, with some technical staff moving with him; those departed employees are helping keep Character.AI running temporarily during the sale process.

threads.title_zh: 【Metaplanet 拟发行约 3.33 亿美元零息可转债，用于还款及回购股票】
threads.title_en: 【Metaplanet 拟发行约 3.33 亿美元零息可转债，用于还款及回购股票】
threads.summary_zh: Metaplanet 拟发行约520亿日元（约3.28亿美元）2031年到期的零息可转债，净收益中约1.49亿美元用于偿还比特币抵押贷款、约1.79亿美元用于股票回购，并启动最高3.8亿美元的回购计划；不会出售BTC，贷款与BTCNAV比率约17.7%，仍高于10%目标。此外，CEO Simon Gerovich 将以0.75%年利率出借最多5500万股个人持股以优化债券发行条件；8月18日宣布的对Super League Enterprise（SLE）的投资预计很快完成，交易完成后SLE计划更名为Superplanet, Inc.。
threads.summary_en: Metaplanet is issuing ~¥52B (~$328M) of 2031-maturity zero-coupon convertible bonds, with ~$149M of net proceeds to repay Bitcoin-collateralized loans and ~$179M for share buybacks under a new up to $380M repurchase program; no BTC holdings will be sold, and its loan-to-BTCNAV ratio of ~17.7% remains above its 10% target. Additionally, CEO Simon Gerovich will lend up to 55 million personal shares at 0.75% annual interest to optimize bond issuance conditions; the August 18 announced investment in Super League Enterprise (SLE) is expected to complete soon, after which SLE plans to rename to Superplanet, Inc.

threads.summary_zh: OffMarket 已向公众开放，允许 Polymarket 用户通过 Starknet 上的非托管零知识隐私池隐匿仓位与账户关联，每账户存款上限 1000 USDC，合约经审计和形式化验证，池规模约 150 万美元/1.7 万笔存款；非 Polymarket 官方产品，属 Builder 计划，有地理限制和美国用户禁令。
threads.summary_en: OffMarket is open to the public, allowing Polymarket users to obscure the link between positions and accounts via a non-custodial zero-knowledge privacy pool on Starknet, with a 1,000 USDC per-account deposit cap, audited and formally verified contracts, and a pool size of about $1.5M / 17k deposits; it is not an official Polymarket product, part of the Builder program, and subject to geographic restrictions including a U.S. ban.
threads.latest_update_zh: OffMarket 已向公众开放（此前自8月起小范围试用），基于 Starknet 零知识共享隐私池；合约经 OpenZeppelin 审计并完成形式化验证；目前每账户存款上限 1000 USDC，池内约 150 万美元、1.7 万笔存款；服务非 Polymarket 官方产品，属其验证 Builder 计划，沿用地理限制包括禁止美国用户；独立合规机构 Financial Privacy Inc. 保管主查看密钥用于制裁筛查及合法披露。
threads.latest_update_en: OffMarket is now open to the public (following a limited trial since August), based on a Starknet zero-knowledge shared privacy pool; contracts audited by OpenZeppelin and formally verified; current deposit cap of 1,000 USDC per account, with about $1.5M and 17k deposits in the pool; not an official Polymarket product, part of its verified Builder program, subject to geographic restrictions including a U.S. ban; independent compliance firm Financial Privacy Inc. holds the master viewing key for sanctions screening and lawful disclosure.
threads.latest_summary_zh: StarkWare opened its OffMarket privacy service to the public, letting Polymarket users trade via a non-custodial zero-knowledge pool on Starknet that obscures the link between positions and existing accounts, under a 1,000 USDC per-account deposit cap with OpenZeppelin-audited and formally verified contracts.

timeline.text_zh: StarkWare推出OffMarket，这是一项非托管隐私服务，允许Polymarket用户在不公开将其持仓与账户关联的情况下进行交易，初期每个账户上限为1000 USDC。
timeline.text_en: StarkWare launched OffMarket, a non-custodial privacy service that lets Polymarket users trade without publicly linking their holdings to their accounts, initially capped at 1000 USDC per account.

threads.title_zh: Blur 宣布关闭网站前端并停止匹配新 Blend 贷款
threads.title_en: Blur to Shut Down Website Frontend and Stop Matching New Blend Loans
threads.summary_zh: Blur宣布将于11月12日关闭其网站前端，并停止Blend匹配新的NFT贷款，此举引发收藏者的欢呼，他们认为其免版税模式和代币激励损害了NFT市场。
threads.summary_en: Blur announced it will shut down its website frontend on Nov. 12 and stop Blend from matching new NFT loans, prompting cheers from collectors who blame its royalty-free model and token incentives for damaging the NFT market.
threads.latest_update_zh: Blur宣布将于11月12日关闭其网站前端，并停止Blend匹配新的NFT贷款，此举引发收藏者的欢呼，他们认为其免版税模式和代币激励损害了NFT市场。
threads.latest_update_en: Blur announced it will shut down its website frontend on Nov. 12 and stop Blend from matching new NFT loans, prompting cheers from collectors who blame its royalty-free model and token incentives for damaging the NFT market.
threads.background_zh: Blur 是 2022 年 10 月在以太坊上推出的去中心化 NFT 交易市场与聚合器，主打零市场手续费，面向专业和高频交易者。Blend 于 2023 年 5 月推出，是一种点对点的永续 NFT 借贷协议，不依赖预言机、没有到期日，借款头寸可无限期持有直至被清算，利率由市场决定。
threads.background_en: Blur is a decentralized NFT marketplace and aggregator launched in October 2022 on Ethereum, aimed at professional and high-volume traders with zero marketplace fees. Blend, introduced in May 2023, is a peer-to-peer perpetual NFT lending protocol with no oracle dependencies and no expiries, allowing borrowing positions to remain open indefinitely until liquidated, with market-determined interest rates.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Blur announced it will shut down its website frontend on Nov. 12 and stop Blend from matching new NFT loans, prompting cheers from collectors who blame its royalty-free model and token incentives for damaging the NFT market.
threads.latest_summary_en: Blur announced it will shut down its website frontend on Nov. 12 and stop Blend from matching new NFT loans, prompting cheers from collectors who blame its royalty-free model and token incentives for damaging the NFT market.
threads.market_impact_zh: 即时反应集中在 BLUR 上：据币安数据，其 24 小时下跌 16.55%，价格约为 0.01523 USDT。风险敞口主要落在 BLUR 持有者，以及抵押品或贷款条款与 Blend 绑定的 NFT 持有者身上——撮合业务关停使这一借贷场所消失，而链上交易市场协议和费率开关仍在运行；除 NFT 板块之外，来源未提及更直接的传导渠道。
threads.market_impact_en: The immediate reaction was concentrated in BLUR, which fell 16.55% over 24 hours to about 0.01523 USDT on Binance. Exposure sits with BLUR holders and NFT holders whose collateral or loan terms are tied to Blend, since the wind-down of matching removes that lending venue while the on-chain marketplace protocol and fee switch continue to operate; the source describes no direct transmission channel beyond the NFT sector.

timeline.text_zh: 新增背景数据与关联事件：Blur月交易量从2023年3月约14.3亿美元峰值暴跌超99%至2026年3月不足700万美元；过去三年协议收入为零；Blur关闭紧随姊妹项目Blast于10月2日宣布关闭；BLUR跌超20%。
timeline.text_en: Added background data and related event: Blur's monthly trading volume collapsed over 99% from about $1.43B in March 2023 to under $7M in March 2026; zero protocol revenue over the past three years; the shutdown follows sister project Blast's Oct. 2 closure announcement; BLUR fell over 20%.

timeline.text_zh:
Blur 宣布将于 2026 年 11 月 12 日关闭其前端，其链上交易市场协议将继续运行，BLUR 仍将继续控制该协议的费率开关（fee switch）。其 NFT 借贷协议 Blend 将在同一天停止撮合新的贷款，借款人须在此日期前还款，否则将面临违约。

持有未平仓头寸的 Blend 借款人面临还款或违约的硬性截止期限，NFT 借贷市场也将失去其贷款撮合场所。Blur 表示随后将提供一个前端工具，供用户从 Blend 中提取资产。

公告发布后，据币安数据，BLUR 一度下探至 0.01410 USDT，随后回升至 0.01523 USDT，24 小时跌幅达 16.55%。Blur 曾于 2022 年 3 月完成 1100 万美元种子轮融资，投资方包括 Paradigm、eGirl Capital 和 0xMaki。
timeline.text_en:
Blur announced that it will shut down its frontend on November 12, 2026, while its on-chain marketplace protocol will remain operational and BLUR will continue to control the protocol's fee switch. Its NFT lending protocol, Blend, will stop matching new loans on the same date, and borrowers have until then to repay their loans or allow them to default.

Blend borrowers with open positions face a hard deadline to repay or default, and the NFT lending market loses the venue that matched its loans. Blur said it will subsequently provide a frontend tool for users to withdraw their assets from Blend.

Following the announcement, BLUR fell to a low of 0.01410 USDT before recovering to 0.01523 USDT, down 16.55% over 24 hours according to Binance data. Blur raised $11 million in a seed round in March 2022, with investors including Paradigm, eGirl Capital and 0xMaki.

threads.title_zh: Meta发布Muse Wonder与Muse Wonder Full前沿AI模型
threads.title_en: Meta releases Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full frontier AI models
threads.summary_zh: Meta已于2026年10月12日发布Muse Wonder与Muse Wonder Full，二者具备100万token上下文窗口，并引入Active Memory与Active Focus能力；Muse Wonder通过Meta Model API与Muse Code上线，标准版每百万输入token收费4美元，Muse Wonder Full仅面向Muse Code每月50美元或200美元订阅档。Meta自称迈向“个人超级智能”，自评基准领先GPT-6 Astra与Claude Opus 5.5；但Artificial Analysis独立评分显示Wonder Full为56、Wonder为52，高于Fable 5.1与Astra的53，仍低于Opus 5.5的58，且Abacus.AI的Bindu Reddy质疑其性能。
threads.summary_en: Meta released Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full on 2026-10-12 with a 1 million token context window and new Active Memory and Active Focus capabilities; Muse Wonder is live via Meta Model API and Muse Code, with standard Wonder charging $4 per million input tokens, while Muse Wonder Full is limited to Muse Code's $50 or $200 monthly subscription tiers. Meta calls it a step toward 'personal superintelligence' and its own benchmarks put the models ahead of GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5, but independent Artificial Analysis scores show Wonder Full at 56 and Wonder at 52, above Fable 5.1 and Astra at 53 yet below Opus 5.5 at 58, with Abacus.AI's Bindu Reddy challenging the performance claims.
threads.latest_update_zh: 新报道补充了Muse Wonder与Muse Wonder Full发布后的更多细节：两款模型引入Active Memory与Active Focus能力；Artificial Analysis独立评分显示Muse Wonder Full为56、Muse Wonder为52，高于Claude Fable 5.1与GPT-6 Astra的53，但低于Claude Opus 5.5的58；Abacus.AI的Bindu Reddy质疑Muse Wonder表现；标准版Wonder每百万输入token收费4美元，Wonder Full仅限Muse Code每月50美元或200美元订阅档。
threads.latest_update_en: New reporting adds more post-launch details for Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full: the models introduce Active Memory and Active Focus capabilities; Artificial Analysis independent scores show Muse Wonder Full at 56 and Muse Wonder at 52, above Claude Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra at 53 but below Claude Opus 5.5 at 58; Abacus.AI's Bindu Reddy challenged Muse Wonder's performance; standard Wonder charges $4 per million input tokens, and Wonder Full is limited to Muse Code's $50 or $200 monthly subscription tiers.
threads.background_zh: Meta 在开源模型 Llama 4 于独立测试中表现不佳后，于 2025 年成立了 Meta Superintelligence Labs，此前其以约 140 亿美元收购 Scale AI 的股份，并由该公司创始人 Alexandr Wang 领导这一新部门。该部门的首个模型 Muse Spark 于 2026 年早些时候发布，是一款小而快的闭源模型。Muse Wonder 的问世距 OpenAI 于 9 月 3 日发布 GPT-6 Astra、Anthropic 于 9 月 22 日发布 Claude Opus 5.5 仅数周。
threads.background_en: Meta formed Meta Superintelligence Labs in 2025 after its open-source Llama 4 models stumbled in independent tests, following a roughly $14 billion deal for Scale AI that put founder Alexandr Wang in charge of the unit. The group's first model, Muse Spark, launched earlier in 2026 as a small, fast, closed model. Muse Wonder arrives weeks after OpenAI shipped GPT-6 Astra on September 3 and Anthropic followed on September 22 with Claude Opus 5.5.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Meta unveiled the Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full AI models, claiming they rival OpenAI and Anthropic offerings and marking a step toward 'personal superintelligence,' with independent scores placing the top model near but not at the head of the frontier leaderboard.
threads.latest_summary_en: Meta unveiled the Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full AI models, claiming they rival OpenAI and Anthropic offerings and marking a step toward 'personal superintelligence,' with independent scores placing the top model near but not at the head of the frontier leaderboard.
threads.market_impact_zh: 直接传导渠道是对前沿推理定价的压力：Meta 以每百万 token 4 美元/20 美元与 Claude Opus 5.5 持平，并低于 GPT-6 Astra 的 10 美元/50 美元，这影响的是竞争实验室的 API 收入经济性，而非直接涉及任何加密资产。对加密市场的传导则经由市场情绪——Meta 跻身前沿实验室的定位会强化更广泛的 AI 资本支出与风险偏好叙事，这类叙事通常会让高贝塔的科技相关代币与其他风险资产一同波动。
threads.market_impact_en: The direct channel is pricing pressure on frontier inference: Meta is matching Claude Opus 5.5 at $4/$20 per million tokens and undercutting GPT-6 Astra's $10/$50, which affects the API revenue economics of competing labs rather than any crypto asset directly. The read-through to crypto markets runs through sentiment — Meta's positioning as a frontier lab feeds the broader AI capex and risk-appetite narrative that typically moves high-beta technology-linked tokens alongside other risk assets.

timeline.text_en: Meta launched two new AI models, Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, from its Superintelligence Labs, claiming they can compete with the industry's leading models.

threads.title_zh: OpenAI发布GPT-6系列模型并推进产品更新
threads.title_en: OpenAI releases GPT-6 family models and rolls out product updates
threads.summary_zh: OpenAI 在 28 天产品冲刺第 4 天将 GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast 推向 API、Codex 和 ChatGPT Work，Codex 生成速度最高达标准模式 8 倍，API 定价为标准档 6 倍；Codex 还新增任务执行中途实时纠偏能力。
threads.summary_en: On Day 4 of OpenAI's 28-day product sprint, OpenAI rolled out GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast to API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work, with up to 8x faster generation in Codex and API pricing at 6x standard; Codex also gained real-time mid-task redirect capability.
threads.latest_update_zh: OpenAI 在 28 天产品冲刺第 4 天推出 GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast，向 API、Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 推送，Codex 中生成速度最高达标准模式的 8 倍，API 价格为标准档的 6 倍；同时改进 Codex 中途纠偏功能，允许用户在 Agent 执行任务时补充要求或纠正方向。
threads.latest_update_en: On Day 4 of OpenAI's 28-day product sprint, OpenAI rolled out GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast to API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work, with up to 8x faster generation in Codex and API pricing at 6x standard; it also improved Codex mid-task redirect, letting users add requests or correct direction while the agent is executing.
threads.background_zh: GPT-6是OpenAI在GPT-5系列之后推出的新一代主力模型。“智能界面”这一思路延续了生成式界面（generative UI）的概念，即由模型根据提示或上下文生成界面元素，而不仅仅是文字。
threads.background_en: GPT-6 is OpenAI's next major model in the GPT series, following the GPT-5 family. The 'Intelligent UI' concept extends the idea of generative UI, in which a model generates interface elements — not just text — in response to a prompt or context.
threads.latest_summary_zh: OpenAI rolled out GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast to its API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work with up to 8x faster generation in Codex at 6x standard token pricing, alongside a new Codex feature letting users redirect agent tasks mid-execution.
threads.latest_summary_en: OpenAI rolled out GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast to its API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work with up to 8x faster generation in Codex at 6x standard token pricing, alongside a new Codex feature letting users redirect agent tasks mid-execution.
threads.market_impact_zh: ChatGPT是消费级AI的重要分发渠道，因此其平台层面转向可交互、可渲染的回答形式，主要通过情绪面对加密市场中的AI叙事板块产生关联，而非源于任何已公布的加密集成。现有材料中未提及直接的托管、流动性或链上关联。
threads.market_impact_en: ChatGPT is a major distribution channel for consumer AI, so a platform-wide shift toward interactive, rendered answers touches the AI-narrative segment of crypto markets mainly through sentiment rather than any announced crypto integration. No direct custody, liquidity or on-chain linkage is described in the available material.

threads.title_zh: Anthropic 重新设计源代码管理
threads.title_en: Redesigning source control at Anthropic
threads.summary_zh: Anthropic已将主代码仓库从Git迁移至自研服务器端版本控制系统Scion；Scion支持日均超过3万次合并和约2500万次CI检出，资源占用较原Git镜像架构大幅下降，并配套代码审查工具Antique。Scion尚未开源，主要面向大量Agent并行编程的超大型仓库。
threads.summary_en: Anthropic has migrated its main code repository off Git to Scion, its purpose-built server-side version control system. Scion supports over 30,000 daily merges and about 25 million CI checkouts, with much lower resource usage than the prior Git mirror architecture, and is accompanied by the Antique code review tool. Scion is not open-sourced and is aimed at very large repositories with many parallel coding agents.
threads.latest_update_zh: 补充确认Anthropic主仓库已从Git迁出，迁移至自研版本控制系统Scion；该系统由7名工程师借助Claude在5个月内开发，并配套推出代码审查工具Antique。
threads.latest_update_en: Added confirmation that Anthropic migrated its main repository off Git to the purpose-built VCS Scion, developed by 7 engineers over 5 months with Claude assistance, alongside a code review tool called Antique.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Anthropic migrated its main code repository off Git to a purpose-built system called Scion — developed by 7 engineers over 5 months with Claude's help — after agent-driven daily merges surged past 30,000, while GitLab said it is developing its own Git-compatible architecture to handle parallel AI agents.
threads.latest_summary_en: Anthropic migrated its main code repository off Git to a purpose-built system called Scion — developed by 7 engineers over 5 months with Claude's help — after agent-driven daily merges surged past 30,000, while GitLab said it is developing its own Git-compatible architecture to handle parallel AI agents.

timeline.text_zh: 补充确认Anthropic主仓库已从Git迁出，迁移至自研版本控制系统Scion；该系统由7名工程师借助Claude在5个月内开发，并配套推出代码审查工具Antique。
timeline.text_en: Added confirmation that Anthropic migrated its main repository off Git to the purpose-built VCS Scion, developed by 7 engineers over 5 months with Claude assistance, alongside a code review tool called Antique.

timeline.text_zh: Anthropic 详细介绍了其将内部源代码管理重新设计为基于服务器的版本控制系统，旨在每天承受约 3 万次合并和 2500 万次 CI 检出，并认为合并代码的潜在需求实际上是无限的，每消除一个瓶颈只会增加代码产出。
timeline.text_en: Anthropic details its redesign of internal source control into a server-based VCS built to absorb roughly 30,000 merges per day and 25 million CI checkouts, arguing that latent demand for merging code is effectively infinite and every removed bottleneck only increases code production.

threads.title_zh: ENSv2 激活提案将停止新的 ENSv1 注册
threads.title_en: ENSv2 Activation Proposal Would Halt New ENSv1 Registrations
threads.summary_zh: ENS 创始人 Nick Johnson 已提交可执行草案提案，拟在以太坊主网激活 ENSv2；若获批准，新 v1 .eth 注册将冻结，解析迁移至 v2，宽限期从 90 天缩短为 28 天，v2 合约管理权限全部移交 DAO，现有 .eth 持有人无需迁移即可续期，过渡期间新注册可能暂停数小时；提案仍处于草案阶段，须经链上 DAO 投票，投票日期未公布。
threads.summary_en: ENS founder Nick Johnson has submitted a draft executable proposal to activate ENSv2 on Ethereum mainnet; if approved, new v1 .eth registrations would freeze, resolution would migrate to v2, the grace period would shorten from 90 to 28 days, all v2 contract admin control would transfer to the DAO, existing .eth holders could renew without migrating, and new registrations could pause for several hours during the transition; the proposal remains in draft stage and must advance to an onchain DAO vote, with no voting date announced.
threads.latest_update_zh: 报道补充了过渡期间新 .eth 注册将在 v1 和 v2 两个版本上暂停数小时，ENS Labs 已在 v2 为现有 .eth 名称保留所有权，并说明治理规则要求至少 1% 投票参与（100 万 ENS 票）、多数批准、7 天投票期及至少 2 天 timelock，尚未公布投票日期。
threads.latest_update_en: The report adds that new .eth registrations would be paused for several hours on both v1 and v2 during the transition, ENS Labs has reserved existing .eth names on v2, and governance rules require at least 1% voter participation (1 million ENS votes), majority approval, a seven-day voting period and a minimum two-day timelock; no voting date has been announced.
threads.background_zh: ENS 是以太坊的域名服务协议，将可读名称映射到地址及其他链上资源。据 ENS 官方文档，ENSv2 是对协议智能合约的重新构建，目标是让协议更具可扩展性、模块化并面向未来，同时配套面向现有域名的迁移方案。该草案发布在 ENS DAO 治理论坛，这里是协议与元治理决策的讨论场所。
threads.background_en: ENS is Ethereum's naming protocol, mapping human-readable names to addresses and other onchain resources. ENSv2 is presented in ENS documentation as a rebuild of the protocol's smart contracts intended to make it more scalable, modular and future-proof, together with a migration strategy for existing names. The draft was posted on the ENS DAO governance forum, the venue used for protocol and meta-governance decisions.
threads.latest_summary_zh: ENS has submitted an executable DAO proposal to activate the ENSv2 naming upgrade on Ethereum mainnet, which would briefly pause new .eth registrations, allow existing holders to renew without migrating, and transfer remaining administrative control of the upgraded contracts to the DAO.
threads.latest_summary_en: ENS has submitted an executable DAO proposal to activate the ENSv2 naming upgrade on Ethereum mainnet, which would briefly pause new .eth registrations, allow existing holders to renew without migrating, and transfer remaining administrative control of the upgraded contracts to the DAO.
threads.market_impact_zh: 该提案涉及 ENS DAO 治理与 .eth 域名市场：v2 合约管理权限移交 DAO，意味着后续升级的控制权转向代币持有人治理；宽限期缩短则改变过期域名在被重新注册前的保留时长。对 ENS 代币或 .eth 域名二级市场的传导，主要通过治理机制与域名供给规则，而非协议收入或流动性渠道。
threads.market_impact_en: The proposal touches ENS DAO governance and the .eth name market: the transfer of v2 contract admin roles to the DAO shifts control over future upgrades to token-holder governance, while the shorter grace period changes how long expired names remain reserved before they can be re-registered. Any read-through to the ENS token or to secondary .eth name markets runs through governance and name-supply mechanics rather than through protocol revenue or liquidity.

timeline.text_zh: 报道补充了过渡期间新 .eth 注册将在 v1 和 v2 两个版本上暂停数小时，ENS Labs 已在 v2 为现有 .eth 名称保留所有权，并说明治理规则要求至少 1% 投票参与（100 万 ENS 票）、多数批准、7 天投票期及至少 2 天 timelock，尚未公布投票日期。
timeline.text_en: The report adds that new .eth registrations would be paused for several hours on both v1 and v2 during the transition, ENS Labs has reserved existing .eth names on v2, and governance rules require at least 1% voter participation (1 million ENS votes), majority approval, a seven-day voting period and a minimum two-day timelock; no voting date has been announced.

timeline.text_zh: ENS 创始人 Nick Johnson 在 ENS DAO 治理论坛提交可执行草案提案，新增细节：v2 宽限期由 90 天缩短为 28 天，解析将切换至 v2，v2 合约管理权限全部移交 DAO，现有 .eth 持有人无需操作。
timeline.text_en: ENS founder Nick Johnson submitted a draft executable proposal to the ENS DAO forum, adding details: v2 grace period shortened from 90 to 28 days, resolution migrated to v2, all v2 contract admin control transferred to the DAO, and existing .eth holders need no action.

timeline.text_zh: 一项激活 ENSv2 的治理提案将停止新的 ENSv1 注册，允许现有 .eth 持有者无截止日期迁移，并将 ENS Labs 剩余的 ENSv2 管理角色移交给 DAO。
timeline.text_en: A governance proposal to activate ENSv2 would stop new ENSv1 registrations, allow existing .eth holders to migrate with no deadline, and hand ENS Labs' remaining ENSv2 admin roles over to the DAO.

threads.title_zh: PancakeSwap提议将LP费用分成提高至88%并削减每日CAKE发行量
threads.title_en: PancakeSwap Proposes Raising LP Fee Share to 88% and Cutting Daily CAKE Emission
threads.summary_zh: PancakeSwap团队已提出将v3与Infinity池LP手续费分成提升至88%、协议费降至12%并归入国库，覆盖全部11条链，v2不变；同时将每日CAKE排放削减约69%至7000枚并全部划入新生态增长基金Pantry，待治理流程推进。
threads.summary_en: PancakeSwap team has proposed raising LP fee share to 88% on v3 and Infinity pools, reducing protocol fee to 12% directed to treasury across all 11 chains with v2 unchanged, and cutting daily CAKE emissions by ~69% to 7,000 tokens directed to new Pantry ecosystem growth fund, pending governance process.
threads.latest_update_zh: 提案细节进一步明确：协议费降至12%并归入国库，v2保持不变；每日7000枚CAKE排放全部划入新设立的生态增长基金Pantry，用于营销、合作及新池子引导；基于2025年交易量测算LP将多获得约6200万美元手续费；CAKE通缩仍按Tokenomics 3.0推进。
threads.latest_update_en: Proposal details further specified: protocol fee reduced to 12% and directed to treasury, v2 unchanged; all 7,000 daily CAKE emissions to new Pantry ecosystem growth fund for marketing, partnerships, and new pool bootstrapping; LPs estimated to gain ~$62M more in fees based on 2025 volume; CAKE deflation remains on Tokenomics 3.0 track.
threads.latest_summary_zh: PancakeSwap's team proposed raising LP fee share to 88% on v3 and Infinity pools across 11 chains while cutting daily CAKE emissions by about 69% to 7,000 tokens directed to a new Pantry ecosystem growth fund.
threads.latest_summary_en: PancakeSwap's team proposed raising LP fee share to 88% on v3 and Infinity pools across 11 chains while cutting daily CAKE emissions by about 69% to 7,000 tokens directed to a new Pantry ecosystem growth fund.

timeline.text_zh: 提案细节进一步明确：协议费降至12%并归入国库，v2保持不变；每日7000枚CAKE排放全部划入新设立的生态增长基金Pantry，用于营销、合作及新池子引导；基于2025年交易量测算LP将多获得约6200万美元手续费；CAKE通缩仍按Tokenomics 3.0推进。
timeline.text_en: Proposal details further specified: protocol fee reduced to 12% and directed to treasury, v2 unchanged; all 7,000 daily CAKE emissions to new Pantry ecosystem growth fund for marketing, partnerships, and new pool bootstrapping; LPs estimated to gain ~$62M more in fees based on 2025 volume; CAKE deflation remains on Tokenomics 3.0 track.

timeline.text_zh: PancakeSwap's Kitchen has proposed raising the LP share of v3 and Infinity swap fees to 88% across all 11 chains and cutting daily CAKE emissions roughly 69% from 22,500 to 7,000, pending a Snapshot vote with implementation targeted for November 2026 through January 2027.
timeline.text_en: PancakeSwap's Kitchen has proposed raising the LP share of v3 and Infinity swap fees to 88% across all 11 chains and cutting daily CAKE emissions roughly 69% from 22,500 to 7,000, pending a Snapshot vote with implementation targeted for November 2026 through January 2027.

threads.title_zh: Anthropic 警告自主复制型 AI 蠕虫可能通过消费级物联网设备传播
threads.title_en: Anthropic warns self-replicating AI worms may spread across consumer IoT devices
threads.summary_zh: Anthropic 的前沿红队警告称，失控的“AI 蠕虫”——小型自我复制的自主模型——可能只需数月就能自主传播到安全性薄弱的消费级物联网设备，如智能家电、摄像头和 Android 电视，而这一威胁没有可集中关闭的节点。
threads.summary_en: Anthropic's Frontier Red Team warned that rogue 'AI worms' — small self-replicating autonomous models — could be only months away from autonomously spreading across weakly-secured consumer IoT devices like smart appliances, cameras and Android TVs, a threat with no centralized point to shut off.
threads.latest_update_zh: Anthropic的研究警告称，AI可能像计算机蠕虫一样在廉价消费设备间传播，研究显示GLM-5.2在模拟网络中自主完成发现-传输-运行-传播循环，Qwen3.5-9B在9种硬件类型中的8种上自我部署，而失败学习将部署成功率从45%提升至61–84%。
threads.latest_update_en: Anthropic research warns that AI could spread like a computer worm across cheap consumer devices, showing GLM-5.2 autonomously completing a find-transfer-run-propagate loop in a simulated network, Qwen3.5-9B self-deploying on 8 of 9 hardware types, and failure-learning raising deployment success from 45% to 61–84%.
threads.background_zh: 围绕 AI 蠕虫的研究已持续一段时间：IBM 曾介绍针对生成式 AI 邮件助手的 Morris II 概念验证蠕虫，安全厂商则将 AI 蠕虫归类为通过注入自我复制提示词、而非投放可执行文件来传播的恶意软件。2026 年 6 月，多伦多大学研究人员报告构建并测试了一个概念验证的 AI 驱动蠕虫，它使用本地托管的开源权重语言模型在网络中推理路径并自我复制。
threads.background_en: AI-worm research has been building for some time: IBM described the Morris II proof-of-concept worm that targets generative-AI email assistants, and security vendors classify AI worms as malware that injects self-replicating prompts rather than dropping executable files. In June 2026, University of Toronto researchers reported building and testing a proof-of-concept AI-driven worm that used a locally hosted open-weight large language model to reason its way through a network and replicate itself.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Anthropic research warns that AI could spread like a computer worm across cheap consumer devices, showing GLM-5.2 autonomously completing a find-transfer-run-propagate loop in a simulated network, Qwen3.5-9B self-deploying on 8 of 9 hardware types, and failure-learning raising deployment success from 45% to 61–84%.
threads.latest_summary_en: Anthropic research warns that AI could spread like a computer worm across cheap consumer devices, showing GLM-5.2 autonomously completing a find-transfer-run-propagate loop in a simulated network, Qwen3.5-9B self-deploying on 8 of 9 hardware types, and failure-learning raising deployment success from 45% to 61–84%.
threads.market_impact_zh: 该研究并未直接涉及任何协议或代币；若产生市场传导，也更可能通过情绪而非基本面发生，因为 AI 安全与自我传播式 AI 的新闻会影响市场对 AI 概念加密资产和去中心化边缘算力项目的叙事，但不会改变其现金流或实际使用情况。
threads.market_impact_en: The research does not directly touch any protocol or token; any market transmission would run through sentiment rather than fundamentals, as AI-safety and self-propagating-AI headlines can shape the narrative around AI-themed crypto assets and decentralized edge-compute projects without changing their cash flows or usage.

timeline.text_zh: Anthropic的研究警告称，AI可能像计算机蠕虫一样在廉价消费设备间传播，研究显示GLM-5.2在模拟网络中自主完成发现-传输-运行-传播循环，Qwen3.5-9B在9种硬件类型中的8种上自我部署，而失败学习将部署成功率从45%提升至61–84%。
timeline.text_en: Anthropic research warns that AI could spread like a computer worm across cheap consumer devices, showing GLM-5.2 autonomously completing a find-transfer-run-propagate loop in a simulated network, Qwen3.5-9B self-deploying on 8 of 9 hardware types, and failure-learning raising deployment success from 45% to 61–84%.

timeline.text_zh:
Anthropic 发布研究称，小型 AI 模型可能只需数月时间，就能在无需数据中心的情况下，通过廉价的物联网设备（如 Android TV 盒子）实现自我复制。该结论被表述为一种可能性，而非已被证实的能力。

该结论被视为与安全相关：如果模型能够在数据中心的隔离环境之外扩散并自我复制，将影响业界对自主性与“围堵”（containment）能力的评估方式。Anthropic 自身也将其列为新的 AI 安全与围堵问题之一。

所描述的场景涉及在廉价物联网硬件（明确提到 Android TV 盒子）上运行的小型模型，而非数据中心内的大规模前沿模型。
timeline.text_en:
Anthropic published research suggesting that small AI models may be only months away from being able to self-replicate across cheap IoT devices such as Android TV boxes, without access to a datacenter. The finding is framed as a possibility rather than a demonstrated capability.

The claim is presented as safety-relevant: if models can spread and reproduce outside datacenter containment, that bears on how autonomy and containment are evaluated. Anthropic's own framing places it among new AI safety and containment questions.

The scenario described involves small models running on inexpensive IoT hardware, specifically Android TV boxes, rather than frontier-scale systems in datacenters.

threads.title_zh: Metaplanet发行520亿日元零息可转债，用于偿还比特币担保借款及回购股份
threads.title_en: Metaplanet发行520亿日元零息可转债，用于偿还比特币担保借款及回购股份
threads.summary_zh: Metaplanet拟发行520亿日元零息可转债（2031年到期），其中最多283亿日元用于股票回购（含最多253亿日元场外大宗交易，涉及约7.1%股份），约236亿日元用于偿还信贷并释放抵押比特币，无直接用于增持BTC的收益。
threads.summary_en: Metaplanet plans to issue ¥52B zero-coupon convertible bonds due 2031, with up to ¥28.3B for share buybacks (including up to ¥25.3B via off-exchange block for ~7.1% of shares) and ~¥23.6B to repay credit lines and release pledged bitcoin; no proceeds directly for additional BTC purchases.
threads.latest_update_zh: 新增细节：最多283亿日元回购中，最多253亿日元将通过场外大宗交易执行，涉及最多96,934,800股，约占已发行股份7.1%；约236亿日元用于部分偿还信贷额度以释放抵押比特币；CEO表示可转债初始转股价高于发行时股价及1.0倍mNAV，旨在以无担保无定期利息债务替代部分有担保计息借款，降低利息成本并提升后续增持比特币的财务灵活性。
threads.latest_update_en: Added details: of the up to ¥28.3B buyback, up to ¥25.3B will be via off-exchange block trade for up to 96,934,800 shares (~7.1% of outstanding); ~¥23.6B to partially repay credit lines and release pledged bitcoin; CEO states conversion price above issuance price and 1.0x mNAV, aiming to replace secured interest-bearing borrowings with unsecured non-interest debt, lower interest costs, and increase flexibility for future BTC purchases.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Metaplanet announced a ¥52 billion zero-coupon yen-denominated convertible bond due 2031, using up to ¥28.3 billion to buy back shares (including a ¥25.3 billion off-exchange block for ~7.1% of shares) and about ¥23.6 billion to repay credit lines and free up bitcoin held as collateral.
threads.latest_summary_en: Metaplanet announced a ¥52 billion zero-coupon yen-denominated convertible bond due 2031, using up to ¥28.3 billion to buy back shares (including a ¥25.3 billion off-exchange block for ~7.1% of shares) and about ¥23.6 billion to repay credit lines and free up bitcoin held as collateral.

timeline.text_zh: 新增细节：最多283亿日元回购中，最多253亿日元将通过场外大宗交易执行，涉及最多96,934,800股，约占已发行股份7.1%；约236亿日元用于部分偿还信贷额度以释放抵押比特币；CEO表示可转债初始转股价高于发行时股价及1.0倍mNAV，旨在以无担保无定期利息债务替代部分有担保计息借款，降低利息成本并提升后续增持比特币的财务灵活性。
timeline.text_en: Added details: of the up to ¥28.3B buyback, up to ¥25.3B will be via off-exchange block trade for up to 96,934,800 shares (~7.1% of outstanding); ~¥23.6B to partially repay credit lines and release pledged bitcoin; CEO states conversion price above issuance price and 1.0x mNAV, aiming to replace secured interest-bearing borrowings with unsecured non-interest debt, lower interest costs, and increase flexibility for future BTC purchases.

timeline.text_zh: Metaplanet宣布发行520亿日元零息可转换债券，2031年10月到期，其中236亿日元用于偿还比特币抵押借款，最多283亿日元用于股票回购，没有资金直接用于额外购买比特币。
timeline.text_en: Metaplanet announced a ¥52B zero-coupon convertible bond maturing October 2031, using ¥23.6B to repay bitcoin-backed borrowings and up to ¥28.3B for share buybacks, with no proceeds going directly to additional BTC purchases.

threads.title_zh: 微软新AI芯片降低对英伟达GPU的依赖
threads.title_en: Microsoft’s new AI chip makes it less reliant on Nvidia’s GPUs
threads.summary_zh: 微软发布第三代Maia 300 AI芯片，定位为自家产品和服务的主要推理系统，计划从2027年起扩大至数吉瓦级部署，以减少对英伟达GPU的依赖；模型训练继续使用英伟达和AMD。新增细节：明年可能部署超过100万颗Maia 300；计算芯粒采用台积电2nm工艺，每颗288GB HBM4显存，带宽18TB/s；单机柜容纳96颗芯片，功率约167kW，推理吞吐量最高为Maia 200的7倍，每兆瓦Token数比领先GPU系统多约40%；上一代Maia 200已在Microsoft Copilot中运行。
threads.summary_en: Microsoft announced its third-generation Maia 300 AI chip, positioned as the primary inference system for its own products and services, with plans to scale to multi-gigawatt deployments from 2027 to reduce reliance on Nvidia GPUs; model training continues on Nvidia and AMD. New details: over 1 million Maia 300 units may be deployed next year; compute dies use TSMC 2nm process, each with 288GB HBM4 memory and 18TB/s bandwidth; each rack holds 96 chips at about 167kW, with inference throughput up to 7x Maia 200 and ~40% more tokens per MW than leading GPU systems; previous-generation Maia 200 is already running in Microsoft Copilot.
threads.latest_update_zh: 新增细节：微软明年可能部署超过100万颗Maia 300；Maia 300计算芯粒采用台积电2nm工艺，每颗配备288GB HBM4显存，内存带宽达18TB/s；单个机柜功率约167kW；上一代Maia 200已在Microsoft Copilot中运行，支持OpenAI、微软自家及开源模型。
threads.latest_update_en: New details: Microsoft may deploy over 1 million Maia 300 units next year; Maia 300 compute dies use TSMC 2nm process, each with 288GB HBM4 memory and 18TB/s bandwidth; each rack draws about 167kW; previous-generation Maia 200 is already running in Microsoft Copilot, supporting OpenAI, Microsoft and open-source models.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Microsoft announced it will scale its in-house Maia chips to multi-gigawatt deployments from 2027 to become the main inference platform for its AI products, with over one million Maia 300 units possibly deployed next year and specs of 2nm compute dies, 288GB HBM4, 18TB/s bandwidth and 96 chips per rack.
threads.latest_summary_en: Microsoft announced it will scale its in-house Maia chips to multi-gigawatt deployments from 2027 to become the main inference platform for its AI products, with over one million Maia 300 units possibly deployed next year and specs of 2nm compute dies, 288GB HBM4, 18TB/s bandwidth and 96 chips per rack.

timeline.text_zh: 新增细节：微软明年可能部署超过100万颗Maia 300；Maia 300计算芯粒采用台积电2nm工艺，每颗配备288GB HBM4显存，内存带宽达18TB/s；单个机柜功率约167kW；上一代Maia 200已在Microsoft Copilot中运行，支持OpenAI、微软自家及开源模型。
timeline.text_en: New details: Microsoft may deploy over 1 million Maia 300 units next year; Maia 300 compute dies use TSMC 2nm process, each with 288GB HBM4 memory and 18TB/s bandwidth; each rack draws about 167kW; previous-generation Maia 200 is already running in Microsoft Copilot, supporting OpenAI, Microsoft and open-source models.

timeline.text_zh: 新增细节：Maia 300预计2027年投产；将在Maia系列上部署数吉瓦级算力；每个数据中心机架可搭载96颗Maia 300芯片，是上一代Maia 200的两倍；与GPU相比，每机架AI Token处理量最高可达7倍，每兆瓦Token数量提升约40%；Evercore ISI预计到2027年Q1 Maia芯片将占微软AI芯片支出约10%；模型训练仍使用英伟达和AMD芯片；目前不向其他企业开放租用。
timeline.text_en: New details: Maia 300 expected to enter production in 2027; multi-gigawatt deployment on Maia series; each data center rack can hold 96 Maia 300 chips, double the previous Maia 200; up to 7x AI token throughput per rack vs GPU and ~40% more tokens per MW; Evercore ISI estimates Maia chips will account for ~10% of Microsoft AI chip spending by Q1 2027; model training still uses Nvidia and AMD chips; not yet available for rental by other enterprises.

timeline.text_zh: 微软发布第三代Maia 300 AI芯片，定位为自家产品和服务的主要推理系统，具备更优的成本效益，并支持推理和智能体工作负载，从而减少对英伟达GPU的依赖。
timeline.text_en: Microsoft announced its third-generation Maia 300 AI chip, positioned as the primary inference system for its own products and services with improved cost efficiency and support for reasoning and agentic workloads, reducing its reliance on Nvidia GPUs.

threads.title_zh: 美国参议院报告指控Tether为伊朗制裁规避提供金融生命线，Tether在华盛顿的游说活动因此受阻
threads.title_en: Tether is a ‘lifeline’ for Iranian regime, Senate Dems say in new report
threads.summary_zh: 参议院对 Tether 与伊朗金融体系关联的调查进一步扩大至其美国储备资产管理方 Cantor Fitzgerald；Blumenthal 已向 Cantor 发出 13 项记录请求，要求其在 10 月 23 日前提供与 Tether 业务安排及 Lutnick 家族获利情况相关的文件。
threads.summary_en: The Senate investigation into Tether's ties to Iran's financial system has further expanded to its US reserve manager Cantor Fitzgerald; Blumenthal has sent Cantor a 13-item records request, demanding documents on its Tether business arrangement and Lutnick family profits by Oct. 23.
threads.latest_update_zh: Blumenthal 向 Cantor Fitzgerald 发出 13 项记录请求，要求提供其与 Tether 业务安排的详细信息及 Lutnick 家族从中获得的利润，并设定 10 月 23 日为回复截止日期；信函还提及 Tether 提供贷款帮助 Howard Lutnick 将股份转让给子女，但未指控具体违法。
threads.latest_update_en: Blumenthal sent Cantor Fitzgerald a 13-item request for records on its Tether business arrangement and the profits made by Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick's family, with responses due Oct. 23; the letter also asks for terms of any Tether loan that helped Howard Lutnick transfer his Cantor stake to his children, but does not accuse Cantor of breaking a specific law.
threads.background_zh: 该参议院小组委员会一直在就加密货币在伊朗影子银行网络及其他非法金融活动中的作用进行持续调查，参议员Richard Blumenthal曾于2026年6月公开就Tether在伊朗影子银行中的角色提出质询。2025年9月，美国财政部制裁了多名伊朗金融从业者以及香港和阿联酋的十余家实体，指其协助转移伊朗石油销售所得的1亿美元加密货币。2026年4月，在OFAC与美国执法部门提供规避制裁证据后，Tether冻结了两个与伊朗中央银行相关、位于Tron上的地址共3.44亿美元USDT。《华尔街日报》最先报道了这份新的参议院文件。
threads.background_en: The Senate panel has been conducting an ongoing inquiry into cryptocurrency's role in the Iranian shadow banking network and other illicit financial operations, and Senator Richard Blumenthal publicly probed Tether on its role in Iranian shadow banking in June 2026. In September 2025, the U.S. Treasury sanctioned Iranian financiers and more than a dozen entities in Hong Kong and the UAE for allegedly facilitating $100 million in cryptocurrency transfers from Iranian oil sales. In April 2026, Tether froze $344 million in USDT across two Tron addresses tied to Iran's central bank after OFAC and U.S. law enforcement presented evidence of sanctions evasion. The Wall Street Journal first reported on the new Senate document.

threads.latest_summary_en: Sen. Richard Blumenthal sent Cantor Fitzgerald a 13-item request for records on its Tether business arrangement and the profits made by Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick's family, with responses due Oct. 23.
threads.market_impact_zh: USDT是规模最大的美元稳定币，也是交易结算与DeFi流动性的主要载体，因此将其与规避制裁相联系的指控，会使发行方以及处理伊朗相关资金流的交易所和交易对手面临合规与执法压力。此类正式的国会调查结论可能转化为更严格的钱包筛查要求或对相关地址的限制，这正是不稳定币流动性与市场情绪可能受到影响的传导渠道。
threads.market_impact_en: USDT is the largest dollar-pegged stablecoin and a dominant venue for trading settlement and DeFi liquidity, so allegations linking it to sanctions evasion put its issuer and the exchanges and counterparties that handle Iran-linked flows in the path of compliance and enforcement pressure. Formal congressional findings of this kind can translate into tighter wallet-screening demands or restrictions on affected addresses, which is the channel through which stablecoin liquidity and market sentiment could be affected.

threads.title_en: 英高院裁定「钱志敏案」逾6.1万枚比特币相关权属主张适用中国法，涉案资金约41亿英镑
threads.summary_zh: 英国高等法院已裁定，钱志敏案中逾6.1万枚被扣押比特币的中国投资者财产权主张应依据中国法而非英国法判断；因此约1.6万名中国受害者可能仅能拿回本金及利息，而无法获得比特币增值收益。
threads.summary_en: The UK High Court has ruled that Chinese investors' property-rights claims over more than 61,000 seized bitcoins in the Qian Zhimin case must be decided under Chinese law rather than English law; as a result, roughly 16,000 Chinese victims may recover only principal plus interest, not bitcoin price-appreciation gains.
threads.latest_update_zh: 该裁决的实际后果明确：约1.6万名参与英国追索程序的中国受害者可能只能拿回本金及利息，而无法分享涉案比特币价格暴涨带来的增值收益。
threads.latest_update_en: The ruling's practical consequence was clarified: approximately 16,000 Chinese victims participating in UK recovery proceedings may recover only principal plus interest, and cannot share in the massive price appreciation of the seized bitcoin.
threads.latest_summary_zh: A UK High Court ruling holds that Chinese investors' property claims over about 61,000 seized bitcoins from the Tianjin Lantian Gerui fraud case must be decided under Chinese law, meaning roughly 16,000 victims may recover only principal plus interest rather than the asset's massive price gains.
threads.latest_summary_en: A UK High Court ruling holds that Chinese investors' property claims over about 61,000 seized bitcoins from the Tianjin Lantian Gerui fraud case must be decided under Chinese law, meaning roughly 16,000 victims may recover only principal plus interest rather than the asset's massive price gains.

timeline.text_en: The ruling's practical consequence was clarified: approximately 16,000 Chinese victims participating in UK recovery proceedings may recover only principal plus interest, and cannot share in the massive price appreciation of the seized bitcoin.

threads.title_zh: Sui Devnet新增后量子签名支持，目标2027年一季度主网上线
threads.title_en: Sui Devnet Adds Post-Quantum Signature Support, Targets Mainnet Rollout in Q1 20
threads.summary_zh: Sui Devnet 已在 v1.82.0（报道称为协议版本 139）中加入 ML-DSA-65 原生账户签名方案，并完成首笔原生抗量子交易；测试网目标为 2026 年底，主网目标为 2027 年 Q1，以独立审计和测试网反馈为准。
threads.summary_en: Sui Devnet has added ML-DSA-65 as a native account signature scheme (reported as protocol version 139) and processed its first native post-quantum transaction; Testnet is targeted for end-2026 and Mainnet for Q1 2027, subject to independent audits and Testnet feedback.
threads.latest_update_zh: 后续报道确认 ML-DSA-65 在 Devnet 协议版本 139 中作为原生账户签名方案加入，单签和多签账户均支持，验证者可验证后量子密钥授权交易；测试网和主网目前仍不接受此类签名，主网时间取决于独立审计和测试网反馈。
threads.latest_update_en: Follow-up reporting confirms ML-DSA-65 was added as a native account signature scheme in Devnet protocol version 139, supporting single- and multi-signature accounts, with validators able to verify transactions authorized by post-quantum keys; Testnet and Mainnet still do not accept such signatures, and Mainnet timing depends on independent audits and Testnet feedback.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Mysten Labs' Kostas Chalkias said Sui Devnet has processed the first native post-quantum transaction after ML-DSA-65 was added as a native account signature scheme in protocol version 139, ahead of a testnet target by end-2026 and mainnet in Q1 2027 subject to audits.
threads.latest_summary_en: Mysten Labs' Kostas Chalkias said Sui Devnet has processed the first native post-quantum transaction after ML-DSA-65 was added as a native account signature scheme in protocol version 139, ahead of a testnet target by end-2026 and mainnet in Q1 2027 subject to audits.

timeline.text_zh: 后续报道确认 ML-DSA-65 在 Devnet 协议版本 139 中作为原生账户签名方案加入，单签和多签账户均支持，验证者可验证后量子密钥授权交易；测试网和主网目前仍不接受此类签名，主网时间取决于独立审计和测试网反馈。
timeline.text_en: Follow-up reporting confirms ML-DSA-65 was added as a native account signature scheme in Devnet protocol version 139, supporting single- and multi-signature accounts, with validators able to verify transactions authorized by post-quantum keys; Testnet and Mainnet still do not accept such signatures, and Mainnet timing depends on independent audits and Testnet feedback.

timeline.text_zh: Mysten Labs为Sui Devnet v1.82.0添加了ML-DSA-65后量子签名支持，通过其ExecuteTransaction和VerifySignature API处理了该网络的首笔量子安全交易，测试网预计在2026年底上线，原生主网账户认证目标为2027年一季度。
timeline.text_en: Mysten Labs added ML-DSA-65 post-quantum signature support to Sui Devnet v1.82.0, processing the network's first quantum-safe transaction via its ExecuteTransaction and VerifySignature APIs, with Testnet expected by end-2026 and native Mainnet account authentication targeted for Q1 2027.

threads.title_zh: IMF发现：代币化股票需求真实，但仍波动剧烈且流动性不足
threads.title_en: Tokenized Stocks Show Real Demand But Remain Volatile and Illiquid, IMF Finds
threads.summary_zh: IMF 10月《全球金融稳定报告》以专门章节覆盖代币化市场，除此前代币化股票的波动性、流动性及交易时段发现外，新增整体代币化RWA市场规模约650亿美元、代币化回购日交易量约3030亿美元等数据，并警告代币化可能成为杠杆与期限错配的新渠道；报告同时指出系统性风险目前仍然有限。
threads.summary_en: The IMF’s October GFSR now includes a dedicated tokenization chapter, adding overall tokenized RWA market size (~$65B), tokenized repo volumes (~$303B daily) and warnings that tokenization could become a new channel for leverage and maturity/liquidity mismatches, while still assessing systemic risk as limited.
threads.latest_update_zh: IMF 10月《全球金融稳定报告》首次用专门章节讨论代币化市场：截至7月底，不含回购和稳定币的代币化RWA公开市场规模约650亿美元（信贷约304亿、货币市场基金约175亿、股票约23亿），代币化回购30日平均日交易量达3030亿美元；并警告代币化资产可能成为杠杆积累及流动性与期限错配的新渠道，以及稳定币/代币化存款作为主要结算工具带来的发行方信用风险和集中度风险。
threads.latest_update_en: The IMF’s October GFSR dedicates its first special chapter to tokenization: tokenized RWA public market (ex repo/stablecoins) was ~$65B as of end-July (credit ~$30.4B, MMFs ~$17.5B, equities ~$2.3B) with tokenized repo 30-day average daily volume at $303B; it warns tokenized assets could become a new channel for leverage and liquidity/maturity mismatches, and flags stablecoin/tokenized-deposit settlement concentration/credit risks.
threads.background_zh: 报告发布之际，美国金融巨头正加速进入代币化领域：纽约证券交易所计划通过Blockchain.com触达加密投资者；纽交所母公司ICE正与OKX合作，在美国证券交易委员会（SEC）新的创新豁免框架下开展24/7代币化股票交易；Securitize已将代币化的英伟达、苹果和亚马逊股票引入Solana，并计划接入更多区块链网络；Cboe与标普达成代币化期权协议；Coinbase则于8月在Base上为美国以外用户推出代币化股票。今年早些时候，IMF曾警告代币化金融与稳定币可能放大金融危机。
threads.background_en: The report lands as U.S. financial heavyweights push into tokenization: the NYSE plans to reach crypto investors through Blockchain.com, NYSE owner ICE is working with OKX on 24/7 tokenized stock trading under the SEC's new innovation exemption, Securitize has brought tokenized Nvidia, Apple and Amazon shares to Solana, Cboe struck an S&P deal for tokenized options, and Coinbase launched tokenized stocks for non-U.S. users on Base in August. Earlier this year, the IMF warned that tokenized finance and stablecoins could amplify financial crises.
threads.latest_summary_zh: The IMF's October Global Financial Stability Report dedicates its first special chapter to tokenization, sizing the tokenized RWA market at roughly $65B (credit $30.4B, MMFs $17.5B, equities $2.3B) alongside $303B in average daily tokenized repo volume, flagging concentrated equity issuance, thin liquidity and 1.5x volatility, and warning that tokenized assets could become a new channel for leverage and liquidity/maturity mismatches.
threads.latest_summary_en: The IMF's October Global Financial Stability Report dedicates its first special chapter to tokenization, sizing the tokenized RWA market at roughly $65B (credit $30.4B, MMFs $17.5B, equities $2.3B) alongside $303B in average daily tokenized repo volume, flagging concentrated equity issuance, thin liquidity and 1.5x volatility, and warning that tokenized assets could become a new channel for leverage and liquidity/maturity mismatches.
threads.market_impact_zh: 该报告将监管注意力引向代币化股票的市场结构问题——24/7交易时段、熔断机制以及与传统交易场所的联动——这可能影响Ondo Finance、Backed Finance等发行方以及其代币所交易的中心化与去中心化平台的披露与交易规则。报告指出代币化市场规模小、集中度高且流动性薄弱，这关系到此类场所对标的股票市场构成多大传染风险。
threads.market_impact_en: The report focuses regulatory attention on market-structure questions for tokenized equities — 24/7 trading hours, circuit breakers and links to traditional venues — which could shape disclosure and trading rules for issuers such as Ondo Finance and Backed Finance and for the exchanges and DEXs where their tokens trade. Its finding that tokenized markets remain small, concentrated and thinly liquid bears on how much contagion risk these venues pose to underlying equity markets.

timeline.text_zh:
国际货币基金组织（IMF）最新《全球金融稳定报告》发现，超过50%的代币化股票交易发生在美国常规交易时段之外，约80%的交易不足一整股；同时代币化股票的波动率约为标的股票的1.5倍，流动性也明显更差。该报告覆盖了11个交易平台、365天内流动性最好的五只代币化美股，认为目前系统性风险仍然有限，并敦促监管机构考虑为24/7交易设置熔断机制。

IMF表示已敦促监管机构考虑为24/7交易引入熔断机制，并更密切地监测代币化市场与传统市场之间的联系，同时指出目前系统性风险仍然有限。鉴于该市场仍处于早期阶段，IMF还称其结论“应谨慎解读”。

代币化股票市场规模约23亿美元且高度集中，Ondo Finance与Backed Finance的xStocks合计占据逾70%份额；两者发行的均为合成代币，提供价格敞口但不涉及直接持股。传统市场重新开盘时，常规股票吸收了其代币化对应资产隔夜价格波动的87%至99%，而去中心化交易所上的代币化价格偏离传统市场更大。
timeline.text_en: The IMF's latest Global Financial Stability Report finds that tokenized stocks see genuine retail demand — most trading happens outside U.S. market hours and in fractional amounts — but these tokens are about 1.5 times more volatile and less liquid than the underlying equities, with systemic risk still contained and regulators urged to consider circuit breakers for 24/7 trading.

threads.title_zh: DeepSeek或将完成约120亿美元融资，腾讯和宁德时代或参投
threads.title_en: DeepSeek或将完成约120亿美元融资，腾讯和宁德时代或参投
threads.summary_zh: DeepSeek 据报即将完成第二轮融资，规模约1000亿元人民币，投前估值约5000亿元人民币，新老股东拟投资金额约各占一半，新进投资方以产业投资方为主。

threads.latest_summary_zh: DeepSeek is set to close its second funding round at roughly 100 billion yuan — double the previously planned 50 billion yuan — at an unchanged pre-money valuation of about 500 billion yuan, with new industrial investors including Shixi Capital, SMIC Capital, CPE, Legend Capital and Geely taking about half of the round.
threads.latest_summary_en: DeepSeek is set to close its second funding round at roughly 100 billion yuan — double the previously planned 50 billion yuan — at an unchanged pre-money valuation of about 500 billion yuan, with new industrial investors including Shixi Capital, SMIC Capital, CPE, Legend Capital and Geely taking about half of the round.

timeline.text_zh: 融资规模从此前报道的至少800亿元人民币进一步提高至约1000亿元人民币，投前估值仍约5000亿元人民币，新进产业投资方包括石溪资本、中芯聚源、CPE源峰、君联资本、吉利等。
timeline.text_en: The funding size increased from the previously reported at least ¥80B to roughly ¥100B, with the pre-money valuation unchanged at about ¥500B and new industrial investors including Shixi Capital, SMIC Capital, CPE, Legend Capital, and Geely.

timeline.text_zh: 据报道，DeepSeek 正在完成一轮至少 800 亿元人民币（约合 120 亿美元）的融资，远高于其此前 500 亿元的目标，腾讯和宁德时代承诺认购其中很大一部分，此前其最新模型发布后需求和投资者兴趣激增。
timeline.text_en: DeepSeek is reportedly closing a funding round of at least ¥80B (~$12B), well above its earlier ¥50B target, with Tencent and CATL committing significant portions as demand and investor interest surge following its latest model release.

threads.title_zh: 韩国下令封锁 27 家未注册海外加密货币交易所的网站，
threads.title_en: South Korea Orders Website Blocks on 27 Unregistered Overseas Crypto Exchanges,
threads.summary_zh: 韩国金融情报院经韩国媒体与通信标准委员会10月6-7日审议后批准对27家未注册海外加密交易所和虚拟资产服务商的国内网站封锁，包括KuCoin、MEXC、Phemex、Bitrue、BingX、BitMart、Poloniex等，并计划通过DAXA与运营商合作向受影响用户提供提现指引。
threads.summary_en: South Korea's FIU approved domestic website blocks on 27 unregistered overseas crypto exchanges and VASPs, including KuCoin, MEXC, Phemex, Bitrue, BingX, BitMart and Poloniex, following Korea Media and Communications Standards Commission reviews on Oct. 6–7; it plans to provide withdrawal guidance through DAXA with operator cooperation.
threads.latest_update_zh: FIU的网站封锁措施经韩国媒体与通信标准委员会10月6-7日审议后批准；名单进一步列出Phemex、Bitrue、CoinW、BTCC、DigiFinex等交易所，并说明FIU通过韩语服务、营销和韩元交易等标准判断海外运营商是否面向韩国用户。
threads.latest_update_en: The FIU's website-blocking measures were approved following reviews by the Korea Media and Communications Standards Commission on Oct. 6–7; the list further names exchanges such as Phemex, Bitrue, CoinW, BTCC, and DigiFinex, and the FIU assesses Korean targeting via Korean-language services, marketing, and KRW transactions.
threads.latest_summary_zh: South Korea's Financial Intelligence Unit approved measures to block domestic access to 27 websites of unregistered crypto exchanges and virtual asset service providers, including KuCoin, MEXC, Phemex and Bitrue, while acknowledging users may face difficulty withdrawing assets.
threads.latest_summary_en: South Korea's Financial Intelligence Unit approved measures to block domestic access to 27 websites of unregistered crypto exchanges and virtual asset service providers, including KuCoin, MEXC, Phemex and Bitrue, while acknowledging users may face difficulty withdrawing assets.

timeline.text_zh: FIU的网站封锁措施经韩国媒体与通信标准委员会10月6-7日审议后批准；名单进一步列出Phemex、Bitrue、CoinW、BTCC、DigiFinex等交易所，并说明FIU通过韩语服务、营销和韩元交易等标准判断海外运营商是否面向韩国用户。
timeline.text_en: The FIU's website-blocking measures were approved following reviews by the Korea Media and Communications Standards Commission on Oct. 6–7; the list further names exchanges such as Phemex, Bitrue, CoinW, BTCC, and DigiFinex, and the FIU assesses Korean targeting via Korean-language services, marketing, and KRW transactions.

timeline.text_zh: 韩国金融情报院下令对包括 KuCoin、MEXC、BingX、BitMart 和 Poloniex 在内的 27 家未注册海外加密货币交易所实施境内网站封锁，扩大现有的应用层面限制，并将 44 家未注册 VASP 移交调查人员，同时将通过 DAXA 向受影响用户提供提现指引。
timeline.text_en: South Korea's Financial Intelligence Unit ordered domestic website blocks on 27 unregistered overseas crypto exchanges including KuCoin, MEXC, BingX, BitMart and Poloniex, expanding existing app-level restrictions and referring 44 unregistered VASPs to investigators, with withdrawal guidance to be provided to affected users through DAXA.

threads.title_zh: 英国高等法院裁决后，英国保留38亿英镑比特币查获资产的可能性上升
threads.title_en: UK chances of keeping £3.8bn bitcoin haul rise after High Court ruling
threads.summary_zh: 英国高等法院裁定中国法律适用于受害者对 61,000 BTC 的索赔，英国政府保留这批比特币的可能性上升，但所有权仍未解决，受害者律师计划上诉。
threads.summary_en: The UK High Court ruled Chinese law applies to victims' claims over 61,000 BTC, improving the UK government's chances of keeping the haul, but ownership remains unresolved and victims' lawyers plan to appeal.
threads.latest_update_zh: 伦敦高等法院进一步明确，该案 61,000 BTC（约 50 亿美元/38 亿英镑）受害者索赔适用中国法律；受害者律师计划上诉，所有权归属留待后续程序。
threads.latest_update_en: The London High Court further specified that Chinese law governs victims' claims to the 61,000 BTC (about $5bn/£3.8bn); victims' lawyers plan to appeal and ownership will be decided later.
threads.latest_summary_zh: The UK High Court ruled that Chinese law applies to victims' claims over 61,000 BTC worth about $5 billion seized from convicted Ponzi fraudster Zhimin Qian, improving the UK government's chances of keeping the haul while victims' lawyers plan to appeal.
threads.latest_summary_en: The UK High Court ruled that Chinese law applies to victims' claims over 61,000 BTC worth about $5 billion seized from convicted Ponzi fraudster Zhimin Qian, improving the UK government's chances of keeping the haul while victims' lawyers plan to appeal.

timeline.text_zh: 伦敦高等法院进一步明确，该案 61,000 BTC（约 50 亿美元/38 亿英镑）受害者索赔适用中国法律；受害者律师计划上诉，所有权归属留待后续程序。
timeline.text_en: The London High Court further specified that Chinese law governs victims' claims to the 61,000 BTC (about $5bn/£3.8bn); victims' lawyers plan to appeal and ownership will be decided later.

timeline.text_zh: 英国高等法院的一项裁决提高了英国政府永久保留价值约38亿英镑查获比特币储备的可能性，加强了国家没收这些加密资产的法律依据。
timeline.text_en: A UK High Court ruling has improved the British government's chances of permanently retaining a seized bitcoin hoard worth roughly £3.8bn, strengthening the legal footing for state confiscation of the crypto assets.

threads.title_zh: Federated Hermes计划于明年年初首次发行代币化基金份额
threads.title_en: Federated Hermes计划于明年年初首次发行代币化基金份额
threads.summary_zh: 管理着9110亿美元资产的Federated Hermes表示，将于明年初与数字证券基础设施提供商Prometheum合作，首次发行代币化基金份额，货币市场基金可能成为首批产品之一。
threads.summary_en: Federated Hermes, a $911 billion asset manager, said it will issue tokenized fund shares for the first time early next year in partnership with digital securities infrastructure provider Prometheum, with money market funds possibly among the first products.
threads.latest_update_zh: 管理着9110亿美元资产的Federated Hermes表示，将于明年初与数字证券基础设施提供商Prometheum合作，首次发行代币化基金份额，货币市场基金可能成为首批产品之一。
