timeline.text_en: Tether blacklisted four THORChain vaults holding 1.45 million USDT, prompting THORChain to halt Tron swaps and liquidity-provider operations without prior notice.

threads.title_zh: 韩国多家金融机构疑遭AI攻击，黑客在Claude Code留下身份线索
threads.title_en: 韩国多家金融机构疑遭AI攻击，黑客在Claude Code留下身份线索
threads.summary_zh: 韩国监管机构和 CrowdStrike 已将七家以上金融机构的数据泄露事件与一名攻击者联系起来，该攻击者使用开源代理式渗透测试框架 ARTEX，并借助 DeepSeek v4.1-flash、Claude Code、GLM-5.3 和 Grok 4.6 驱动，影响数万名客户；一名疑似 Telegram 账户否认参与。ARTEX 开发者已宣布闭源并下架 GitHub 原始仓库，但源码已被他人备份。
threads.summary_en: South Korean regulators and CrowdStrike have linked data breaches at seven-plus financial institutions, affecting tens of thousands of customers, to an attacker using the open-source agentic pentest framework ARTEX driven by DeepSeek v4.1-flash along with Claude Code, GLM-5.3 and Grok 4.6, with a suspect Telegram account denying involvement. The ARTEX developer has now closed the project and removed the original GitHub repository, though the source code has been backed up by others.
threads.latest_update_zh: ARTEX 开发者 Autumn-27 于 10 月 8 日宣布项目闭源，停止更新，不再对外发布新版本或提供维护支持；随后 GitHub 原始仓库被下架。源码已被其他开发者备份。
threads.latest_update_en: ARTEX developer Autumn-27 announced on October 8 that the project is going closed-source, stopping updates and no longer releasing new versions or providing maintenance support; the original GitHub repository was subsequently removed. The source code has been backed up by other developers.
threads.latest_summary_zh: After CrowdStrike found that attackers behind a wave of intrusions into South Korean financial institutions had used the open-source multi-agent AI penetration-testing tool ARTEX, its developer closed the project and removed the original GitHub repository.
threads.latest_summary_en: After CrowdStrike found that attackers behind a wave of intrusions into South Korean financial institutions had used the open-source multi-agent AI penetration-testing tool ARTEX, its developer closed the project and removed the original GitHub repository.

timeline.text_zh: ARTEX 开发者 Autumn-27 于 10 月 8 日宣布项目闭源，停止更新，不再对外发布新版本或提供维护支持；随后 GitHub 原始仓库被下架。源码已被其他开发者备份。
timeline.text_en: ARTEX developer Autumn-27 announced on October 8 that the project is going closed-source, stopping updates and no longer releasing new versions or providing maintenance support; the original GitHub repository was subsequently removed. The source code has been backed up by other developers.

timeline.text_zh: 韩国监管机构和CrowdStrike将七家以上金融机构的数据泄露事件与一名攻击者联系起来，事件影响数万名客户；该攻击者使用了由DeepSeek v4.1-flash驱动、并结合Claude Code、GLM-5.3和Grok 4.6的开源代理式渗透测试框架ARTEX，一个疑似Telegram账号目前否认参与。
timeline.text_en: South Korean regulators and CrowdStrike have linked data breaches at seven-plus financial institutions, affecting tens of thousands of customers, to an attacker using the open-source agentic pentest framework ARTEX driven by DeepSeek v4.1-flash along with Claude Code, GLM-5.3 and Grok 4.6, with a suspect Telegram account now denying involvement.

threads.title_zh: FT：DWF Labs就涉嫌提前出售锁定代币起诉BitGo，索赔1.41亿美元
threads.title_en: FT: DWF Labs Sues BitGo for $141 Million Over Alleged Early Sales of Locked Toke
threads.summary_zh: DWF Labs 旗下 DWF Maas 与 Falcon Digital 在伦敦起诉 BitGo，索赔 1.41 亿美元；其称 BitGo 在三个月锁仓期到期前出售折价 FF 和 ESPORTS 代币，并寻求 1.14 亿美元损害赔偿。
threads.summary_en: DWF Labs subsidiaries DWF Maas and Falcon Digital sued BitGo in London seeking $141 million; they allege BitGo sold discounted FF and ESPORTS tokens before three-month lock-ups expired and seek $114 million in damages.
threads.latest_update_zh: 披露原告为 DWF Maas 与 Falcon Digital，并明确索赔 1.14 亿美元损害赔偿及三个月锁仓期等细节。
threads.latest_update_en: Disclosed plaintiffs DWF Maas and Falcon Digital, specified $114 million in damages sought and three-month lock-up periods.
threads.latest_summary_zh: DWF Labs subsidiaries DWF Maas and Falcon Digital sued BitGo in London for $141 million, alleging the custodian sold discounted FF and ESPORTS tokens before their three-month lock-ups expired and seeking $114 million in damages for resulting price declines.
threads.latest_summary_en: DWF Labs subsidiaries DWF Maas and Falcon Digital sued BitGo in London for $141 million, alleging the custodian sold discounted FF and ESPORTS tokens before their three-month lock-ups expired and seeking $114 million in damages for resulting price declines.

timeline.text_zh: 披露原告为 DWF Maas 与 Falcon Digital，并明确索赔 1.14 亿美元损害赔偿及三个月锁仓期等细节。
timeline.text_en: Disclosed plaintiffs DWF Maas and Falcon Digital, specified $114 million in damages sought and three-month lock-up periods.

timeline.text_zh: DWF Labs关联公司在伦敦高等法院起诉加密托管机构BitGo，索赔1.41亿美元，指控BitGo在约定的锁定期和归属期之前出售Falcon Finance和ESPORTS代币，压低了价格和DWF剩余持仓的价值。
timeline.text_en: DWF Labs affiliates sued crypto custodian BitGo in London's High Court for $141 million, alleging BitGo sold Falcon Finance and ESPORTS tokens ahead of agreed lock-up and vesting periods, depressing prices and DWF's remaining holdings.

threads.title_zh: Webull 因被指与中国存在“结构性”关联的报道而暴跌 32%
threads.title_en: Webull plunged 32% on report of ‘structural’ ties to China
threads.summary_zh: 美国众议院美中战略竞争特别委员会发布 23 页报告，称 Webull 存在与中国关联的数据安全风险，Webull 股价当日收跌 19% 至 5.89 美元；Webull 回应称报告存在重大不实，美国客户数据存储于美国境内，敏感数据访问权限由美国方面控制。
threads.summary_en: The US House Select Committee on the CCP released a 23-page report alleging China-linked data security risks at Webull, sending its shares down 19% to close at $5.89; Webull denied the report as materially false, saying US client data is stored domestically and sensitive access is controlled by US parties.
threads.latest_update_zh: Webull 发言人称该报告包含重大不实之处和缺乏依据的结论，并称美国客户数据存储于美国境内，敏感数据访问权限由美国方面控制；报告发布当日 Webull 股价收跌 19%，报 5.89 美元。
threads.latest_update_en: A Webull spokesperson called the report materially false and said US client data is stored domestically under US-controlled access; the stock closed down 19% at $5.89 on the day the report was released.
threads.latest_summary_zh: The US House Select Committee on the CCP released a 23-page report alleging China-linked data security risks at crypto-trading broker Webull, sending its shares down 19%, while Webull called the report materially false and said US client data is stored domestically under US-controlled access.
threads.latest_summary_en: The US House Select Committee on the CCP released a 23-page report alleging China-linked data security risks at crypto-trading broker Webull, sending its shares down 19%, while Webull called the report materially false and said US client data is stored domestically under US-controlled access.

timeline.text_zh: Webull 发言人称该报告包含重大不实之处和缺乏依据的结论，并称美国客户数据存储于美国境内，敏感数据访问权限由美国方面控制；报告发布当日 Webull 股价收跌 19%，报 5.89 美元。
timeline.text_en: A Webull spokesperson called the report materially false and said US client data is stored domestically under US-controlled access; the stock closed down 19% at $5.89 on the day the report was released.

timeline.text_zh: 美国一个两党国会委员会报告将拥有2800万用户的券商Webull列为国家安全风险，指其所有权、人员、技术和合规在结构上与中国挂钩，Webull股价一度暴跌32%。
timeline.text_en: Webull shares plunged as much as 32% after a bipartisan US congressional committee report labeled the 28-million-user brokerage a national security risk, alleging its ownership, staffing, technology and compliance are structurally tied to China.

threads.title_zh: 【贝森特：美国本周可能查扣约 10 亿美元与伊朗相关的加密货币】
threads.title_en: 【贝森特：美国本周可能查扣约 10 亿美元与伊朗相关的加密货币】
threads.summary_zh: 美国可能本周查扣约 10 亿美元与伊朗相关的加密资产，同时将对伊政策升级为“绝对孤立”，涵盖金融制裁、海上封锁、航空限制和陆路通道切断；相关行动是否已正式实施尚不明确。
threads.summary_en: The US may seize about $1 billion in Iran-related crypto this week while escalating its Iran policy to 'absolute isolation' through sanctions, maritime blockade, aviation restrictions, and cutting land transit routes; implementation remains unconfirmed.
threads.latest_update_zh: 贝森特进一步说明对伊朗政策从“极限施压”升级为“绝对孤立”，措施包括海上封锁、限制航空运输、切断陆路通道，并与阿联酋、阿曼、巴基斯坦、土耳其协调；他还称当局已掌握拟查扣加密资产的位置。
threads.latest_update_en: Bessent further detailed escalation from 'maximum pressure' to 'absolute isolation' against Iran, including maritime blockade, aviation restrictions, land transit cuts, and coordination with UAE, Oman, Pakistan, and Turkey; he also said authorities know the location of the crypto assets to be seized.
threads.latest_summary_zh: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Washington may seize about $1 billion in crypto assets this week while escalating its Iran policy from 'maximum pressure' to 'absolute isolation' through sanctions, maritime blockade, aviation restrictions and cuts to land transit routes.
threads.latest_summary_en: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Washington may seize about $1 billion in crypto assets this week while escalating its Iran policy from 'maximum pressure' to 'absolute isolation' through sanctions, maritime blockade, aviation restrictions and cuts to land transit routes.

timeline.text_zh: 贝森特进一步说明对伊朗政策从“极限施压”升级为“绝对孤立”，措施包括海上封锁、限制航空运输、切断陆路通道，并与阿联酋、阿曼、巴基斯坦、土耳其协调；他还称当局已掌握拟查扣加密资产的位置。
timeline.text_en: Bessent further detailed escalation from 'maximum pressure' to 'absolute isolation' against Iran, including maritime blockade, aviation restrictions, land transit cuts, and coordination with UAE, Oman, Pakistan, and Turkey; he also said authorities know the location of the crypto assets to be seized.

timeline.text_zh: 美国财政部长贝森特表示，美国本周可能扣押约10亿美元与伊朗相关的加密货币，华盛顿正将其制裁行动升级为对伊朗的“绝对孤立”。
timeline.text_en: US Treasury Secretary Bessent said the US may seize about $1 billion in Iran-related cryptocurrency this week as Washington escalates its sanctions campaign into 'absolute isolation' of Iran.

threads.title_zh: Deno将加入Cloudflare
threads.title_en: Deno Is Joining Cloudflare
threads.summary_zh: Cloudflare 已聘用整个 Deno 团队，Deno 运行时进入为期一年的仅错误修复和安全更新阶段后停止官方开发；Deno Deploy 将在6个月后关闭，客户迁至 Cloudflare Workers；JSR 继续运营并迁移基础设施至 Cloudflare；Ryan Dahl 和 Bert Belder 负责将 celld 整合进 workerd。
threads.summary_en: Cloudflare has hired the entire Deno team, Deno runtime enters a one-year bug-fix and security-update-only phase before official development ceases; Deno Deploy will shut down in six months with customers migrated to Cloudflare Workers; JSR continues operating with infrastructure moving to Cloudflare; Ryan Dahl and Bert Belder are tasked with integrating celld into workerd.
threads.latest_update_zh: Deno Deploy 将于6个月后关闭，付费客户迁至 Cloudflare Workers；JSR 继续运营并将基础设施迁至 Cloudflare；Ryan Dahl 与 Bert Belder 将把 celld 的分布式 Workers/Durable Objects 能力整合进 workerd。
threads.latest_update_en: Deno Deploy will shut down in six months with paid customers migrated to Cloudflare Workers; JSR continues operating with infrastructure moving to Cloudflare; Ryan Dahl and Bert Belder will integrate celld's distributed Workers/Durable Objects capabilities into workerd.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Cloudflare has hired the entire Deno team, prompting the Deno runtime to enter a one-year error-fix and security-update-only phase before official development ceases, Deno Deploy to shut down in six months, and Ryan Dahl to focus on merging Deno's distributed celld project with Cloudflare's workerd engine.
threads.latest_summary_en: Cloudflare has hired the entire Deno team, prompting the Deno runtime to enter a one-year error-fix and security-update-only phase before official development ceases, Deno Deploy to shut down in six months, and Ryan Dahl to focus on merging Deno's distributed celld project with Cloudflare's workerd engine.

timeline.text_zh: Deno Deploy 将于6个月后关闭，付费客户迁至 Cloudflare Workers；JSR 继续运营并将基础设施迁至 Cloudflare；Ryan Dahl 与 Bert Belder 将把 celld 的分布式 Workers/Durable Objects 能力整合进 workerd。
timeline.text_en: Deno Deploy will shut down in six months with paid customers migrated to Cloudflare Workers; JSR continues operating with infrastructure moving to Cloudflare; Ryan Dahl and Bert Belder will integrate celld's distributed Workers/Durable Objects capabilities into workerd.

timeline.text_zh: Cloudflare正在收购Deno，Deno自身的运行时开发将逐步收尾，先进行为期一年的每月漏洞修复和安全更新，随后结束，项目将保持开源，但不再由其原团队提供支持。
timeline.text_en: Cloudflare is acquiring Deno, and Deno's own runtime development will wind down to a year of monthly bug-fix and security releases before ending, leaving the project open source but unsupported by its original team.

threads.title_zh: ⚡️美媒：美军已被要求做好对伊朗恢复打击的准备
threads.title_en: ⚡️美媒：美军已被要求做好对伊朗恢复打击的准备
threads.summary_zh: 美国官员称五角大楼已指示中央司令部准备恢复对伊朗的大规模军事行动，可能打击伊朗能源、基础设施和核设施；同时特朗普公开承诺不在中期选举前打击伊朗，但美军据报已向以色列通报可能月底前恢复行动，美伊谈判持续且美国维持封锁。
threads.summary_en: US officials say the Pentagon has instructed CENTCOM to prepare for resuming large-scale military operations against Iran, potentially targeting Iranian energy, infrastructure, and nuclear facilities; meanwhile Trump publicly pledged no strikes before the midterm elections, but the US military reportedly told Israel that operations could resume by the end of October, with US-Iran talks ongoing and the US maintaining its blockade.
threads.latest_update_zh: 特朗普承诺美国不会在11月3日中期选举前打击伊朗；美军据报已向以色列国防军总参谋长通报可能在本月底前恢复对伊军事行动；若恢复打击，伊朗可能报复以色列并导致以色列选举推迟；美伊谈判被描述为富有成效，美国维持对伊封锁。
threads.latest_update_en: Trump pledged the US will not strike Iran before the Nov 3 midterm elections; the US military reportedly told Israel's military chief that operations against Iran could resume by the end of October; if strikes resume, Iran may retaliate against Israel and delay Israel's election; US-Iran talks described as productive; US maintains blockade on Iran.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Trump pledged the US will not strike Iran before the November 3 midterm elections, even as reports say the US military has told Israel's military chief that operations against Iran—potentially targeting energy and nuclear sites—could resume by the end of October.
threads.latest_summary_en: Trump pledged the US will not strike Iran before the November 3 midterm elections, even as reports say the US military has told Israel's military chief that operations against Iran—potentially targeting energy and nuclear sites—could resume by the end of October.

timeline.text_zh: 特朗普承诺美国不会在11月3日中期选举前打击伊朗；美军据报已向以色列国防军总参谋长通报可能在本月底前恢复对伊军事行动；若恢复打击，伊朗可能报复以色列并导致以色列选举推迟；美伊谈判被描述为富有成效，美国维持对伊封锁。
timeline.text_en: Trump pledged the US will not strike Iran before the Nov 3 midterm elections; the US military reportedly told Israel's military chief that operations against Iran could resume by the end of October; if strikes resume, Iran may retaliate against Israel and delay Israel's election; US-Iran talks described as productive; US maintains blockade on Iran.

timeline.text_zh: 美国官员称，五角大楼已指示中央司令部准备恢复对伊朗的大规模军事行动，消息人士暗示打击可能在美国中期选举前发生，目标是伊朗的能源、基础设施和核设施。
timeline.text_en: US officials say the Pentagon has instructed CENTCOM to prepare for resuming large-scale military operations against Iran, with sources suggesting strikes could occur before the US midterm elections, targeting Iranian energy, infrastructure, and nuclear facilities.

threads.title_zh: Solana 生态 Orca 与 Loopscale 合并为 Formation
threads.title_en: Solana's Orca and Loopscale Merge to Form Formation
threads.summary_zh: Orca 与 Loopscale 已完成合并并以 Formation 名义运营，由 Luke Truitt 任 CEO；Formation 总部位于纽约，计划为 AI、能源、机器人、国防资产提供融资，并在 12 个月内推出基于 SEC 创新豁免的代币化证券场所；ORCA 将作为整个 Formation 的代币，Loopscale 积分继续累积并将在今年晚些时候转换。
threads.summary_en: Orca and Loopscale have completed their merger and operate under the Formation brand, led by CEO Luke Truitt; Formation is headquartered in New York, plans to finance AI, energy, robotics, and defense assets, and intends to launch a tokenized securities venue under the SEC Innovation Exemption within 12 months; ORCA will serve as the token for all of Formation, while Loopscale points keep accruing and will convert later this year.
threads.latest_update_zh: Formation 总部位于纽约；计划为 AI、能源、机器人、国防资产提供融资，并在 12 个月内根据 SEC 创新豁免推出代币化证券场所；ORCA 将作为整个 Formation 的代币，Loopscale 积分继续累积并将在今年晚些时候转换；管理层增加 Mary Gooneratne 任 COO、Christopher Montagano 任首席战略与法务官。
threads.latest_update_en: Formation is headquartered in New York; plans to finance AI, energy, robotics, and defense assets and to launch a tokenized securities venue under the SEC Innovation Exemption within 12 months; ORCA will serve as the token for all of Formation, Loopscale points keep accruing and will convert later this year; management adds Mary Gooneratne as COO and Christopher Montagano as chief strategy and legal officer.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Solana DEX Orca and lending protocol Loopscale are merging into a New York-based company called Formation, which plans to finance AI, energy, robotics and defense assets and to launch a tokenized securities venue under the SEC Innovation Exemption within 12 months.
threads.latest_summary_en: Solana DEX Orca and lending protocol Loopscale are merging into a New York-based company called Formation, which plans to finance AI, energy, robotics and defense assets and to launch a tokenized securities venue under the SEC Innovation Exemption within 12 months.

timeline.text_zh: Formation 总部位于纽约；计划为 AI、能源、机器人、国防资产提供融资，并在 12 个月内根据 SEC 创新豁免推出代币化证券场所；ORCA 将作为整个 Formation 的代币，Loopscale 积分继续累积并将在今年晚些时候转换；管理层增加 Mary Gooneratne 任 COO、Christopher Montagano 任首席战略与法务官。
timeline.text_en: Formation is headquartered in New York; plans to finance AI, energy, robotics, and defense assets and to launch a tokenized securities venue under the SEC Innovation Exemption within 12 months; ORCA will serve as the token for all of Formation, Loopscale points keep accruing and will convert later this year; management adds Mary Gooneratne as COO and Christopher Montagano as chief strategy and legal officer.

timeline.text_zh: Solana 流动性协议 Orca 与链上借贷协议 Loopscale 已完成合并，将以新名称 Formation 运营，由 Loopscale 联合创始人 Luke Truitt 出任 CEO，将交易/流动性基础设施与信贷和托管基础设施相结合，为资产提供从发行到融资和流动性的端到端路径。
timeline.text_en: Solana liquidity protocol Orca and on-chain lending protocol Loopscale have completed a merger and will operate under the new name Formation, led by Loopscale co-founder Luke Truitt as CEO, combining trading/liquidity infrastructure with credit and custody infrastructure to offer assets an end-to-end path from issuance to financing and liquidity.

timeline.text_zh: Solana 去中心化交易所 Orca 和借贷协议 Loopscale 正在合并为一家名为 Formation 的新实体，将交易基础设施与借贷和资金库产品相结合，并计划在未来一年向 AI、能源、机器人和国防垂直领域扩张。
timeline.text_en: Solana DEX Orca and lending protocol Loopscale are merging into a new entity called Formation, combining trading infrastructure with lending and vault products and planning expansion into AI, energy, robotics and defense verticals over the next year.

threads.title_zh: Consensys与ClearToken达成合作，将为批发金融市场提供全天候结算基础设施
threads.title_en: Consensys与ClearToken达成合作，将为批发金融市场提供全天候结算基础设施
threads.summary_zh: Consensys与ClearToken的合作维持，提供代币化证券与法币、代币化存款及稳定币之间的全天候DvP结算基础设施；ClearToken旗下CSD已获英国央行数字证券沙盒Gate 2批准，可在限额内运营数字证券存管，但清算业务仍须英国央行授权。
threads.summary_en: The Consensys-ClearToken partnership remains in place to provide round-the-clock DvP settlement between tokenized securities and fiat, tokenized deposits, and stablecoins; ClearToken's CSD has received Bank of England Digital Securities Sandbox Gate 2 approval to operate a limited digital securities depository, while clearing operations still require Bank of England authorization.
threads.latest_update_zh: ClearToken旗下中央证券存管机构获得英国央行数字证券沙盒Gate 2批准，可在限额内运营数字证券存管；清算业务仍须英国央行授权。
threads.latest_update_en: ClearToken's CSD received Bank of England Digital Securities Sandbox Gate 2 approval to operate a limited digital securities depository; clearing operations still require Bank of England authorization.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Consensys partnered with UK digital-asset market infrastructure firm ClearToken to provide round-the-clock DvP settlement between tokenized securities and fiat, tokenized deposits and stablecoins, with ClearToken's CSD having won Bank of England Digital Securities Sandbox Gate 2 approval for limited digital securities depository operations.
threads.latest_summary_en: Consensys partnered with UK digital-asset market infrastructure firm ClearToken to provide round-the-clock DvP settlement between tokenized securities and fiat, tokenized deposits and stablecoins, with ClearToken's CSD having won Bank of England Digital Securities Sandbox Gate 2 approval for limited digital securities depository operations.

timeline.text_zh: ClearToken旗下中央证券存管机构获得英国央行数字证券沙盒Gate 2批准，可在限额内运营数字证券存管；清算业务仍须英国央行授权。
timeline.text_en: ClearToken's CSD received Bank of England Digital Securities Sandbox Gate 2 approval to operate a limited digital securities depository; clearing operations still require Bank of England authorization.

timeline.text_zh: Consensys 与 ClearToken 宣布建立战略合作伙伴关系，为批发市场提供全天候的 DvP 结算基础设施，在英格兰银行的数字证券沙盒下对符合条件的银行证券进行代币化，并以法币、代币化存款和稳定币进行结算。
timeline.text_en: Consensys and ClearToken announced a strategic partnership to deliver round-the-clock DvP settlement infrastructure for wholesale markets, tokenizing eligible bank securities under the Bank of England's Digital Securities Sandbox and settling against fiat, tokenized deposits, and stablecoins.

threads.title_zh: 加密早报：Abstract 宣布分阶段关停，Coinbase 计划年底前重新推出 Coinbase Pro
threads.title_en: Crypto Morning Briefing: Abstract Announces Phased Shutdown, Coinbase Plans to Relaunch Coinbase Pro by Year-End
threads.summary_zh: 每日加密简报中的 Abstract 分阶段关闭事件现已明确：Abstract 将于 2026 年 12 月 15 日关闭，各迁移路径的截止时间可能更早；Coinbase 计划年底前重启 Coinbase Pro 仍按此前报道。
threads.summary_en: The Abstract phased shutdown covered in the daily crypto briefing is now more specific: Abstract will shut down on Dec. 15, 2026, with route-specific migration cutoffs potentially earlier; Coinbase's planned Coinbase Pro relaunch by year-end remains as previously reported.
threads.latest_update_zh: 后续报道补充了 Abstract 关闭的具体日期为 2026 年 12 月 15 日，并说明各迁移路径的启动、完成和申领截止时间可能更早；Cube 条款还明确了迁移与资产访问的相关条件。
threads.latest_update_en: Follow-up coverage adds that Abstract's shutdown date is Dec. 15, 2026, with route-specific initiation, completion, and claim cutoffs potentially earlier; Cube terms also clarify migration and asset-access conditions.

threads.title_zh: 德国监管机构拒绝 MiCA 申请，Bitcoin.de 交易仍处暂停状态
threads.title_en: Bitcoin.de trading remains halted as German regulator rejects MiCA application
threads.summary_zh: BaFin 拒绝了 Futurum Bank AG 的 MiCA 申请，Bitcoin.de 自 6 月 12 日起交易基本暂停，欧元存款暂停，但加密资产提现仍开放。平台计划将交易和托管外包给两家未具名的受监管德国合作方，Futurum Bank 将在资产转移前继续持有资产；无恢复日期，公司可在一个月内提出异议或重新申请。
threads.summary_en: BaFin rejected Futurum Bank AG's MiCA application, leaving Bitcoin.de trading largely suspended since June 12 and euro deposits halted, while crypto withdrawals remain open. The platform plans to outsource trading and custody to two unidentified regulated German partners, with Futurum Bank continuing to hold assets until transfer; no restart date is set, and the company may object within one month or reapply.
threads.latest_update_zh: BaFin 拒绝后，Bitcoin.de 计划通过两家受监管的德国机构重建交易和托管模式：一家作为交易对手方，另一家负责加密资产托管；平台保留应用、品牌和客户界面。客户仍可提取加密资产，但交易和欧元存款暂停，合作方尚未公布，恢复服务无确定日期；公司可在一个月内提出异议，也可能重新申请授权。
threads.latest_update_en: After BaFin's rejection, Bitcoin.de plans to rebuild trading and custody through two regulated German institutions: one as trading counterparty and one for crypto custody, while retaining its app, brand and customer interface. Withdrawals remain open, but trading and euro deposits are suspended; the partners are unidentified, no restart date is set, and the company may object within one month or reapply for authorization.
threads.latest_summary_zh: German regulator BaFin rejected Bitcoin.de operator Futurum Bank's MiCA crypto-asset service provider application, forcing the 1.1 million-user platform to dismantle and rebuild its trading and custody model around external regulated partners while withdrawals remain open and trading stays suspended.
threads.latest_summary_en: German regulator BaFin rejected Bitcoin.de operator Futurum Bank's MiCA crypto-asset service provider application, forcing the 1.1 million-user platform to dismantle and rebuild its trading and custody model around external regulated partners while withdrawals remain open and trading stays suspended.

Withdrawals remain open, but trading and euro deposits are suspended; the partners are unidentified, no restart date is set, and the company may object within one month or reapply for authorization.

timeline.text_en: German regulator BaFin rejected Bitcoin Group SE subsidiary futurum bank AG's MiCA crypto-asset service provider authorization, leaving bitcoin.de trading largely suspended since June while the company pursues an alternative model through regulated partners.

threads.summary_en: Coinbase has appealed a Connecticut court ruling over its sports event contracts, escalating its jurisdictional fight with state regulators over whether prediction-market style products fall under federal derivatives oversight or state gaming law.

focus.title_zh: Anthropic 筹备 IPO：递交招股书并计划最早 11 月中旬上市
focus.summary_zh: Anthropic 正在推进其约 2 万亿美元估值的 IPO，目标 11 月上市，并于 10 月 14 日向投资者披露 Q3 营收 168 亿美元、调整后盈利且现金流为正，市场关注其营收确认口径。
focus.summary_en: Anthropic is advancing its ~$2 trillion IPO targeting a November listing, and on October 14 disclosed Q3 revenue of $16.8 billion with adjusted profitability and positive cash flow to investors, with market focus on revenue recognition clarity.
focus.latest_update_zh: Anthropic 告知投资者其第三季度营收跃升至 168 亿美元，较第二季度的 115 亿美元增长近 50%，按调整后口径实现盈利，并录得正现金流。
focus.latest_update_en: Anthropic told investors its Q3 revenue rose to $16.8 billion, up nearly 50% quarter-over-quarter from $11.5 billion, with adjusted profitability and positive cash flow.
focus.background_zh: Anthropic 是一家 AI 安全与研究公司，以公益公司（public benefit corporation）形式运营，由包括 Amodei 兄妹在内的前 OpenAI 员工创立。若完成 IPO，公司将由私募持股转为公开上市。
focus.background_en: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company that operates as a public benefit corporation and was founded by former OpenAI staff, including siblings Dario and Daniela Amodei. An IPO would move the company from private ownership into public markets.
focus.latest_summary_zh: Anthropic told investors its Q3 revenue rose to $16.8 billion, up nearly 50% quarter-over-quarter, with adjusted profitability and positive cash flow as it prepares for what is expected to be the largest IPO by valuation in history.
focus.latest_summary_en: Anthropic told investors its Q3 revenue rose to $16.8 billion, up nearly 50% quarter-over-quarter, with adjusted profitability and positive cash flow as it prepares for what is expected to be the largest IPO by valuation in history.
focus.market_impact_zh: Anthropic 并未发行代币，因此对加密市场的传导是间接的：一方面通过 AI 叙事类代币的市场情绪，另一方面是这样一笔大型 AI 股票上市可能吸走机构配置资金、加剧风险资本竞争。按其报道中的规模，这一事件更可能影响 AI 相关加密板块的情绪与流动性，而非某一具体资产。
focus.market_impact_en: Anthropic issues no token, so any crypto-market transmission would be indirect — through sentiment toward AI-narrative tokens and through competition for risk capital as a large AI equity listing absorbs institutional allocations. The scale of the reported offering makes it a potential sentiment and liquidity factor for AI-adjacent crypto segments rather than for any single asset.

focus.title_zh: CFTC提出规则将事件合约归类为联邦掉期并排除赌场赌博
focus.title_en: CFTC Proposes CTX and CAM Rules to Establish Federal Crypto Exchange Framework
focus.summary_zh: CFTC提出两项规则，将事件合约归类为联邦“掉期”，同时排除赌场赌博，这加剧了其与起诉Kalshi和Polymarket等预测市场运营商的各州之间的管辖权之争。
focus.summary_en: The CFTC proposed two rules that would classify event contracts as federal 'swaps' while excluding casino gambling, escalating its jurisdictional battle with states suing prediction-market operators like Kalshi and Polymarket.
focus.latest_update_zh: CFTC提案明确将体育、政治、文化和天气事件合约纳入掉期定义，并发布临时最终规则排除体育博彩和赌场赌注，进一步划定预测市场与赌博的联邦界限。
focus.latest_update_en: The CFTC proposed expressly including sports, political, cultural and weather event contracts in the swap definition and issued an interim final rule excluding sportsbook and casino wagers, further drawing the federal line between prediction markets and gambling.
focus.background_zh: 参议院未能达到推进《CLARITY 法案》所需的 60 票门槛，该法案本将为数字资产建立法定框架。美国加密交易目前要么适用为其他市场制定的规则，要么适用各州不一的地方牌照。CFTC 的这份通知还否定了该机构在拜登时期对 Kraken、Ooki DAO 和 Uniswap 的执法案件，称其为“以执法代替监管”。
focus.background_en: The Senate failed to reach the 60 votes needed to advance the CLARITY Act, which would have created a statutory framework for digital assets. Crypto trading in the US currently runs under rules built for other markets or under state licenses that vary by state. The CFTC notice also disowns the agency's Biden-era cases against Kraken, Ooki DAO and Uniswap as regulation by enforcement.
focus.latest_summary_zh: The CFTC proposed including sports, political, cultural and weather event contracts in the swap definition while issuing an interim final rule excluding sportsbook and casino wagers, drawing a federal line between prediction markets and gambling.
focus.latest_summary_en: The CFTC proposed including sports, political, cultural and weather event contracts in the swap definition while issuing an interim final rule excluding sportsbook and casino wagers, drawing a federal line between prediction markets and gambling.
focus.market_impact_zh: 传导路径在于美国市场准入：联邦牌照将使本土交易所能够上线目前主要在离岸提供的杠杆及永续类产品，涉及交易所股票、在岸永续合约场所及为其撮合交易的经纪商，而更清晰的规则也会降低银行和券商涉足加密业务的门槛。由于该文件只是开启意见征询期，近期影响限于围绕美国受监管场所的情绪与仓位，而非已生效的规则。
focus.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through US market access: a federal license would let domestic exchanges list leveraged and perpetual-style products now largely offered offshore, putting exchange equities, listed perp venues and the brokers routing those trades in scope, with clear rules also lowering the barrier for banks and brokers to touch crypto. Because the document only opens a comment period, near-term effects are confined to sentiment and positioning around US-regulated venues rather than to rules in force.

timeline.text_zh: CFTC提案明确将体育、政治、文化和天气事件合约纳入掉期定义，并发布临时最终规则排除体育博彩和赌场赌注，进一步划定预测市场与赌博的联邦界限。
timeline.text_en: The CFTC proposed expressly including sports, political, cultural and weather event contracts in the swap definition and issued an interim final rule excluding sportsbook and casino wagers, further drawing the federal line between prediction markets and gambling.

timeline.text_zh: CFTC发布了一项立即生效的临时最终规则，并提出另一项新规，拟将Kalshi和Polymarket等平台的预测市场事件合约纳入其掉期监管框架；临时最终规则已立即生效但仍接受公众意见，新规提案则有30天意见征询期。
timeline.text_en: The CFTC issued an immediately effective interim final rule and proposed a new rule to bring prediction-market event contracts on platforms such as Kalshi and Polymarket under its swaps regulatory framework; the interim final rule is effective immediately but remains open to comment, while the proposed rule has a 30-day comment period.

timeline.text_zh: NFL向最高法院提交法庭意见书，支持新泽西州在Kalshi案中的调卷令申请，主张各州可对预测市场的体育事件合约施加赌博监管，并对CFTC声称拥有专属联邦管辖权提出异议，指出Kalshi未遵守操纵防范措施、内部人员投注限制和21岁年龄要求。
timeline.text_en: The NFL filed an amicus brief with the Supreme Court supporting New Jersey's cert petition in the Kalshi case, arguing states may impose gambling regulation on prediction-market sports event contracts and disputing the CFTC's claim of exclusive federal jurisdiction, citing unmet manipulation safeguards, insider-betting limits, and age-21 requirements that Kalshi does not follow.

focus.title_zh: 加密硬件钱包遭攻击，估计损失7000万美元
focus.title_en: Crypto Hardware Wallets Hit in Estimated $70 Million Attack
focus.summary_zh: Ledger 硬件钱包被盗事件现已确认涉及供应链环节：授权经销商售出的设备被植入未授权模块，助记词可被截获并外传；行业对硬件钱包供应链与自托管安全保证的审查加剧。
focus.summary_en: The Ledger hardware-wallet loss incident is now confirmed to involve the supply chain: devices sold through an authorized reseller contained unauthorized implants that could capture and exfiltrate recovery phrases, intensifying scrutiny of hardware-wallet supply-chain and self-custody security guarantees.
focus.latest_update_zh: Ledger 确认通过授权经销商 CryptoBilis 售出的一台受影响设备含有未授权植入模块；这些恶意植入模块会截取用户助记词并通过蜂窝网络传输。Trezor 也宣布作为预防措施减少经销商数量。
focus.latest_update_en: Ledger confirmed that one affected device sold through authorized reseller CryptoBilis contained an unauthorized implant; the malicious implants captured users’ recovery phrases and transmitted them over cellular networks. Trezor also announced it would reduce resellers as a preventive step.
focus.latest_summary_zh: A Cointelegraph report, featuring hardware-security researcher Joe Grand, examines whether crypto users can realistically verify the integrity of hardware wallets after reported losses involving Ledger devices sold through authorized reseller CryptoBilis.
focus.latest_summary_en: A Cointelegraph report, featuring hardware-security researcher Joe Grand, examines whether crypto users can realistically verify the integrity of hardware wallets after reported losses involving Ledger devices sold through authorized reseller CryptoBilis.

timeline.text_zh: Ledger 确认通过授权经销商 CryptoBilis 售出的一台受影响设备含有未授权植入模块；这些恶意植入模块会截取用户助记词并通过蜂窝网络传输。Trezor 也宣布作为预防措施减少经销商数量。
timeline.text_en: Ledger confirmed that one affected device sold through authorized reseller CryptoBilis contained an unauthorized implant; the malicious implants captured users’ recovery phrases and transmitted them over cellular networks. Trezor also announced it would reduce resellers as a preventive step.

timeline.text_zh: Ledger报告称，加密货币硬件钱包在一场估计损失7000万美元的攻击中被盗空，引发了对自托管设备安全保证的担忧。
timeline.text_en: Ledger reported that cryptocurrency hardware wallets were drained in an attack estimated at $70 million, raising concerns about the security guarantees of self-custody devices.

focus.title_zh: Blast宣布关停L2主网，因维护成本超过收入
focus.title_en: Blast announces shutdown of its L2 mainnet as maintenance costs exceed revenue
focus.summary_zh: Blast 因维护成本超过收入而停止运营，用户需在 10 月 26 日前将资产撤回以太坊主网；Bithumb 与 Upbit 已将 BLAST 列入交易注意名单并暂停充值；Upbit 进一步宣布将下架 BLAST，并将在当地时间 10 月 26 日 12:00 下架 BLAST 现货交易，相关网络转换期间暂停提现；Coinbase 要求用户在 10 月 26 日前将 BLAST 转出，并据报道于 10 月 20 日暂停 BLAST 交易。
focus.summary_en: Blast is ceasing operations because maintenance costs exceed revenue, and users need to withdraw assets to Ethereum mainnet by Oct. 26. Bithumb and Upbit added BLAST to trading-caution watchlists and suspended deposits; Upbit has further announced it will delist BLAST and will delist BLAST spot trading on Oct. 26 at 12:00 local time, with withdrawals halted during the associated network conversion. Coinbase requires users to move BLAST off Coinbase by Oct. 26 and is reported to suspend BLAST trading on Oct. 20.
focus.latest_update_zh: Upbit 具体说明将于当地时间 10 月 26 日 12:00 下架 BLAST 现货交易。
focus.latest_update_en: Upbit specified that it will delist BLAST spot trading on October 26 at 12:00 local time.
focus.background_zh: Blast 是一条以太坊二层网络，在 2024 年 2 月主网上线时吸引了 23 亿美元存款，最初主打 ETH 与稳定币持仓的原生收益。有报道称，团队于 2026 年 10 月 2 日宣布逐步关停，理由是运营成本已超过二层网络收入，且看不到可信的经济可持续路径。
focus.background_en: Blast is an Ethereum layer-2 network that drew $2.3 billion in deposits by its February 2024 mainnet launch and initially pitched native yield on ETH and stablecoin holdings. Reports say the team announced the wind-down on October 2, 2026, citing operating costs that exceed L2 revenue with no credible path to economic sustainability.
focus.latest_summary_zh: Upbit announced it will delist BLAST spot trading on October 26 at 12:00 local time.
focus.latest_summary_en: Upbit announced it will delist BLAST spot trading on October 26 at 12:00 local time.
focus.market_impact_zh: 传导路径经由交易所托管与提现基础设施：存放在 Coinbase 的 BLAST 必须在截止日期前转出，随着网络关停，资金流将集中到该代币剩余的交易场所与提现通道。这也会影响市场对以太坊二层网络经济模型的情绪，不过此次关停属于有序退出，而非故障或漏洞事件。
focus.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through exchange custody and withdrawal infrastructure: BLAST held on Coinbase must be moved before the deadline, which concentrates flow into the token's remaining trading venues and withdrawal rails as the network winds down. It also feeds sentiment about the economics of Ethereum layer-2 networks, though the shutdown is an orderly sunset rather than a failure or exploit.

focus.title_zh: Google 发布 Gemini 4 Argon 模型
focus.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 的 Gemini 4 Argon 已向全球付费用户开放，此前仅面向部分网络安全合作伙伴。用户可通过 Gemini App（Google AI Pro/Ultra）、Antigravity（仅 Ultra）及付费 API 使用；API 首发价为每百万输入 token 2 美元、输出 10 美元，优惠至 11 月 30 日后翻倍。谷歌同时展示其视频驱动机器人技能学习、自动仿真生成等能力，ERQA 物理推理评测得分 87%。
focus.summary_en: Google DeepMind's Gemini 4 Argon is now open to global paid users after initially being limited to selected cybersecurity partners. It is available via the Gemini App (Google AI Pro/Ultra), Antigravity (Ultra only), and paid API; introductory API pricing is $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens until Nov 30, after which it doubles. Google also showcased video-driven robot skill learning, automated simulation generation, and an 87% score on the ERQA physical-reasoning benchmark.
focus.latest_update_zh: Gemini 4 Argon 从仅面向部分网络安全合作伙伴，扩大至向全球所有付费用户正式开放；可在 Gemini App（Google AI Pro/Ultra）、Antigravity（仅 Ultra）和付费 API 使用；API 首发价每百万输入 2 美元、输出 10 美元，优惠持续至 11 月 30 日后翻倍。谷歌还展示了其视频驱动机器人技能学习和仿真生成能力，ERQA 得分 87%。
focus.latest_update_en: Gemini 4 Argon expanded from limited availability for selected cybersecurity partners to a general opening for all global paid users; it is available in the Gemini App (Google AI Pro/Ultra), Antigravity (Ultra only), and paid API. Introductory API pricing of $2/$10 per million tokens lasts until Nov 30, after which it doubles. Google also showcased video-driven robot skill learning, simulation generation, and an 87% ERQA score.
focus.background_zh: 据 9to5Google 报道，Gemini 4 Argon 采用了新的命名体系，此前谷歌取消了 Gemini 3.5 Pro，并将重心放在 Gemini 3.8 Flash 上。前沿模型通常基于海量数据训练，成本极高，涵盖数据获取与处理以及算力开支。第三方对比报道将 Gemini 4 Argon 与 OpenAI 的 GPT-6 Astra 视为同代竞争对手。
focus.background_en: Gemini 4 Argon uses a new naming scheme and follows the cancellation of Gemini 3.5 Pro, with Google having focused on Gemini 3.8 Flash, according to 9to5Google. Frontier models are typically trained on vast datasets at very high cost, covering data acquisition and processing plus compute. Third-party comparison coverage places Gemini 4 Argon alongside OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra as a same-generation rival.
focus.latest_summary_zh: Google has opened Gemini 4 Argon to all global paid users, showcasing video-driven robot skill learning (Apptronik's Apollo landing 7 straight sandbag throws), automated simulation generation, 87% on the ERQA physical-reasoning benchmark, and launch API pricing of $2/$10 per million tokens that doubles after November 30.
focus.latest_summary_en: Google has opened Gemini 4 Argon to all global paid users, showcasing video-driven robot skill learning (Apptronik's Apollo landing 7 straight sandbag throws), automated simulation generation, 87% on the ERQA physical-reasoning benchmark, and launch API pricing of $2/$10 per million tokens that doubles after November 30.
focus.market_impact_zh: 该发布与链上资产、托管或代币供给没有直接关联；对加密市场的可能传导渠道是情绪面，即去中心化算力、AI 代理等 AI 叙事类资产历来会对头部实验室的前沿模型发布作出反应。由于模型初期仅面向选定合作伙伴开放，目前尚不能确立开发者需求层面的即时变化。
focus.market_impact_en: The release has no direct on-chain, custody or token-supply linkage; any crypto read-through runs through sentiment in AI-narrative assets such as decentralized-compute and AI-agent tokens, which have historically reacted to frontier-model announcements from major labs. Because availability is initially gated to select partners, no immediate developer-demand shift is established.

focus.title_zh: Ledger硬件钱包供应链植入间谍芯片窃取助记词事件
focus.title_en: Ledger Hardware Wallet Supply Chain Implant Seed Theft Incident
focus.summary_zh: Ledger已将销售暂停请求扩大至六个东南亚国家和香港的经销商，设备下架，调查仍在进行；Ledger称已确认事件仍限于东南亚，且未核实其他地区购买设备相关的资金流出。
focus.summary_en: Ledger has expanded its sales suspension request to resellers in six Southeast Asian countries and Hong Kong, with devices removed from shelves and the investigation ongoing; Ledger says confirmed incidents remain contained to Southeast Asia and it has not verified a drain linked to a device bought elsewhere.
focus.latest_update_zh: Ledger要求印度尼西亚、新加坡、泰国、菲律宾、越南、马来西亚及香港的经销商暂停销售并下架硬件钱包，以调查设备篡改事件；此前仅要求经销商CryptoBilis停售和停止发货。
focus.latest_update_en: Ledger requested resellers and distributors in Indonesia, Singapore, Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia and Hong Kong to suspend sales and remove its hardware wallets from shelves while it investigates device tampering; this expands on the earlier request for reseller CryptoBilis to halt sales and shipments.
focus.background_zh: 相关调查于 10 月 9 日公开，此前有用户报告称，通过区域经销商 CryptoBilis 购买的 Ledger 设备涉及加密资产被盗；Ledger 表示所有已确认的损失都涉及通过该经销商售出的设备。Ledger 称目前确认的相关事件仍局限于东南亚，尚未核实其他地区购买的设备与资金被盗有关。该公司还强调，没有迹象表明其自身基础设施、系统、服务或官方直销渠道遭到入侵。研究人员称，自 9 月 16 日起已发现 Ledger X 设备中被植入该装置，被篡改的设备以近原价一半的价格出售。
focus.background_en: The investigation was disclosed on Oct 9 after users reported crypto asset thefts linked to Ledger devices bought through CryptoBilis, a reseller in the region; Ledger has said all confirmed losses involve devices sold through that reseller. Ledger said the only confirmed incidents remain contained in Southeast Asia and that it has not verified a drain linked to a device bought elsewhere. It added that it has no indication its own infrastructure, systems, services or direct sales channel have been compromised. Researchers have reported the implant in Ledger X devices since Sept 16, with tampered units offered at nearly half the original price.
focus.latest_summary_zh: Ledger asked resellers and distributors across six Southeast Asian countries plus Hong Kong to suspend sales and remove its hardware wallets from shelves while it investigates confirmed device-tampering incidents in the region.
focus.latest_summary_en: Ledger asked resellers and distributors across six Southeast Asian countries plus Hong Kong to suspend sales and remove its hardware wallets from shelves while it investigates confirmed device-tampering incidents in the region.
focus.market_impact_zh: 此次影响集中在 Ledger 设备在东南亚及香港的线下零售与经销渠道，传导路径主要作用于供应链完整性和自托管信心，而非协议流动性。Ledger 称其官方直销渠道未受影响；与此同时，竞争对手 Trezor 表示出于预防将于 2027 年 1 月 1 日终止对经销商的授权，这可能使硬件钱包需求在不同厂商和销售渠道之间发生转移。
focus.market_impact_en: The disruption sits in the physical retail and reseller channel for Ledger devices in Southeast Asia and Hong Kong, so the transmission runs through supply-chain integrity and self-custody sentiment rather than protocol liquidity. Ledger says its direct sales channel is unaffected, while rival Trezor's stated plan to end reseller authorizations from Jan 1, 2027 as a precautionary measure could shift hardware-wallet demand between vendors and sales channels.

timeline.text_zh: Ledger要求印度尼西亚、新加坡、泰国、菲律宾、越南、马来西亚及香港的经销商暂停销售并下架硬件钱包，以调查设备篡改事件；此前仅要求经销商CryptoBilis停售和停止发货。
timeline.text_en: Ledger requested resellers and distributors in Indonesia, Singapore, Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia and Hong Kong to suspend sales and remove its hardware wallets from shelves while it investigates device tampering; this expands on the earlier request for reseller CryptoBilis to halt sales and shipments.

timeline.text_zh: 在Ledger的Donjon团队确认，通过经销商CryptoBilis售出的硬件钱包中被植入间谍程序，可捕获助记词并通过LTE外传——链上追踪到疑似被盗资金达8600万美元——之后，Trezor出于预防考虑，决定在2027年1月1日前削减其自有授权经销商网络。
timeline.text_en: After Ledger's Donjon team confirmed a spy implant in hardware wallets sold via reseller CryptoBilis that captures seed phrases and exfiltrates them over LTE — with $86M in suspected thefts traced onchain — Trezor moved to cut its own authorized reseller network by January 1, 2027 as a precaution.

timeline.text_zh: 新报道称，Mark Karpelès 已在菲律宾官方经销商 LazMall 销售的 Ledger 钱包中也发现间谍软件，使受影响经销商范围进一步扩大；Ledger 最新声明称尚未核实来自其他渠道购买签名器的资金流出，并正在审查其他签名器和地点的植入物报告，同时 CryptoBilis 在调查期间继续停售。
timeline.text_en: The new report says Mark Karpelès has also found spyware in Ledger wallets sold by official Philippine reseller LazMall, further widening the affected-reseller scope; Ledger’s latest statement says it has not verified a drain linked to a signer bought elsewhere and is reviewing reports of implants in other signers and locations, while CryptoBilis remains not selling wallets during the investigation.

ranking.title_zh: Anthropic 筹备 IPO：递交招股书并计划最早 11 月中旬上市
ranking.summary_zh: Anthropic 正在推进其约 2 万亿美元估值的 IPO，目标 11 月上市，并于 10 月 14 日向投资者披露 Q3 营收 168 亿美元、调整后盈利且现金流为正，市场关注其营收确认口径。
ranking.summary_en: Anthropic is advancing its ~$2 trillion IPO targeting a November listing, and on October 14 disclosed Q3 revenue of $16.8 billion with adjusted profitability and positive cash flow to investors, with market focus on revenue recognition clarity.
ranking.latest_update_zh: Anthropic 告知投资者其第三季度营收跃升至 168 亿美元，较第二季度的 115 亿美元增长近 50%，按调整后口径实现盈利，并录得正现金流。
ranking.latest_update_en: Anthropic told investors its Q3 revenue rose to $16.8 billion, up nearly 50% quarter-over-quarter from $11.5 billion, with adjusted profitability and positive cash flow.
ranking.background_zh: Anthropic 是一家 AI 安全与研究公司，以公益公司（public benefit corporation）形式运营，由包括 Amodei 兄妹在内的前 OpenAI 员工创立。若完成 IPO，公司将由私募持股转为公开上市。
ranking.background_en: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company that operates as a public benefit corporation and was founded by former OpenAI staff, including siblings Dario and Daniela Amodei. An IPO would move the company from private ownership into public markets.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: Anthropic told investors its Q3 revenue rose to $16.8 billion, up nearly 50% quarter-over-quarter, with adjusted profitability and positive cash flow as it prepares for what is expected to be the largest IPO by valuation in history.
ranking.latest_summary_en: Anthropic told investors its Q3 revenue rose to $16.8 billion, up nearly 50% quarter-over-quarter, with adjusted profitability and positive cash flow as it prepares for what is expected to be the largest IPO by valuation in history.
ranking.market_impact_zh: Anthropic 并未发行代币，因此对加密市场的传导是间接的：一方面通过 AI 叙事类代币的市场情绪，另一方面是这样一笔大型 AI 股票上市可能吸走机构配置资金、加剧风险资本竞争。按其报道中的规模，这一事件更可能影响 AI 相关加密板块的情绪与流动性，而非某一具体资产。
ranking.market_impact_en: Anthropic issues no token, so any crypto-market transmission would be indirect — through sentiment toward AI-narrative tokens and through competition for risk capital as a large AI equity listing absorbs institutional allocations. The scale of the reported offering makes it a potential sentiment and liquidity factor for AI-adjacent crypto segments rather than for any single asset.

ranking.title_zh: CFTC提出规则将事件合约归类为联邦掉期并排除赌场赌博
ranking.title_en: CFTC Proposes CTX and CAM Rules to Establish Federal Crypto Exchange Framework
ranking.summary_zh: CFTC提出两项规则，将事件合约归类为联邦“掉期”，同时排除赌场赌博，这加剧了其与起诉Kalshi和Polymarket等预测市场运营商的各州之间的管辖权之争。
ranking.summary_en: The CFTC proposed two rules that would classify event contracts as federal 'swaps' while excluding casino gambling, escalating its jurisdictional battle with states suing prediction-market operators like Kalshi and Polymarket.
ranking.latest_update_zh: CFTC提案明确将体育、政治、文化和天气事件合约纳入掉期定义，并发布临时最终规则排除体育博彩和赌场赌注，进一步划定预测市场与赌博的联邦界限。
ranking.latest_update_en: The CFTC proposed expressly including sports, political, cultural and weather event contracts in the swap definition and issued an interim final rule excluding sportsbook and casino wagers, further drawing the federal line between prediction markets and gambling.
ranking.background_zh: 参议院未能达到推进《CLARITY 法案》所需的 60 票门槛，该法案本将为数字资产建立法定框架。美国加密交易目前要么适用为其他市场制定的规则，要么适用各州不一的地方牌照。CFTC 的这份通知还否定了该机构在拜登时期对 Kraken、Ooki DAO 和 Uniswap 的执法案件，称其为“以执法代替监管”。
ranking.background_en: The Senate failed to reach the 60 votes needed to advance the CLARITY Act, which would have created a statutory framework for digital assets. Crypto trading in the US currently runs under rules built for other markets or under state licenses that vary by state. The CFTC notice also disowns the agency's Biden-era cases against Kraken, Ooki DAO and Uniswap as regulation by enforcement.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: The CFTC proposed including sports, political, cultural and weather event contracts in the swap definition while issuing an interim final rule excluding sportsbook and casino wagers, drawing a federal line between prediction markets and gambling.
ranking.latest_summary_en: The CFTC proposed including sports, political, cultural and weather event contracts in the swap definition while issuing an interim final rule excluding sportsbook and casino wagers, drawing a federal line between prediction markets and gambling.
ranking.market_impact_zh: 传导路径在于美国市场准入：联邦牌照将使本土交易所能够上线目前主要在离岸提供的杠杆及永续类产品，涉及交易所股票、在岸永续合约场所及为其撮合交易的经纪商，而更清晰的规则也会降低银行和券商涉足加密业务的门槛。由于该文件只是开启意见征询期，近期影响限于围绕美国受监管场所的情绪与仓位，而非已生效的规则。
ranking.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through US market access: a federal license would let domestic exchanges list leveraged and perpetual-style products now largely offered offshore, putting exchange equities, listed perp venues and the brokers routing those trades in scope, with clear rules also lowering the barrier for banks and brokers to touch crypto. Because the document only opens a comment period, near-term effects are confined to sentiment and positioning around US-regulated venues rather than to rules in force.

timeline.text_zh: CFTC提案明确将体育、政治、文化和天气事件合约纳入掉期定义，并发布临时最终规则排除体育博彩和赌场赌注，进一步划定预测市场与赌博的联邦界限。
timeline.text_en: The CFTC proposed expressly including sports, political, cultural and weather event contracts in the swap definition and issued an interim final rule excluding sportsbook and casino wagers, further drawing the federal line between prediction markets and gambling.

timeline.text_zh: CFTC发布了一项立即生效的临时最终规则，并提出另一项新规，拟将Kalshi和Polymarket等平台的预测市场事件合约纳入其掉期监管框架；临时最终规则已立即生效但仍接受公众意见，新规提案则有30天意见征询期。
timeline.text_en: The CFTC issued an immediately effective interim final rule and proposed a new rule to bring prediction-market event contracts on platforms such as Kalshi and Polymarket under its swaps regulatory framework; the interim final rule is effective immediately but remains open to comment, while the proposed rule has a 30-day comment period.

timeline.text_zh: NFL向最高法院提交法庭意见书，支持新泽西州在Kalshi案中的调卷令申请，主张各州可对预测市场的体育事件合约施加赌博监管，并对CFTC声称拥有专属联邦管辖权提出异议，指出Kalshi未遵守操纵防范措施、内部人员投注限制和21岁年龄要求。
timeline.text_en: The NFL filed an amicus brief with the Supreme Court supporting New Jersey's cert petition in the Kalshi case, arguing states may impose gambling regulation on prediction-market sports event contracts and disputing the CFTC's claim of exclusive federal jurisdiction, citing unmet manipulation safeguards, insider-betting limits, and age-21 requirements that Kalshi does not follow.

ranking.title_zh: 加密硬件钱包遭攻击，估计损失7000万美元
ranking.title_en: Crypto Hardware Wallets Hit in Estimated $70 Million Attack
ranking.summary_zh: Ledger 硬件钱包被盗事件现已确认涉及供应链环节：授权经销商售出的设备被植入未授权模块，助记词可被截获并外传；行业对硬件钱包供应链与自托管安全保证的审查加剧。
ranking.summary_en: The Ledger hardware-wallet loss incident is now confirmed to involve the supply chain: devices sold through an authorized reseller contained unauthorized implants that could capture and exfiltrate recovery phrases, intensifying scrutiny of hardware-wallet supply-chain and self-custody security guarantees.
ranking.latest_update_zh: Ledger 确认通过授权经销商 CryptoBilis 售出的一台受影响设备含有未授权植入模块；这些恶意植入模块会截取用户助记词并通过蜂窝网络传输。Trezor 也宣布作为预防措施减少经销商数量。
ranking.latest_update_en: Ledger confirmed that one affected device sold through authorized reseller CryptoBilis contained an unauthorized implant; the malicious implants captured users’ recovery phrases and transmitted them over cellular networks. Trezor also announced it would reduce resellers as a preventive step.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: A Cointelegraph report, featuring hardware-security researcher Joe Grand, examines whether crypto users can realistically verify the integrity of hardware wallets after reported losses involving Ledger devices sold through authorized reseller CryptoBilis.
ranking.latest_summary_en: A Cointelegraph report, featuring hardware-security researcher Joe Grand, examines whether crypto users can realistically verify the integrity of hardware wallets after reported losses involving Ledger devices sold through authorized reseller CryptoBilis.

timeline.text_zh: Ledger 确认通过授权经销商 CryptoBilis 售出的一台受影响设备含有未授权植入模块；这些恶意植入模块会截取用户助记词并通过蜂窝网络传输。Trezor 也宣布作为预防措施减少经销商数量。
timeline.text_en: Ledger confirmed that one affected device sold through authorized reseller CryptoBilis contained an unauthorized implant; the malicious implants captured users’ recovery phrases and transmitted them over cellular networks. Trezor also announced it would reduce resellers as a preventive step.

timeline.text_zh: Ledger报告称，加密货币硬件钱包在一场估计损失7000万美元的攻击中被盗空，引发了对自托管设备安全保证的担忧。
timeline.text_en: Ledger reported that cryptocurrency hardware wallets were drained in an attack estimated at $70 million, raising concerns about the security guarantees of self-custody devices.

ranking.title_zh: Blast宣布关停L2主网，因维护成本超过收入
ranking.title_en: Blast announces shutdown of its L2 mainnet as maintenance costs exceed revenue
ranking.summary_zh: Blast 因维护成本超过收入而停止运营，用户需在 10 月 26 日前将资产撤回以太坊主网；Bithumb 与 Upbit 已将 BLAST 列入交易注意名单并暂停充值；Upbit 进一步宣布将下架 BLAST，并将在当地时间 10 月 26 日 12:00 下架 BLAST 现货交易，相关网络转换期间暂停提现；Coinbase 要求用户在 10 月 26 日前将 BLAST 转出，并据报道于 10 月 20 日暂停 BLAST 交易。
ranking.summary_en: Blast is ceasing operations because maintenance costs exceed revenue, and users need to withdraw assets to Ethereum mainnet by Oct. 26. Bithumb and Upbit added BLAST to trading-caution watchlists and suspended deposits; Upbit has further announced it will delist BLAST and will delist BLAST spot trading on Oct. 26 at 12:00 local time, with withdrawals halted during the associated network conversion. Coinbase requires users to move BLAST off Coinbase by Oct. 26 and is reported to suspend BLAST trading on Oct. 20.
ranking.latest_update_zh: Upbit 具体说明将于当地时间 10 月 26 日 12:00 下架 BLAST 现货交易。
ranking.latest_update_en: Upbit specified that it will delist BLAST spot trading on October 26 at 12:00 local time.
ranking.background_zh: Blast 是一条以太坊二层网络，在 2024 年 2 月主网上线时吸引了 23 亿美元存款，最初主打 ETH 与稳定币持仓的原生收益。有报道称，团队于 2026 年 10 月 2 日宣布逐步关停，理由是运营成本已超过二层网络收入，且看不到可信的经济可持续路径。
ranking.background_en: Blast is an Ethereum layer-2 network that drew $2.3 billion in deposits by its February 2024 mainnet launch and initially pitched native yield on ETH and stablecoin holdings. Reports say the team announced the wind-down on October 2, 2026, citing operating costs that exceed L2 revenue with no credible path to economic sustainability.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: Upbit announced it will delist BLAST spot trading on October 26 at 12:00 local time.
ranking.latest_summary_en: Upbit announced it will delist BLAST spot trading on October 26 at 12:00 local time.
ranking.market_impact_zh: 传导路径经由交易所托管与提现基础设施：存放在 Coinbase 的 BLAST 必须在截止日期前转出，随着网络关停，资金流将集中到该代币剩余的交易场所与提现通道。这也会影响市场对以太坊二层网络经济模型的情绪，不过此次关停属于有序退出，而非故障或漏洞事件。
ranking.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through exchange custody and withdrawal infrastructure: BLAST held on Coinbase must be moved before the deadline, which concentrates flow into the token's remaining trading venues and withdrawal rails as the network winds down. It also feeds sentiment about the economics of Ethereum layer-2 networks, though the shutdown is an orderly sunset rather than a failure or exploit.

timeline.text_zh: Upbit 具体说明将于当地时间 10 月 26 日 12:00 下架 BLAST 现货交易。
timeline.text_en: Upbit specified that it will delist BLAST spot trading on October 26 at 12:00 local time.

timeline.text_zh: Upbit 宣布将下架 Blast（BLAST），并在相关网络转换期间暂停提现。
timeline.text_en: Upbit announced it will delist Blast (BLAST) from its platform and halt withdrawals during the associated network conversion.

timeline.text_zh: Coinbase 于 10 月 7 日发布状态更新，确认 Blast 网络正在被项目团队关停，并要求用户必须在 2026 年 10 月 26 日前将 BLAST 转出 Coinbase，否则网络关停后将无法访问这些资产；媒体报道称 Coinbase 将于 10 月 20 日暂停 BLAST 交易。
timeline.text_en: Coinbase posted a status update on Oct 7 confirming the Blast network is being shut down by the project team and requiring users to move BLAST off Coinbase before Oct 26, 2026, or lose access after shutdown; media reports say Coinbase will suspend BLAST trading on Oct 20.

ranking.title_zh: Google 发布 Gemini 4 Argon 模型
ranking.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 的 Gemini 4 Argon 已向全球付费用户开放，此前仅面向部分网络安全合作伙伴。用户可通过 Gemini App（Google AI Pro/Ultra）、Antigravity（仅 Ultra）及付费 API 使用；API 首发价为每百万输入 token 2 美元、输出 10 美元，优惠至 11 月 30 日后翻倍。谷歌同时展示其视频驱动机器人技能学习、自动仿真生成等能力，ERQA 物理推理评测得分 87%。
ranking.summary_en: Google DeepMind's Gemini 4 Argon is now open to global paid users after initially being limited to selected cybersecurity partners. It is available via the Gemini App (Google AI Pro/Ultra), Antigravity (Ultra only), and paid API; introductory API pricing is $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens until Nov 30, after which it doubles. Google also showcased video-driven robot skill learning, automated simulation generation, and an 87% score on the ERQA physical-reasoning benchmark.
ranking.latest_update_zh: Gemini 4 Argon 从仅面向部分网络安全合作伙伴，扩大至向全球所有付费用户正式开放；可在 Gemini App（Google AI Pro/Ultra）、Antigravity（仅 Ultra）和付费 API 使用；API 首发价每百万输入 2 美元、输出 10 美元，优惠持续至 11 月 30 日后翻倍。谷歌还展示了其视频驱动机器人技能学习和仿真生成能力，ERQA 得分 87%。
ranking.latest_update_en: Gemini 4 Argon expanded from limited availability for selected cybersecurity partners to a general opening for all global paid users; it is available in the Gemini App (Google AI Pro/Ultra), Antigravity (Ultra only), and paid API. Introductory API pricing of $2/$10 per million tokens lasts until Nov 30, after which it doubles. Google also showcased video-driven robot skill learning, simulation generation, and an 87% ERQA score.
ranking.background_zh: 据 9to5Google 报道，Gemini 4 Argon 采用了新的命名体系，此前谷歌取消了 Gemini 3.5 Pro，并将重心放在 Gemini 3.8 Flash 上。前沿模型通常基于海量数据训练，成本极高，涵盖数据获取与处理以及算力开支。第三方对比报道将 Gemini 4 Argon 与 OpenAI 的 GPT-6 Astra 视为同代竞争对手。
ranking.background_en: Gemini 4 Argon uses a new naming scheme and follows the cancellation of Gemini 3.5 Pro, with Google having focused on Gemini 3.8 Flash, according to 9to5Google. Frontier models are typically trained on vast datasets at very high cost, covering data acquisition and processing plus compute. Third-party comparison coverage places Gemini 4 Argon alongside OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra as a same-generation rival.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: Google has opened Gemini 4 Argon to all global paid users, showcasing video-driven robot skill learning (Apptronik's Apollo landing 7 straight sandbag throws), automated simulation generation, 87% on the ERQA physical-reasoning benchmark, and launch API pricing of $2/$10 per million tokens that doubles after November 30.
ranking.latest_summary_en: Google has opened Gemini 4 Argon to all global paid users, showcasing video-driven robot skill learning (Apptronik's Apollo landing 7 straight sandbag throws), automated simulation generation, 87% on the ERQA physical-reasoning benchmark, and launch API pricing of $2/$10 per million tokens that doubles after November 30.
ranking.market_impact_zh: 该发布与链上资产、托管或代币供给没有直接关联；对加密市场的可能传导渠道是情绪面，即去中心化算力、AI 代理等 AI 叙事类资产历来会对头部实验室的前沿模型发布作出反应。由于模型初期仅面向选定合作伙伴开放，目前尚不能确立开发者需求层面的即时变化。
ranking.market_impact_en: The release has no direct on-chain, custody or token-supply linkage; any crypto read-through runs through sentiment in AI-narrative assets such as decentralized-compute and AI-agent tokens, which have historically reacted to frontier-model announcements from major labs. Because availability is initially gated to select partners, no immediate developer-demand shift is established.

reference_links.title: Introducing Gemini 4 Argon

timeline.text_zh: Gemini 4 Argon 从仅面向部分网络安全合作伙伴，扩大至向全球所有付费用户正式开放；可在 Gemini App（Google AI Pro/Ultra）、Antigravity（仅 Ultra）和付费 API 使用；API 首发价每百万输入 2 美元、输出 10 美元，优惠持续至 11 月 30 日后翻倍。谷歌还展示了其视频驱动机器人技能学习和仿真生成能力，ERQA 得分 87%。
timeline.text_en: Gemini 4 Argon expanded from limited availability for selected cybersecurity partners to a general opening for all global paid users; it is available in the Gemini App (Google AI Pro/Ultra), Antigravity (Ultra only), and paid API. Introductory API pricing of $2/$10 per million tokens lasts until Nov 30, after which it doubles. Google also showcased video-driven robot skill learning, simulation generation, and an 87% ERQA score.

timeline.text_zh: Google DeepMind 发布了 Gemini 4“Argon”，这是一款新的前沿模型，可通过 API 使用，入门价格为每百万输入 token 2 美元、每百万输出 token 10 美元（缓存输入享 95% 折扣），因其 SVG 生成和自然语言写作质量而受到关注。
timeline.text_en: Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 'Argon', a new frontier model available via API at introductory pricing of $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens (95% off cached input), drawing attention for its SVG generation and natural-language writing quality.

timeline.text_zh: Artificial Analysis 的独立评估发现，谷歌的 Gemini 4 Argon 在智能指数上以 53 分与 GPT-6 Astra 持平，其幻觉率远低（15%），API 入门价格也更便宜，但全价成本和答案准确性落后于 Astra。
timeline.text_en: Artificial Analysis' independent evaluation finds Google's Gemini 4 Argon ties GPT-6 Astra on the Intelligence Index at 53 points with a far lower hallucination rate (15%) and cheaper introductory API costs, though full-price costs and answer accuracy lag Astra.

ranking.title_zh: Ledger硬件钱包供应链植入间谍芯片窃取助记词事件
ranking.title_en: Ledger Hardware Wallet Supply Chain Implant Seed Theft Incident
ranking.summary_zh: Ledger已将销售暂停请求扩大至六个东南亚国家和香港的经销商，设备下架，调查仍在进行；Ledger称已确认事件仍限于东南亚，且未核实其他地区购买设备相关的资金流出。
ranking.summary_en: Ledger has expanded its sales suspension request to resellers in six Southeast Asian countries and Hong Kong, with devices removed from shelves and the investigation ongoing; Ledger says confirmed incidents remain contained to Southeast Asia and it has not verified a drain linked to a device bought elsewhere.
ranking.latest_update_zh: Ledger要求印度尼西亚、新加坡、泰国、菲律宾、越南、马来西亚及香港的经销商暂停销售并下架硬件钱包，以调查设备篡改事件；此前仅要求经销商CryptoBilis停售和停止发货。
ranking.latest_update_en: Ledger requested resellers and distributors in Indonesia, Singapore, Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia and Hong Kong to suspend sales and remove its hardware wallets from shelves while it investigates device tampering; this expands on the earlier request for reseller CryptoBilis to halt sales and shipments.
ranking.background_zh: 相关调查于 10 月 9 日公开，此前有用户报告称，通过区域经销商 CryptoBilis 购买的 Ledger 设备涉及加密资产被盗；Ledger 表示所有已确认的损失都涉及通过该经销商售出的设备。Ledger 称目前确认的相关事件仍局限于东南亚，尚未核实其他地区购买的设备与资金被盗有关。该公司还强调，没有迹象表明其自身基础设施、系统、服务或官方直销渠道遭到入侵。研究人员称，自 9 月 16 日起已发现 Ledger X 设备中被植入该装置，被篡改的设备以近原价一半的价格出售。
ranking.background_en: The investigation was disclosed on Oct 9 after users reported crypto asset thefts linked to Ledger devices bought through CryptoBilis, a reseller in the region; Ledger has said all confirmed losses involve devices sold through that reseller. Ledger said the only confirmed incidents remain contained in Southeast Asia and that it has not verified a drain linked to a device bought elsewhere. It added that it has no indication its own infrastructure, systems, services or direct sales channel have been compromised. Researchers have reported the implant in Ledger X devices since Sept 16, with tampered units offered at nearly half the original price.
ranking.latest_summary_zh: Ledger asked resellers and distributors across six Southeast Asian countries plus Hong Kong to suspend sales and remove its hardware wallets from shelves while it investigates confirmed device-tampering incidents in the region.
ranking.latest_summary_en: Ledger asked resellers and distributors across six Southeast Asian countries plus Hong Kong to suspend sales and remove its hardware wallets from shelves while it investigates confirmed device-tampering incidents in the region.
ranking.market_impact_zh: 此次影响集中在 Ledger 设备在东南亚及香港的线下零售与经销渠道，传导路径主要作用于供应链完整性和自托管信心，而非协议流动性。Ledger 称其官方直销渠道未受影响；与此同时，竞争对手 Trezor 表示出于预防将于 2027 年 1 月 1 日终止对经销商的授权，这可能使硬件钱包需求在不同厂商和销售渠道之间发生转移。
ranking.market_impact_en: The disruption sits in the physical retail and reseller channel for Ledger devices in Southeast Asia and Hong Kong, so the transmission runs through supply-chain integrity and self-custody sentiment rather than protocol liquidity. Ledger says its direct sales channel is unaffected, while rival Trezor's stated plan to end reseller authorizations from Jan 1, 2027 as a precautionary measure could shift hardware-wallet demand between vendors and sales channels.

reference_links.title: Ledger confirms spy chip implant behind wallet crypto thefts

timeline.text_zh: Ledger要求印度尼西亚、新加坡、泰国、菲律宾、越南、马来西亚及香港的经销商暂停销售并下架硬件钱包，以调查设备篡改事件；此前仅要求经销商CryptoBilis停售和停止发货。
timeline.text_en: Ledger requested resellers and distributors in Indonesia, Singapore, Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia and Hong Kong to suspend sales and remove its hardware wallets from shelves while it investigates device tampering; this expands on the earlier request for reseller CryptoBilis to halt sales and shipments.

timeline.text_zh: 在Ledger的Donjon团队确认，通过经销商CryptoBilis售出的硬件钱包中被植入间谍程序，可捕获助记词并通过LTE外传——链上追踪到疑似被盗资金达8600万美元——之后，Trezor出于预防考虑，决定在2027年1月1日前削减其自有授权经销商网络。
timeline.text_en: After Ledger's Donjon team confirmed a spy implant in hardware wallets sold via reseller CryptoBilis that captures seed phrases and exfiltrates them over LTE — with $86M in suspected thefts traced onchain — Trezor moved to cut its own authorized reseller network by January 1, 2027 as a precaution.

timeline.text_zh: 新报道称，Mark Karpelès 已在菲律宾官方经销商 LazMall 销售的 Ledger 钱包中也发现间谍软件，使受影响经销商范围进一步扩大；Ledger 最新声明称尚未核实来自其他渠道购买签名器的资金流出，并正在审查其他签名器和地点的植入物报告，同时 CryptoBilis 在调查期间继续停售。
timeline.text_en: The new report says Mark Karpelès has also found spyware in Ledger wallets sold by official Philippine reseller LazMall, further widening the affected-reseller scope; Ledger’s latest statement says it has not verified a drain linked to a signer bought elsewhere and is reviewing reports of implants in other signers and locations, while CryptoBilis remains not selling wallets during the investigation.

featured.title_zh: Anthropic 筹备 IPO：递交招股书并计划最早 11 月中旬上市
featured.summary_zh: Anthropic 正在推进其约 2 万亿美元估值的 IPO，目标 11 月上市，并于 10 月 14 日向投资者披露 Q3 营收 168 亿美元、调整后盈利且现金流为正，市场关注其营收确认口径。
featured.summary_en: Anthropic is advancing its ~$2 trillion IPO targeting a November listing, and on October 14 disclosed Q3 revenue of $16.8 billion with adjusted profitability and positive cash flow to investors, with market focus on revenue recognition clarity.
featured.latest_update_zh: Anthropic 告知投资者其第三季度营收跃升至 168 亿美元，较第二季度的 115 亿美元增长近 50%，按调整后口径实现盈利，并录得正现金流。
featured.latest_update_en: Anthropic told investors its Q3 revenue rose to $16.8 billion, up nearly 50% quarter-over-quarter from $11.5 billion, with adjusted profitability and positive cash flow.
featured.background_zh: Anthropic 是一家 AI 安全与研究公司，以公益公司（public benefit corporation）形式运营，由包括 Amodei 兄妹在内的前 OpenAI 员工创立。若完成 IPO，公司将由私募持股转为公开上市。
featured.background_en: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company that operates as a public benefit corporation and was founded by former OpenAI staff, including siblings Dario and Daniela Amodei. An IPO would move the company from private ownership into public markets.
featured.latest_summary_zh: Anthropic told investors its Q3 revenue rose to $16.8 billion, up nearly 50% quarter-over-quarter, with adjusted profitability and positive cash flow as it prepares for what is expected to be the largest IPO by valuation in history.
featured.latest_summary_en: Anthropic told investors its Q3 revenue rose to $16.8 billion, up nearly 50% quarter-over-quarter, with adjusted profitability and positive cash flow as it prepares for what is expected to be the largest IPO by valuation in history.
featured.market_impact_zh: Anthropic 并未发行代币，因此对加密市场的传导是间接的：一方面通过 AI 叙事类代币的市场情绪，另一方面是这样一笔大型 AI 股票上市可能吸走机构配置资金、加剧风险资本竞争。按其报道中的规模，这一事件更可能影响 AI 相关加密板块的情绪与流动性，而非某一具体资产。
featured.market_impact_en: Anthropic issues no token, so any crypto-market transmission would be indirect — through sentiment toward AI-narrative tokens and through competition for risk capital as a large AI equity listing absorbs institutional allocations. The scale of the reported offering makes it a potential sentiment and liquidity factor for AI-adjacent crypto segments rather than for any single asset.

timeline.text_en: Anthropic told investors its Q3 revenue rose to $16.8 billion, up nearly 50% quarter-over-quarter from $11.5 billion, with adjusted profitability and positive cash flow.

timeline.text_zh: Anthropic 于10月14日在旧金山总部向潜在机构投资者披露第三季度营收数据，作为其约2万亿美元IPO进程的一部分，重点在于营收确认口径（是否计入云合作伙伴收入）。
timeline.text_en: Anthropic is disclosing its Q3 revenue to potential institutional investors at its San Francisco headquarters on October 14 as part of its ~$2 trillion IPO process, with focus on revenue recognition clarity (including whether cloud partner revenue is counted).

timeline.text_zh: 据报道，Anthropic 正准备最早于 11 月中旬 IPO，目标估值约 1.8 至 2 万亿美元，并将于 10 月 14 日在旧金山开始与投资者会面。
timeline.text_en: Anthropic is reportedly preparing to IPO as early as mid-November, targeting a valuation of about $1.8-2 trillion and beginning investor meetings in San Francisco on October 14.

featured.title_zh: CFTC提出规则将事件合约归类为联邦掉期并排除赌场赌博
featured.title_en: CFTC Proposes CTX and CAM Rules to Establish Federal Crypto Exchange Framework
featured.summary_zh: CFTC提出两项规则，将事件合约归类为联邦“掉期”，同时排除赌场赌博，这加剧了其与起诉Kalshi和Polymarket等预测市场运营商的各州之间的管辖权之争。
featured.summary_en: The CFTC proposed two rules that would classify event contracts as federal 'swaps' while excluding casino gambling, escalating its jurisdictional battle with states suing prediction-market operators like Kalshi and Polymarket.
featured.latest_update_zh: CFTC提案明确将体育、政治、文化和天气事件合约纳入掉期定义，并发布临时最终规则排除体育博彩和赌场赌注，进一步划定预测市场与赌博的联邦界限。
featured.latest_update_en: The CFTC proposed expressly including sports, political, cultural and weather event contracts in the swap definition and issued an interim final rule excluding sportsbook and casino wagers, further drawing the federal line between prediction markets and gambling.
featured.background_zh: 参议院未能达到推进《CLARITY 法案》所需的 60 票门槛，该法案本将为数字资产建立法定框架。美国加密交易目前要么适用为其他市场制定的规则，要么适用各州不一的地方牌照。CFTC 的这份通知还否定了该机构在拜登时期对 Kraken、Ooki DAO 和 Uniswap 的执法案件，称其为“以执法代替监管”。
featured.background_en: The Senate failed to reach the 60 votes needed to advance the CLARITY Act, which would have created a statutory framework for digital assets. Crypto trading in the US currently runs under rules built for other markets or under state licenses that vary by state. The CFTC notice also disowns the agency's Biden-era cases against Kraken, Ooki DAO and Uniswap as regulation by enforcement.
featured.latest_summary_zh: The CFTC proposed including sports, political, cultural and weather event contracts in the swap definition while issuing an interim final rule excluding sportsbook and casino wagers, drawing a federal line between prediction markets and gambling.
featured.latest_summary_en: The CFTC proposed including sports, political, cultural and weather event contracts in the swap definition while issuing an interim final rule excluding sportsbook and casino wagers, drawing a federal line between prediction markets and gambling.
featured.market_impact_zh: 传导路径在于美国市场准入：联邦牌照将使本土交易所能够上线目前主要在离岸提供的杠杆及永续类产品，涉及交易所股票、在岸永续合约场所及为其撮合交易的经纪商，而更清晰的规则也会降低银行和券商涉足加密业务的门槛。由于该文件只是开启意见征询期，近期影响限于围绕美国受监管场所的情绪与仓位，而非已生效的规则。
featured.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through US market access: a federal license would let domestic exchanges list leveraged and perpetual-style products now largely offered offshore, putting exchange equities, listed perp venues and the brokers routing those trades in scope, with clear rules also lowering the barrier for banks and brokers to touch crypto. Because the document only opens a comment period, near-term effects are confined to sentiment and positioning around US-regulated venues rather than to rules in force.

timeline.text_zh: CFTC提案明确将体育、政治、文化和天气事件合约纳入掉期定义，并发布临时最终规则排除体育博彩和赌场赌注，进一步划定预测市场与赌博的联邦界限。
timeline.text_en: The CFTC proposed expressly including sports, political, cultural and weather event contracts in the swap definition and issued an interim final rule excluding sportsbook and casino wagers, further drawing the federal line between prediction markets and gambling.

timeline.text_zh: CFTC发布了一项立即生效的临时最终规则，并提出另一项新规，拟将Kalshi和Polymarket等平台的预测市场事件合约纳入其掉期监管框架；临时最终规则已立即生效但仍接受公众意见，新规提案则有30天意见征询期。
timeline.text_en: The CFTC issued an immediately effective interim final rule and proposed a new rule to bring prediction-market event contracts on platforms such as Kalshi and Polymarket under its swaps regulatory framework; the interim final rule is effective immediately but remains open to comment, while the proposed rule has a 30-day comment period.

timeline.text_zh: NFL向最高法院提交法庭意见书，支持新泽西州在Kalshi案中的调卷令申请，主张各州可对预测市场的体育事件合约施加赌博监管，并对CFTC声称拥有专属联邦管辖权提出异议，指出Kalshi未遵守操纵防范措施、内部人员投注限制和21岁年龄要求。
timeline.text_en: The NFL filed an amicus brief with the Supreme Court supporting New Jersey's cert petition in the Kalshi case, arguing states may impose gambling regulation on prediction-market sports event contracts and disputing the CFTC's claim of exclusive federal jurisdiction, citing unmet manipulation safeguards, insider-betting limits, and age-21 requirements that Kalshi does not follow.

featured.title_zh: 加密硬件钱包遭攻击，估计损失7000万美元
featured.title_en: Crypto Hardware Wallets Hit in Estimated $70 Million Attack
featured.summary_zh: Ledger 硬件钱包被盗事件现已确认涉及供应链环节：授权经销商售出的设备被植入未授权模块，助记词可被截获并外传；行业对硬件钱包供应链与自托管安全保证的审查加剧。
featured.summary_en: The Ledger hardware-wallet loss incident is now confirmed to involve the supply chain: devices sold through an authorized reseller contained unauthorized implants that could capture and exfiltrate recovery phrases, intensifying scrutiny of hardware-wallet supply-chain and self-custody security guarantees.
featured.latest_update_zh: Ledger 确认通过授权经销商 CryptoBilis 售出的一台受影响设备含有未授权植入模块；这些恶意植入模块会截取用户助记词并通过蜂窝网络传输。Trezor 也宣布作为预防措施减少经销商数量。
featured.latest_update_en: Ledger confirmed that one affected device sold through authorized reseller CryptoBilis contained an unauthorized implant; the malicious implants captured users’ recovery phrases and transmitted them over cellular networks. Trezor also announced it would reduce resellers as a preventive step.
featured.latest_summary_zh: A Cointelegraph report, featuring hardware-security researcher Joe Grand, examines whether crypto users can realistically verify the integrity of hardware wallets after reported losses involving Ledger devices sold through authorized reseller CryptoBilis.
featured.latest_summary_en: A Cointelegraph report, featuring hardware-security researcher Joe Grand, examines whether crypto users can realistically verify the integrity of hardware wallets after reported losses involving Ledger devices sold through authorized reseller CryptoBilis.

timeline.text_zh: Ledger 确认通过授权经销商 CryptoBilis 售出的一台受影响设备含有未授权植入模块；这些恶意植入模块会截取用户助记词并通过蜂窝网络传输。Trezor 也宣布作为预防措施减少经销商数量。
timeline.text_en: Ledger confirmed that one affected device sold through authorized reseller CryptoBilis contained an unauthorized implant; the malicious implants captured users’ recovery phrases and transmitted them over cellular networks. Trezor also announced it would reduce resellers as a preventive step.

timeline.text_zh: Ledger报告称，加密货币硬件钱包在一场估计损失7000万美元的攻击中被盗空，引发了对自托管设备安全保证的担忧。
timeline.text_en: Ledger reported that cryptocurrency hardware wallets were drained in an attack estimated at $70 million, raising concerns about the security guarantees of self-custody devices.

dormant.title_zh: OKX与ICE合资公司向SEC提交文件，规划代币化股票交易

对该文件的报道称其对代币化股票交易设有限制，另有一个标题指出代币化证券交易场所不会挑战传统交易所。该文件本身并不构成对该计划的批准。
dormant.latest_update_en: OKX has filed with the SEC to outline a 24/7 trading framework for 63 tokenized stocks on its platform, advancing its push into tokenized equity products.

dormant.title_zh: EmbeddingGemma 2：一款开放、轻量的多模态嵌入模型
dormant.title_en: EmbeddingGemma 2: An open, lightweight multimodal embedding model
dormant.latest_update_zh: 新增技术细节：完整模型为 740M 参数，统一支持文本、代码、图片、视频和音频的向量检索；可按需加载，仅文本/代码为 270M，加视觉为 440M，全量为 740M；上下文由 2K 提升至 8K；MTEB Code 得分从 68.76 升至 78.68；支持将 768 维压缩至 512/256/128 维；Pixel 11 Pro 上量化后内存占用约 191MB/567MB。
dormant.latest_update_en: Adds technical details: full model is 740M parameters unifying text, code, image, video and audio retrieval; supports flexible loading (270M text/code, 440M with vision, 740M full); context increased from 2K to 8K; MTEB Code score rose from 68.76 to 78.68; 768-dim vectors can be compressed to 512/256/128; quantized memory on Pixel 11 Pro about 191MB/567MB.

dormant.title_zh: Reflection 推出 Beam：一款以更低算力成本对标中国模型的开源权重 AI 模型
dormant.title_en: Reflection debuts Beam, an open-weight AI model to rival Chinese models at lower compute cost
dormant.latest_update_zh: 新报道补充了 Reflection 自行公布的基准测试结果，显示 Beam 在 DeepSWE 上得分 44.4，接近 GLM-5.2（44.0），但落后于 Qwen 3.8-Max、GLM-5.3、Kimi K3 和 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash。训练方面，预训练使用 6144 块 GB300，不到 4 周处理 23.8 万亿 token；随后用 1.05 万块 GB300 进行 4 周强化学习，生成超过 1 亿条训练轨迹。Beam 仍在最后安全测试阶段，仅少量用户可提前使用；完整权重、技术报告和模型卡计划本月晚些时候以 Apache 2.0 协议发布。
dormant.latest_update_en: New coverage adds Reflection's own benchmark results showing Beam scoring 44.4 on DeepSWE, close to GLM-5.2's 44.0 but behind Qwen 3.8-Max, GLM-5.3, Kimi K3 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. Training details: pretraining on 6,144 GB300 GPUs processing 23.8 trillion tokens in under 4 weeks, followed by 4 weeks of reinforcement learning on 10,500 GB300 GPUs generating over 100 million rollouts. Beam is still in final safety testing with limited early access; full weights, technical report and model card are planned for later this month under Apache 2.0.
